The role at a glance

Get to Know the Team

The Merchant App Flutter team builds and maintains the core merchant app for businesses using Grab. Whether you're supporting small local vendors or scaling for international franchises, the team focuses on creating tools to empower merchants. You'll join a close-knit group of passionate engineers committed to elevating the merchant experience and delivering impactful solutions

Get to Know the Role

Reporting to the Software Engineering Manager, you will focus on both feature development and engineering optimization for the Grab merchant app. With this role, you will take direct responsibility for delivering high-quality technical solutions, scaling tools for merchants, and taking ownership of impactful engineering contributions. This role is an onsite role based in Jakarta

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

You will develop and enhance app features to improve merchant workflows, ensuring the app is efficient, responsive, and user-friendly.

You will design clear, scalable programming solutions using best practices such as dependency injection or MVVM.

You will analyze and optimize app performance to address issues like response time, battery use, and storage impact.

You will write robust unit tests, integration tests, and collaborate with QA engineers to maintain quality standards during app releases.

You will maintain current features, resolve bugs, and enhance code functionality while ensuring technical consistency and long-term performance goals.

You will serve in the on-call rotation for critical mobile issues, balancing rapid fixes with logical troubleshooting.

title: Lead Data Scientist (Analytics) - Digital Marketing
raw_description:
Lead Data Scientist (Analytics) - Digital Marketing

Team

Data Analytics

Location

Jakarta, Indonesia

Job Type

Full-time

The role at a glance

Skills you need

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know the Team

The Growth Data Science team is a key component of our regional growth strategy. We focus on creating and implementing innovative approaches to drive growth through performance marketing automation, machine learning models, geospatial insights, user lifecycle and funnel optimisation, behavioural forecasting, and other advanced analytics methods. Our work spans across transportation, food, fintech, logistics, and platform services.

Get to Know the Role

We are seeking Data Scientist with deep expertise in paid marketing measurement, AI-driven analytics, and operations to join our growing team. In this role, you'll collaborate with marketing leaders, analytics teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to solve complex digital marketing challenges using advanced measurement science, artificial intelligence, and data-driven approaches. You'll work on end-to-end paid marketing analytics initiatives.

You will directly report to the Senior Manager. You will be based onsite.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

Partner with marketing stakeholders to align measurement strategies with business goals, channels, and data constraints.

Select and apply attribution, incrementality, and causal inference methods, explaining trade-offs and recommendations.

Design and run experiments—including A/B tests, holdouts, matched markets, and geo-lift studies—to measure campaign impact.

Build and maintain Media Mix Models (MMM) to assess channel effectiveness, guide budget allocation, and forecast performance.

Develop AI and machine learning solutions to improve campaign targeting, bidding, experimentation, and measurement workflows.

Build scalable data pipelines integrating paid media, conversion, and internal data using SQL, Spark, and cloud technologies.

Create analytics tools and dashboards to track campaign performance, acquisition costs, and marketing ROI.

Conduct exploratory analysis and statistical modeling; validate models and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

Manage project plans, document methodologies, and communicate insights clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Collaborate across marketing, analytics, product, and engineering teams; mentor junior analysts and data scientists.

Read more

title: Data Scientist (Product Analytics) - Financial Services
raw_description:
Data Scientist (Product Analytics) - Financial Services

Team

Data Analytics

Location

Jakarta, Indonesia

Job Type

Full-time

The role at a glance

Skills you need

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know the Team

GrabFin Analytics team supports the GFin product and business organisations, across Payments, Lending, Insurance, and Kios. As a Senior Data Scientist (Analytics), you will be part of the Lending tech family where we strive to be the best FinTech company in the region. Our team is focused on understanding user experiences and partnering with Business, Product, Design, and Tech teams to achieve the right outcomes. We are integral to product development, from understanding user journeys with UX designers, to developing hypotheses, through to post-rollout optimisation.

Get to Know the Role

In this role, you'll partner closely with Product Managers to turn product and business questions into clear hypotheses, thoughtfully designed experiments, and actionable insights. You'll build a deep understanding of users—their needs, pain points, and behaviours—while keeping business goals in view. As a strategic analytics partner throughout the product development lifecycle, you'll support teams from early ideation through execution, helping shape product direction and prioritize features based on evidence and expected impact.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

Partner with cross-functional teams to identify data requirements and design innovative analytical solutions or insights to address complex challenges effectively.

Conduct in-depth analyses of operational data, including business/impact analysis and text analysis, to identify areas for improvement and process optimization.

Develop dashboards to monitor the performance of Grab Support operations, support specialists, and the business overall.

Utilize advanced statistical and machine learning techniques, such as quasi-experimental methods, NLP & LLM, to analyze large datasets and derive meaningful insights that drive business decisions, improve support performance, and mitigate risks.

Stay up-to-date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in analytics and data science, leveraging this knowledge to enhance the organization's data-driven capabilities.

Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure data quality, integrity, and accessibility, while building data pipelines and infrastructure for analytics projects.

Communicate complex analytical findings to all stakeholders, including senior management, through concise reports, presentations, and visualizations.

Read more

Skills you need

What Essential Skills You Will Need

A minimum of Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Statistics, or Engineering or any related field.

At least 2+ years of experience in Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Data Science roles, preferably in an Internet or "Direct-to-Consumer" company with large, complex, high-velocity data.

Proficiency in Big Data technologies such as Spark, PySpark, and Databricks.

title: Senior Data Engineer
raw_description:
Senior Data Engineer

Team

Engineering

Location

Jakarta, Indonesia

Job Type

Full-time

The role at a glance

Skills you need

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know the Role

As a Data Engineer in the Lending Data Engineering team, you will collaborate with a diverse group of stakeholders across Southeast Asia. This group includes data modelers, product analysts, product managers, software engineers, and business leaders. You will design and manage scalable, end-to-end data solutions across acquisition, storage, processing, and consumption. These solutions will utilize technologies like Flink, Airflow, Spark, Kafka, and Trino. You will report directly to the Data Engineering Manager, with a full-time onsite working arrangement in our Jakarta Office.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

Build and maintain scalable batch, real-time, and event-driven ETL pipelines using core AWS services (Glue, Redshift, Athena, Lambda, S3, EMR, Kinesis, MSK).

Design and deploy modern data lifecycle frameworks supporting streaming, API-based, serverless, and batch consumption directly on the data lake.

Establish robust data checks, automated cleansing routines, and governance best practices using tools like AWS Glue DataBrew to ensure high data reliability.

Monitor, maintain, and optimize data platform infrastructure to guarantee high availability, low latency, and accurate, timely delivery of key business metrics.

Master and leverage in-house data platform tools alongside native AWS technologies to streamline pipeline setup, execution, and real-time metric tracking.

Collaborate across engineering teams to translate real-time data availability into actionable business definitions, driving data-informed decision-making.

Read more

Skills you need

What Essential Skills You Will Need

6+ years building scalable, fault-tolerant, and mission-critical data pipelines.

Proficiency in Python, Scala, or Java; strong SQL, schema design, and data modeling skills.

Expertise in big data frameworks (Flink, Spark, Trino, Airflow, Kafka) across SQL, NoSQL, and Columnar databases.

Hands-on experience with AWS services (S3, EMR, Redshift, Athena, Glue, Kinesis) and event-driven architectures (SNS, SQS, Lambda).

Experience for analytical. Experience communicating updates and resolutions to customers and other partners with a drive to learn and innovate.

Degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Bertanggung jawab dalam pengelolaan operasional Digital Channel Astra Daihatsu (Website, Apps, dan Chatbot), termasuk pengelolaan konten, pemantauan performa sistem, serta analisis data yang dihasilkan untuk memastikan setiap kanal digital berfungsi optimal dan menghasilkan leads yang direspon dengan cepat dan tepat.

  1. Mengelola operasional digital channel Astra Daihatsu (website, apps, chatbot) agar berjalan dengan baik tanpa error.
  2. Membuat report dan analisis performa digital product Astra Daihatsu serta menyusun insight yang relevan untuk dipresentasikan kepada tim.

  6. Terus memperdalam pengetahuan tentang teknologi terbaru, algoritma, dan perkembangan dalam dunia machine learning untuk menghadirkan solusi yang inovatif dan efektif.
  7. Menyediakan solusi yang kreatif dan efisien terhadap tantangan teknis atau metodologis dalam pengembangan model-machine learning.

title: AVP-Data Integration
raw_description:
Role:

Responsible for leading the definition, development, continuous improvement, and delivery of enterprise data integration capabilities across Data Analytics platforms. The role acts as a senior individual contributor and technical platform owner for data integration, ensuring that data solutions are reliable, scalable, secure, cost-efficient, and aligned with business outcomes.

Responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data integration architecture, data pipelines, data warehouse interfaces, data marts, and data exchange mechanisms between operational systems, analytical platforms, cloud platforms, and reporting/BI solutions.

 

Qualification:

Minimum Bachelor’s degree (S1) in Telecommunication, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or other relevant technical disciplines. Master’s degree or relevant professional certification in cloud/data engineering is an advantage.

Experience:

  • Minimum 5–8 years of total experience in data engineering, data integration, Big Data, Data Warehouse, cloud data platform (GCP), or digital technology delivery.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on experience in data integration architecture, ETL/ELT development, cloud data platform implementation (GCP), DWH/data mart development, or large-scale data pipeline delivery.
  • Strong experience in managing end-to-end project delivery for telecom operator, enterprise data platform, or complex digital technology environment.
  • Experience working with Agile delivery and/or structured project management methodology, including planning, estimation, risk management, delivery tracking, and production readiness.
  • Experience with data governance, data quality, metadata, lineage, security/privacy, observability, and cost optimization / FinOps practices is preferred.

Working knowledge of AI/ML, advanced analytics, and real-time analytics use cases is an advantage.

 

Skills:

The role is expected to have sufficient hands-on technical depth to review, guide, and challenge engineering implementation, while primarily focusing on architecture ownership, technical governance, delivery assurance, and continuous improvement of enterprise data integration capabilities.

 

General Skillset:

  1. Strong understanding of telecommunications business processes, enterprise IT landscape, data-driven business operations, and the role of data platforms in supporting commercial, finance, network, customer, digital, and regulatory use cases.
  2. Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving capability to translate business problems into data integration requirements, architecture decisions, delivery plans, risks, dependencies, and measurable outcomes.
  3. Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, negotiation, and communication skills to work effectively with business users, BI teams, data governance, enterprise architects, IT project owners, security, operations, vendors, consultants, and system integrators.

 

Must-have Skillset and Technology Expertise:

  1. Data Integration Architecture: Strong capability in integration pattern selection, batch/incremental/near-real-time pipeline design, interface specification, data exchange mechanism, orchestration design, dependency management, resiliency pattern, and production readiness review.
  2. ETL/ELT and Data Engineering: Hands-on experience designing, developing, reviewing, and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines using GCP Platform, SQL, Python, PySpark/Spark, shell scripting, Talend, IBM DataStage, Apache Nifi, DBT, and/or equivalent enterprise data integration tools.
  3. Cloud Data Platform and BigQuery: Strong knowledge of GCP data services, especially BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer / Apache Airflow, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Dataproc, IAM, service account management, monitoring, logging, and cloud networking concepts relevant to data platforms.
  4. Data Warehouse and Data Mart: Strong understanding of enterprise DWH, ODS, staging layer, data mart, dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schema, historical data handling, slowly changing dimensions, aggregation, semantic layer, reconciliation, and BI/reporting consumption patterns.
  5. SQL, Programming, and Troubleshooting: Strong capability in SQL, Python, PySpark/Spark, API integration concepts, code review, transformation logic assessment, query/job optimization, failure analysis, root cause investigation, and development standard definition.

Responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data integration architecture, data pipelines, data warehouse interfaces, data marts, and data exchange mechanisms between operational systems, analytical platforms, cloud platforms, and reporting/BI solutions.

 

Qualification:

Minimum Bachelor’s degree (S1) in Telecommunication, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or other relevant technical disciplines. Master’s degree or relevant professional certification in cloud/data engineering is an advantage.

Experience:

  • Minimum 5–8 years of total experience in data engineering, data integration, Big Data, Data Warehouse, cloud data platform (GCP), or digital technology delivery.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on experience in data integration architecture, ETL/ELT development, cloud data platform implementation (GCP), DWH/data mart development, or large-scale data pipeline delivery.
  • Strong experience in managing end-to-end project delivery for telecom operator, enterprise data platform, or complex digital technology environment.
  • Experience working with Agile delivery and/or structured project management methodology, including planning, estimation, risk management, delivery tracking, and production readiness.
  • Experience with data governance, data quality, metadata, lineage, security/privacy, observability, and cost optimization / FinOps practices is preferred.

Working knowledge of AI/ML, advanced analytics, and real-time analytics use cases is an advantage.

 

Skills:

The role is expected to have sufficient hands-on technical depth to review, guide, and challenge engineering implementation, while primarily focusing on architecture ownership, technical governance, delivery assurance, and continuous improvement of enterprise data integration capabilities.

 

General Skillset:

  1. Strong understanding of telecommunications business processes, enterprise IT landscape, data-driven business operations, and the role of data platforms in supporting commercial, finance, network, customer, digital, and regulatory use cases.
  2. Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving capability to translate business problems into data integration requirements, architecture decisions, delivery plans, risks, dependencies, and measurable outcomes.
  3. Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, negotiation, and communication skills to work effectively with business users, BI teams, data governance, enterprise architects, IT project owners, security, operations, vendors, consultants, and system integrators.

 

Must-have Skillset and Technology Expertise:

  1. Data Integration Architecture: Strong capability in integration pattern selection, batch/incremental/near-real-time pipeline design, interface specification, data exchange mechanism, orchestration design, dependency management, resiliency pattern, and production readiness review.
  2. ETL/ELT and Data Engineering: Hands-on experience designing, developing, reviewing, and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines using GCP Platform, SQL, Python, PySpark/Spark, shell scripting, Talend, IBM DataStage, Apache Nifi, DBT, and/or equivalent enterprise data integration tools.
  3. Cloud Data Platform and BigQuery: Strong knowledge of GCP data services, especially BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer / Apache Airflow, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Dataproc, IAM, service account management, monitoring, logging, and cloud networking concepts relevant to data platforms.
  4. Data Warehouse and Data Mart: Strong understanding of enterprise DWH, ODS, staging layer, data mart, dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schema, historical data handling, slowly changing dimensions, aggregation, semantic layer, reconciliation, and BI/reporting consumption patterns.
  5. SQL, Programming, and Troubleshooting: Strong capability in SQL, Python, PySpark/Spark, API integration concepts, code review, transformation logic assessment, query/job optimization, failure analysis, root cause investigation, and development standard definition.

title: Sr Officer-Business Governance Analyst
raw_description:
Role Purpose

The Business Governance Analyst acts as the governance control tower for the Indosat HiFi FTTH business, ensuring all operations and processes align with company policies, regulatory requirements, and strategic goals. The role connects commercial strategy, field execution (Isales and Direct Sales), system capabilities, and compliance to ensure smooth end-to-end operations. It focuses on standardizing processes, minimizing deviations and invalid subscriptions, and reducing operational leakages, while enabling consistent and scalable execution across all regions and partners.

 

Job Descriptions :

  1. Governance & Compliance

The Governance & Compliance function ensures that all FTTH operations are aligned with internal policies, SOPs, and regulatory requirements. It is responsible for maintaining and updating governance frameworks and guidelines, while continuously monitoring key processes such as subscription, installation, and billing to ensure adherence. The role also works closely with Risk, Legal, and Compliance teams to ensure consistent governance and regulatory alignment across the business.

  1. Process Standardization & Improvement.

The Process Standardization & Improvement function analyzes end-to-end FTTH processes, identifies gaps and inefficiencies, and drives improvements to enhance efficiency and customer experience, while ensuring field execution aligns with defined SOPs.

  1. Business Contract Management.

Manage the full contract lifecycle for FTTH strategic partners, from drafting to renewal, ensuring compliance with policies and regulations. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align contract terms with business needs, review key clauses to mitigate risks, and monitor contract performance. Maintain a centralized contract repository, track renewals and milestones, resolve risks and disputes, and provide regular status and compliance reporting.

  1. Audit & Control

The Audit & Control function conducts regular audits across FTTH operations, ensures proper documentation and audit trails, and follows up on findings to drive corrective actions.

  1. Risk Management

The Risk Management function identifies operational and compliance risks in FTTH processes, develops and monitors mitigation plans, and supports incident investigation and root cause analysis.

  1. Cross-functional Coordination

The Cross-functional Coordination function collaborates with Sales, Technical, Customer Operations, IT, and Finance teams to ensure governance alignment across FTTH delivery, and supports new product launches or commercial changes with proper governance readiness.

 

Requirements

 

Qualification & Experience

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Telecommunications, or related field
  • 3 – 6 years of experience in telecom, broadband, or governance/compliance roles
  • Strong understanding of FTTH business processes and lifecycle
  • Experience in process improvement, audit, or risk management is preferred
  • Strong analytical thinking
  • Good communication skills
  • Customer focused
  • Business/System Transformational excellence is preferable.

 

Skills:

 

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Good understanding of telecom operations (especially FTTH)
  • Data-driven mindset (Excel, SQL, BI tools is a plus)
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Attention to detail and strong governance mindset
  • Ability to work cross-functionally in a dynamic environment
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written, to interact with the team, business partners, advisors, and senior management.

Senior Software Engineer - Fullstack, Product (Pekanbaru)

Daftar Sekarang

Pekanbaru, Pekanbaru City, Riau, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full-Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Lead the development of responsive web applications (React, Angular, Vue), ensuring consistency in UX/UI and functionality.

Design, build, and maintain backend services in Go, delivering scalable, low-latency APIs that power web and mobile clients.

Architect scalable solutions across the full stack, ensuring maintainability, performance, and security while advocating for modular design patterns.

Mentor engineers in cross-platform development, backend design, code reviews, and testing strategies.

Partner with backend and infrastructure teams to design unified APIs (REST/GraphQL) and optimize data synchronization.

Champion Agile/Scrum rituals, refining sprint planning and retrospectives for cross-functional teams.

Monitor and troubleshoot production issues using analytics and observability tools.

Visit customers and collect user feedback to inform product improvements.

Contribute to technical innovation and optimization efforts across the stack.

Kualifikasi

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

10+ years of experience in web, and/or backend development.

Strong proficiency in

JavaScript/TypeScript

for frontend development.

Proficiency in

Go

for building backend services and APIs.

Solid understanding of RESTful API design and OpenAPI Specification; GraphQL experience is a plus.

Experience with scalable databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and data modeling.

Experience building CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Fastlane, etc.).

Knowledge of frontend and backend analytics and monitoring tools (e.g., Firebase, AppsFlyer, New Relic).

Experience with unit testing, automated testing, and TDD (Robot Framework is a plus).

Proficiency in Git and version control systems.

Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Excellent communication, teamwork, and collaboration abilities.

Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).

Willing to be placed in

Pekanbaru.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is a cutting-edge green digital agritech startup located in the heart of Jakarta. Our mission is to be the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the palm oil industry. Through our integrated end-to-end agri-platform, we create a win-win-win scenario for people, planet, and prosperity.

We provide integrated apps that connect the supply chain stakeholders in the palm oil industry (Mills, DO Agents, Smallholders, Harvesters, Drivers, etc.). Creating a digital ecosystem that essentially boosts their productivity with effortless work documentation, affordable yet original agri-inputs, and agronomist services.

Our commitment extends beyond providing innovative solutions; we aim to nurture every aspect of Indonesia's palm oil industry. By fostering growth and sustainability, we strive to bring positive change to the lives of individuals in the palm oil sector, one at a time.

title: Fullstack Engineer - Prototyping (Pekanbaru)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Fullstack Engineer - Prototyping (Pekanbaru)

Daftar Sekarang

Pekanbaru, Pekanbaru City, Riau, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Contract

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

We are looking for a Full Stack Developer who can build scalable web applications while also being able to quickly translate business and product requirements into functional prototypes and technical solutions.

This role is suitable for someone who enjoys working across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, system architecture, and product experimentation. You will not only be responsible for writing production-quality code, but also for validating ideas quickly through prototypes using tools such as Replit, Lovable, and other AI-assisted development tools.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and maintain end-to-end web applications, covering frontend, backend, API, database, and third-party integrations.

Translate business requirements, product requirements, and user problems into practical technical solutions.

Build rapid functional prototypes and MVPs using tools such as Replit, Lovable, AI coding assistants, and other modern development platforms.

Convert prototypes into production-ready applications when the product has been validated.

Design and implement REST APIs, database structures, authentication, authorization, and system integrations.

Develop responsive and user-friendly interfaces with consideration for mobile-first and low-bandwidth environments.

Evaluate technical trade-offs between speed, scalability, maintainability, cost, and complexity.

Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Business Teams, and other Engineers to iterate on product solutions.

Build proof-of-concepts and experiments to validate product assumptions before investing in full production development.

Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and determine when a prototype should evolve into a custom-built system.

Ensure applications are reliable, secure, maintainable, and properly documented.

Debug and troubleshoot issues across the frontend, backend, database, API, and deployment environments.

Beyond coding skills, the candidate is expected to demonstrate:

Understand what problem is being solved before deciding what to build.

Break down ambiguous business problems into clear technical and product requirements.

Identify assumptions and determine which assumptions need to be validated first.

Design practical experiments or MVPs to validate ideas quickly.

Understand the difference between a prototype, MVP, and production system.

Make pragmatic decisions about when to use an existing tool versus building a custom solution.

Kualifikasi

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

3 to 5+ years of experience in Full Stack Development or a similar software engineering role.

Strong knowledge of frontend and backend development.

Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React.js, Next.js, Vue.js, or Angular.​

Experience with backend technologies such as Node.js, TypeScript, Python, Java, or Go.​

Good understanding of APIs, databases, authentication, Git, testing, and debugging.​ Experience integrating third-party APIs and services.​

Able to quickly build prototypes using Replit, Lovable, or similar AI-assisted development tools.​

Able to understand, debug, and improve AI-generated code.

Willing to be placed in Pekanbaru, Riau.

Preferred

• Experience building MVPs, prototypes, or 0→1 products.​

• Familiarity with Replit, Lovable, Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools.​

• Experience with cloud platforms, Docker, or CI/CD.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the Palm Oil industry. SawitPRO develops an integrated end-to-end agri-platform, creating a win-win-win for people, planet and profit. Our missions are to improve the livelihood of Indonesia’s smallholders, to unlock value for the industry, and to strive in a demanding global market in traceability and sustainability of palm oil products.

We provide platforms that connect the supply chain stakeholders within the palm oil industry (i.e. Palm Oil Mills, Agents, Smallholders, and Agri Input vendors), create a digital ecosystem that removes friction points, and essentially boosts the productivity of the smallholders via access to affordable yet high quality agro-inputs, agronomic services, and high-quality planting materials.

We envision to be the game-changer that improves smallholders’ living standard, and helps our planet to meet the growing global demand for sustainable palm oil.

title: Searah Muara Bakau - ICT Field Engineer (Offshore)
raw_description:
Searah is a leading independent integrated energy company in Southeast Asia, established in 2026 through the strategic partnership between Eni and PETRONAS. With a current asset base of 19 assets across Malaysia and Indonesia, Searah stands as one of the leading players in the Asia Pacific energy sector. In Indonesia, Searah Muara Bakau serves as one of Searah’s operating companies. Its operations span the exploration, development, and production of offshore natural gas resources, with a strong focus on the deepwater areas of the Kutei Basin in the Makassar Strait, contributing to energy security across Southeast Asia and the sustainable development of the communities where it operates.


We are looking for qualified personnel with high motivation, initiative, and integrity to fill the following position:


Job Title: ICT Field Engineer


Purpose 

Responsible for delivery of excellent ICT quality service and ensure the continuing functionality of all ICT infrastructure equipment to support daily operational activities and to meet business operational requirements respecting Company Standard Control especially in field area (FPSO)


Main Accountabilities and Responsibilities 

Technical: 

  • Performs a wide variety of installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of IT System (hardware and software) and Telecommunication system (PAGA, CCTV, Microwave, VSAT, Trunking Radio, Marine Radio, Aeronautical Radio, WiMAX, Entertainment System, GMDSS, etc.) in both offshore and onshore facilities 
  • Provides investigation, diagnostic testing and repair/resolution of system, hardware, software and infrastructure. 
  • Manages and continuously improves/enhances the operations of existing IT and Telecom infrastructure  
  • Manage all equipment usage according to Indonesia Body Telecom Regulator (KEMNKOMINFO, HUBLA, HUBDA) 
  • Manages company assets 
  • Manages System documentation 
  • Provide user support for general IT matters 


Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ): 

  • Comply with rules and standards described in Company Policies, HSE Integrated Management System and Procedures 
  • Report all incidents 
  • Motivate staff and colleagues to comply with HSE rules and standards 
  • Participate in HSE related initiatives
raw_requirements:
Qualifications & Experience 

  • Education: Minimum Bachelor Degree in Computer or Telecommunication engineering or equivalent technical subjects from accredited institutions 
  • Professional Qualification: Minimum 5 years of working experience in similar position, preferably in Oil & Gas industries 
  • Certification, Training and Courses:  
    • HSE Awareness 
    • System Administration 
    • Employee induction program 
    • Basic Sea Survival & HUET  
    • Radio Operator 
  • Language: Proficient in English and Bahasa Indonesia 


 


Required Competencies 

Technical Competencies 

  • Updated general knowledge of enterprise scale infrastructure systems technology 
  • Excellent working knowledge of up-to-date desktop applications 
  • Understanding government or law regulation of Telecom system 
  • Well versed in at least one or more systems below: 
  • Server Operating System  
  • LAN & WAN System 
  • Office, Business and Technical Applications 
  • Wireless Radio Communication Systems (Microwave, VSAT, WiMAX, Conventional/Trunk Radio, Telecom Tower, etc.) 
  • Navigation Systems (Marine and Aeronautical) 
  • Security Systems (PAGA, CCTV and Access Control) 
  • Entertainment System 
  • IP Telephony and Video Conference System 
  • Industrial Control System Security (PLC / SCADA / DCS) 


Non-Technical Competencies 

  • Problem-solving
  • Ability to multi-task in a company environment.  
  • Team player with good discipline and positive work attitude as well as independently. 
  • Ability to communicate in an understandable, polite and friendly manner both written and verbal. 


Working Conditions 

  • Location: Offshore (FPSO), Indonesia 
  • Possibility for business travel to other Company’s premises or field areas

title: Otopprentice Information & Technology / Intern - AOP
raw_description:
IT Apps Manufacturing

  1. Membantu Tim Developer dalam pengembangan API untuk proyek Digisprint.
  2. Membantu pembuatan dan pengembangan dashboard proyek Digisprint.
  3. Mendukung proses pengembangan aplikasi bersama Tim Developer.

AR/VR Developer

  1. Membantu merancang mengembangkan dan menguji aplikasi AR/VR untuk kebutuhan manufaktur seperti instruksi kerja digital pelatihan operator dan panduan pemeliharaan.
  2. Mengembangkan dan memelihara aplikasi pendukung berbasis Android/web menggunakan Kotlin Flutter atau framework terkait.
  3. Menyiapkan dan mengoptimalkan aset 3D agar dapat berjalan dengan baik pada perangkat AR/VR dan perangkat mobile.
  4. Mengintegrasikan aplikasi AR/VR dan AI Camera dengan layanan backend API serta data IoT.
  5. Melakukan pengujian perbaikan bug dan peningkatan performa aplikasi termasuk uji coba langsung bersama pengguna di Plant 1/Plant 2 serta menyusun dokumentasi teknis dan laporan perkembangan proyek.
raw_requirements:
IT Apps Manufacturing

  1. Mahasiswa AKTIF S-1 Informatika semester akhir.
  2. Menguasai pemrograman web menggunakan .NET dan pengembangan API.
  3. Memiliki kemampuan analitis dan pemecahan masalah yang baik serta mampu bekerja sama dalam tim.
  4. Bersedia magang secara WFO di Astra Otoparts Head Office, Jakarta Utara.

AR/VR Developer

  1. Mahasiswa AKTIF tingkat akhir jurusan Teknologi Informasi, Sistem Informasi, Teknik Informatika, Teknik Mesin, atau bidang terkait.
  2. Memiliki ketertarikan yang kuat pada AR/VR AI Camera (Computer Vision) atau pengembangan aplikasi.
  3. Pengalaman proyek kampus menjadi nilai tambah.
  4. Memiliki pengetahuan dasar pemrograman seperti C# Kotlin PHP atau Python.
  5. Memiliki rasa ingin tahu dan kemauan belajar yang tinggi terhadap tools seperti Unity, Unreal Engine, OpenCV, atau YOLO.
  6. Bersedia mengikuti program magang selama 6 bulan secara WFO di Astra Komponen Indonesia, Bogor.

title: IT Infrastructure & Network - TN
raw_description:
1. Melakukan pemeliharaan dan monitoring infrastruktur IT, konektivitas jaringan, layanan cloud, serta sistem keamanan untuk memastikan operasional IT berjalan secara andal dan aman.
  2. Mendukung administrasi, konfigurasi, dan troubleshooting Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, perangkat jaringan, VPN, manajemen identitas, serta solusi keamanan endpoint.
  3. Melakukan troubleshooting infrastruktur, menyusun dokumentasi teknis, dan mendukung perbaikan berkelanjutan untuk meningkatkan keandalan layanan IT, keamanan, dan efisiensi operasional.
raw_requirements:
1. Pendidikan minimal S1/D4 Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, Teknologi Informasi, atau jurusan terkait.
  2. IPK minimal 3,00 (skala 4,00).
  3. Memahami layanan Microsoft Azure, termasuk Virtual Machine (VM), Virtual Network (VNet), Network Security Group (NSG), Azure Backup, dan Azure Monitor.
  4. Memahami dasar konfigurasi dan troubleshooting jaringan, termasuk perangkat Cisco, Huawei, atau Ruijie, serta VPN dan Microsoft Entra ID.
  5. Memahami dasar penggunaan PowerShell untuk administrasi sistem dan troubleshooting.
  6. Memiliki pengetahuan mengenai Microsoft 365, Microsoft Defender, Exchange, atau pengelolaan antivirus menjadi nilai tambah.
  7. Memiliki kemampuan analisis, pemecahan masalah, dan penyusunan dokumentasi teknis yang baik.
  8. Mampu berkomunikasi dalam bahasa Inggris, baik lisan maupun tulisan.

title: Technology & Infrastructure Trainee - UT Trainee
raw_description:
Mulai perjalanan karier Anda bersama United Tractors melalui United Tractors Trainee Program.

United Tractors Trainee menawarkan kesempatan bagi fresh graduate dan young talents untuk mengeksplorasi peluang karier di United Tractors. Melalui program ini, trainee akan mendapatkan pengalaman pembelajaran yang terstruktur, exposure kerja secara langsung, penugasan proyek, serta mentoring dari para profesional dan leader berpengalaman di United Tractors. Program ini juga memberikan kesempatan untuk memperoleh exposure yang lebih luas terhadap ekosistem Mining Solutions & Heavy Equipment (MSHE).


  1. Mengawasi dan memelihara seluruh aspek infrastruktur IT perusahaan, termasuk performa sistem, health monitoring, dan proses backup otomatis.
  2. Memastikan seluruh sistem IT berjalan lancar dan andal, termasuk jaringan, hardware, server, dan layanan IT.
  3. Mengelola operasional data center dan information security, mencakup sistem kelistrikan, kontrol akses, server, database, proses backup, dan preventive maintenance.
  4. Melakukan Quality Assurance (QA) sistem untuk memastikan aspek keamanan, performa, dan kapasitas telah sesuai dengan kebutuhan.
  5. Berperan sebagai L2 support untuk kendala yang berkaitan dengan infrastruktur.
  6. Merencanakan dan mengelola capacity planning serta disaster recovery.
  7. Berkontribusi dalam pengembangan dan continuous improvement terhadap kebijakan, standar, dan skalabilitas infrastruktur Departemen IT.
raw_requirements:
1. Fresh graduate atau kandidat dengan pengalaman kerja maksimal 2 tahun di bidang System Administrator, IT Operations, Cloud, Network, atau IT Infrastructure.
  2. Minimal S1 Sistem Informasi, Ilmu Komputer, Teknik Komputer, Software Engineering, atau Teknik Informatika.
  3. IPK minimal 3,25.
  4. Memiliki pemahaman yang baik terkait sistem dan infrastruktur IT.
  5. Memiliki pengetahuan teknis yang kuat terkait network dan server operating system.
  6. Memiliki pengetahuan terkait konsep dan platform cloud computing, serta dasar-dasar data security dan cyber security.
  7. Bersedia ditempatkan di cabang/site United Tractors di seluruh Indonesia.

Pelajari programnya disini: https://untr.id/d/HandbookUTJobFair

title: Data Analyst - MODA
raw_description:
1. Mengidentifikasi sumber data yang relevan, mengumpulkan data yang dibutuhkan, serta melengkapi data yang hilang atau tidak lengkap dari sistem internal dan eksternal.
  2. Melakukan pembersihan, validasi, dan persiapan data untuk memastikan akurasi, konsistensi, dan kemudahan penggunaan data.
  3. Mengorganisir dan menyusun data mentah ke dalam format yang siap digunakan untuk analisis dan pelaporan.
  4. Menganalisis dataset untuk menjawab pertanyaan bisnis tertentu dan menghasilkan insight yang dapat ditindaklanjuti.
  5. Mengidentifikasi tren, pola, dan anomali dalam data untuk mendukung pengambilan keputusan berbasis data.
  6. Mengembangkan visualisasi data, dashboard, dan laporan analitis menggunakan tools yang sesuai.
  7. Menyiapkan dan mempresentasikan laporan analisis serta dashboard kepada manajemen eksekutif dan tim proyek.
  8. Melakukan pelatihan dan sesi knowledge sharing, termasuk menyusun materi pelatihan serta mendukung tim lain dalam memahami struktur data dan konsep visualisasi.
raw_requirements:
1. Pendidikan minimal S1 di bidang Sistem Informasi, Ilmu Komputer, Statistik, Matematika, atau bidang terkait.
  2. Memiliki pengalaman kerja minimal 2 tahun sebagai Data Analyst atau posisi lain yang berfokus pada data.
  3. Memiliki kemampuan organisasi, manajemen waktu, penentuan prioritas, dan multitasking yang baik dengan tingkat ketelitian yang tinggi.
  4. Mahir menggunakan Power BI, termasuk data modeling, DAX, pembuatan dashboard, publikasi laporan, dan pengaturan refresh data.
  5. Menguasai Microsoft Excel tingkat lanjut, termasuk Pivot Table, Power Query, formula lanjutan (INDEX-MATCH/XLOOKUP, array formulas), serta Macro.
  6. Memiliki kemampuan SQL yang kuat (GoogleSQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, atau sejenisnya) untuk query kompleks, ekstraksi, dan transformasi data.
  7. Berpengalaman dalam proses integrasi data; memiliki pemahaman integrasi data SAP melalui SAP GUI menjadi nilai tambah.
  8. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik serta mampu menjelaskan hasil analisis kepada stakeholder non-teknis.

title: Staff-Tech. Planning & Development
raw_description:
Role Purpose

As a Staff-Tech Planning & Development professional within the CX Tech Planning & Project Tracking unit, this role will lead the hands-on development, configuration, and end-to-end delivery of customer experience automation and A.I initiatives. The role combines technical expertise with strong project execution, connecting core platforms such as Siebel CRM, Salesforce Service Cloud, and RPA with customer-facing solutions including A.I Agent Assist, A.I Copilot, Social Media Automation, Voice A.I, Self-Service Portals, Semantic Search, and automated Knowledge Bases.

 

Working closely with IT, Martech, Product, Finance, and Business Process teams, this role will turn customer and business needs into practical, scalable digital solutions. This role will directly improve how frontline agents work and how customers access support by rapidly building, testing, and deploying solutions that increase efficiency, enable self-service, and improve the overall customer experience. 

 

Staff-Tech Planning & Development is responsible to identify, evaluate, and propose new technologies and AI solutions to enhance the customer experience. Conduct research, analyze data, and support the development of innovation proposals, pilots, and Proofs of Concept. Support day-to-day project enablement for technology and digital initiatives, including stakeholder coordination, milestone and dependency tracking, risk and issue escalation, and the transition of validated solutions from POC or pilot into implementation. Work closely with cross-functional teams to gather insights and contribute to digital innovation within the customer experience organization. This role is also responsible to apply responsible-AI and data-protection considerations to technology and AI use cases, in line with UU PDP No. 27/2022 and internal policy.

Minimum Requirements

Education & Background:

  • Bachelor's degree (S1) in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Data/A.I, Business Administration with a technology focus, or a related field
  • Minimum 1-3 years of experience in an analytical role, preferably with exposure to technology research, data analysis, or digital initiative implementation; experience in the telecom industry is a plus. Fresh Graduate with Internship, apprenticeship, or substantial final-project experience in technology or digital initiatives may be counted toward this requirement.
  • Working or internship experience within a digital start-up or fast-paced digital environment is highly preferred

Technical Proficiency

  • Working proficiency in SQL and at least one scripting language (e.g. Python or JavaScript/Node.js), sufficient to query data, automate routine tasks, and prototype simple internal tools with understanding of REST API, JSON, webhooks, system integration, and data flow.
  • Working experience with a cloud CRM platform (e.g. Salesforce.com, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or equivalent), including day-to-day configuration or administration support; a practitioner certification such as Salesforce ADM 201 will be a plus.
  • Basic understanding of software development principles and methodologies, with the ability to develop and deploy simple internal applications or scripts to address specific operational challenges or create workarounds
  • Familiarity with API integration concepts, cloud service models (SaaS / PaaS), common integration patterns, and data flows, sufficient to assess vendor solutions and communicate requirements to technical teams
  • Fundamental understanding of AI/ML concepts, specifically Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Semantic Search, and Conversational Voice/Chatbot frameworks. Including and not limited to generative AI, LLM, AI Agent/Agent Assist, Prompt Engineering, Voice AI, Semantic Search, and AI-powered Knowledge Base.
  • Practical experience using generative AI tools in a work or academic context (e.g. prompt design, summarization, drafting, first-pass analysis), together with a realistic understanding of their limitations
  • Working familiarity with a data visualization or BI tool (e.g. Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio), and with spreadsheet-based estimation of benefits, costs, and ROI
  • Exposure to workflow automation or low-code platforms (e.g. Power Automate, n8n, or equivalent) used to digitalize manual processes.

Project Management Proficiency

  • Working proficiency in Bahasa Indonesia and English, sufficient to document requirements and present findings to both business and technical audiences
  • Understanding of Digital Transformation principles and their application within a customer service organization, including how technology can reshape customer interactions and operational processes
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum fundamentals: backlog management, user stories, sprint planning, stand-ups, UAT, retrospectives, and release management.
  • Familiarity with Git/GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Postman, monday.com or equivalent delivery tools.
  • Familiarity with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems and with digital communication channels relevant to customer service (e.g. mobile apps, messaging platforms, social media)
  • Ability to act as both Project Coordinator and Hands-on Builder, moving from requirement → design → development/configuration → testing → deployment → measurement.
  • Basic understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices is highly desirable.
  • Ability to translate complex business processes and SOPs into technical user stories while collaborating across IT, Marketing, Product, Finance, and Customer Care operations.
  • Basic understanding of contact center and digital channel technology — IVR, chatbot and voicebot, omnichannel routing, and knowledge management — and of the operational metrics they influence (AHT, FCR, self-service containment, CSAT).
  • Awareness of data privacy and responsible-AI obligations affecting customer data, including UU PDP No. 27/2022, and of why human oversight is required in AI-assisted customer journeys
  • Basic understanding of project management methodologies and principles (e.g. Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches), and familiarity with at least one project or work tracking tool (e.g. Jira, Asana, Trello, or Microsoft Planner)
  • Exposure to workflow automation or low-code platforms (e.g. Power Automate, n8n, or equivalent) used to digitalize manual processes
  • Conversational Voice/Chatbot frameworks. Including and not limited to generative AI, LLM, AI Agent/Agent Assist, Prompt Engineering, Voice AI, Semantic Search, and AI-powered Knowledge Base.

Secondary Competency

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret data and identify trends
  • Excellent research and information-gathering skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly and concisely
  • Passion for emerging technologies, particularly Artificial Intelligence (AI), and their application in customer experience
  • Ability to translate operational and customer pain points into process flows, requirements, and acceptance criteria with measurable success indicators
  • Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team and to coordinate across business, technology, and operations stakeholders
  • Ability to support change and adoption activities, including communication, training, adoption tracking, and post-implementation stabilization
  • Learning agility and adaptability actively builds new knowledge as technologies and tools change, and adjusts approach when priorities, requirements, or platforms shift
  • Possess self-initiative and able to work independently and collaboratively with people at various levels
  • Good time management and organizational skills arranges tasks in order of priority, manages preparations and schedules, and stays focused to keep on track
  • Comfortable working across business and technology teams and translating business requirements into user stories, process flows, functional requirements, and technical solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to multitask across multiple projects, manage priorities, document progress, and meet delivery timelines.
  • Strong customer-centric mindset with an understanding of Digital Customer Experience and service journey principles.
  • Willingness and ability to continuously self-learn emerging technologies, particularly AI, automation, CRM, and digital CX technologies.

Working closely with IT, Martech, Product, Finance, and Business Process teams, this role will turn customer and business needs into practical, scalable digital solutions. This role will directly improve how frontline agents work and how customers access support by rapidly building, testing, and deploying solutions that increase efficiency, enable self-service, and improve the overall customer experience. 

 

Staff-Tech Planning & Development is responsible to identify, evaluate, and propose new technologies and AI solutions to enhance the customer experience. Conduct research, analyze data, and support the development of innovation proposals, pilots, and Proofs of Concept. Support day-to-day project enablement for technology and digital initiatives, including stakeholder coordination, milestone and dependency tracking, risk and issue escalation, and the transition of validated solutions from POC or pilot into implementation. Work closely with cross-functional teams to gather insights and contribute to digital innovation within the customer experience organization. This role is also responsible to apply responsible-AI and data-protection considerations to technology and AI use cases, in line with UU PDP No. 27/2022 and internal policy.

Minimum Requirements

Education & Background:

  • Bachelor's degree (S1) in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Data/A.I, Business Administration with a technology focus, or a related field
  • Minimum 1-3 years of experience in an analytical role, preferably with exposure to technology research, data analysis, or digital initiative implementation; experience in the telecom industry is a plus. Fresh Graduate with Internship, apprenticeship, or substantial final-project experience in technology or digital initiatives may be counted toward this requirement.
  • Working or internship experience within a digital start-up or fast-paced digital environment is highly preferred

Technical Proficiency

  • Working proficiency in SQL and at least one scripting language (e.g. Python or JavaScript/Node.js), sufficient to query data, automate routine tasks, and prototype simple internal tools with understanding of REST API, JSON, webhooks, system integration, and data flow.
  • Working experience with a cloud CRM platform (e.g. Salesforce.com, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or equivalent), including day-to-day configuration or administration support; a practitioner certification such as Salesforce ADM 201 will be a plus.
  • Basic understanding of software development principles and methodologies, with the ability to develop and deploy simple internal applications or scripts to address specific operational challenges or create workarounds
  • Familiarity with API integration concepts, cloud service models (SaaS / PaaS), common integration patterns, and data flows, sufficient to assess vendor solutions and communicate requirements to technical teams
  • Fundamental understanding of AI/ML concepts, specifically Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Semantic Search, and Conversational Voice/Chatbot frameworks. Including and not limited to generative AI, LLM, AI Agent/Agent Assist, Prompt Engineering, Voice AI, Semantic Search, and AI-powered Knowledge Base.
  • Practical experience using generative AI tools in a work or academic context (e.g. prompt design, summarization, drafting, first-pass analysis), together with a realistic understanding of their limitations
  • Working familiarity with a data visualization or BI tool (e.g. Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio), and with spreadsheet-based estimation of benefits, costs, and ROI
  • Exposure to workflow automation or low-code platforms (e.g. Power Automate, n8n, or equivalent) used to digitalize manual processes.

Project Management Proficiency

  • Working proficiency in Bahasa Indonesia and English, sufficient to document requirements and present findings to both business and technical audiences
  • Understanding of Digital Transformation principles and their application within a customer service organization, including how technology can reshape customer interactions and operational processes
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum fundamentals: backlog management, user stories, sprint planning, stand-ups, UAT, retrospectives, and release management.
  • Familiarity with Git/GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Postman, monday.com or equivalent delivery tools.
  • Familiarity with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems and with digital communication channels relevant to customer service (e.g. mobile apps, messaging platforms, social media)
  • Ability to act as both Project Coordinator and Hands-on Builder, moving from requirement → design → development/configuration → testing → deployment → measurement.
  • Basic understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices is highly desirable.
  • Ability to translate complex business processes and SOPs into technical user stories while collaborating across IT, Marketing, Product, Finance, and Customer Care operations.
  • Basic understanding of contact center and digital channel technology — IVR, chatbot and voicebot, omnichannel routing, and knowledge management — and of the operational metrics they influence (AHT, FCR, self-service containment, CSAT).
  • Awareness of data privacy and responsible-AI obligations affecting customer data, including UU PDP No. 27/2022, and of why human oversight is required in AI-assisted customer journeys
  • Basic understanding of project management methodologies and principles (e.g. Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches), and familiarity with at least one project or work tracking tool (e.g. Jira, Asana, Trello, or Microsoft Planner)
  • Exposure to workflow automation or low-code platforms (e.g. Power Automate, n8n, or equivalent) used to digitalize manual processes
  • Conversational Voice/Chatbot frameworks. Including and not limited to generative AI, LLM, AI Agent/Agent Assist, Prompt Engineering, Voice AI, Semantic Search, and AI-powered Knowledge Base.

Secondary Competency

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret data and identify trends
  • Excellent research and information-gathering skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly and concisely
  • Passion for emerging technologies, particularly Artificial Intelligence (AI), and their application in customer experience
  • Ability to translate operational and customer pain points into process flows, requirements, and acceptance criteria with measurable success indicators
  • Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team and to coordinate across business, technology, and operations stakeholders
  • Ability to support change and adoption activities, including communication, training, adoption tracking, and post-implementation stabilization
  • Learning agility and adaptability actively builds new knowledge as technologies and tools change, and adjusts approach when priorities, requirements, or platforms shift
  • Possess self-initiative and able to work independently and collaboratively with people at various levels
  • Good time management and organizational skills arranges tasks in order of priority, manages preparations and schedules, and stays focused to keep on track
  • Comfortable working across business and technology teams and translating business requirements into user stories, process flows, functional requirements, and technical solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to multitask across multiple projects, manage priorities, document progress, and meet delivery timelines.
  • Strong customer-centric mindset with an understanding of Digital Customer Experience and service journey principles.
  • Willingness and ability to continuously self-learn emerging technologies, particularly AI, automation, CRM, and digital CX technologies.

title: ML Ops Engineers
raw_description:
Role Overview

As a Senior AI/MLOps Engineer specializing in ML Pipeline & Platform Engineering, you will play a pivotal role in scaling Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison's AI and data intelligence capabilities across our digital ecosystem. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end design, automation, and operational management of high-throughput machine learning pipelines and cloud platform environments on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will empower data scientists and AI engineers by building robust CI/CD deployment automation, optimizing high-scale BigQuery workflows, enforcing zero-trust platform security guardrails, and supporting emerging Agentic AI platform integrations to accelerate Indonesia's digital transformation.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

  • Architect and Operate ML Pipelines: Design, build, compile, and maintain enterprise-grade Kubeflow Pipelines (KFP) and Vertex AI Pipelines for automated training, evaluation, continuous batch inference, and automated retraining.
  • Optimize High-Scale Data Workflows: Engineer and optimize large-scale BigQuery data extraction, partitioned and clustered dataset transformations, and automated data pipelines handling multi-million row operational datasets.
  • Drive Platform Provisioning & Governance: Review Architectural Requirement Specifications (ARS) and execute infrastructure provisioning across GCP services (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Spanner, Cloud Storage, and GKE).
  • Enforce Platform Security & Guardrails: Implement least-privileged Identity & Access Management (IAM), per-pipeline service account bindings, and VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC) perimeters to prevent unauthorized data access and egress leaks.
  • Champion Blast Radius Governance: Conduct comprehensive pre-deployment verification checklists for IAM policies, dependencies, and external partner integrations to guarantee zero service disruption.
  • Standardize CI/CD Automation: Build and maintain reusable GitLab CI/CD runner pipelines for pipeline compilation, automated testing, container image packaging, and progressive environment promotion.
  • Secure AI Tooling & Developer Harnesses: Establish security guardrails and governance policies for internal AI tooling, CLI assistants, and IDE developer harnesses, ensuring secret isolation, token sanitization, and auditability.
  • Support Emerging Agentic AI Integrations: Enable operational runtime configurations and backend service connectivity for Agentic AI frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, and conversational agent deployments.
  • Lead Technical Problem Resolution: Troubleshoot complex container dependency builds, private package repository configurations (Google Artifact Registry), and runtime environment discrepancies across Workbench and Cloud Build runners.
  • Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Data Governance, Cloud Operations, Enterprise Security, and external technology partners to ensure platform compliance, high availability, and rapid time-to-market.

 

 

Qualification

Professional Experience & Technical Qualifications

 

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience: Minimum 5+ years of total experience in software, data, or ML engineering, with at least 3+ years of dedicated hands-on experience in MLOps, DataOps, or DevOps within enterprise production environments.
  • Cloud & Big Data Mastery:
    • Deep operational expertise with Google Cloud Platform, specifically Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, IAM, and VPC Service Controls.
    • Strong experience in BigQuery performance tuning, partitioning, clustering, and stored procedures.
  • ML Pipeline & Orchestration:
    • Proven track record of designing, building, compiling, and monitoring production Kubeflow Pipelines (KFP) or Vertex AI Pipelines.
    • Deep familiarity with model registry workflows, artifact versioning, and lifecycle management.
  • Programming & Automation:
    • Expert-level proficiency in Python, including object-oriented programming, packaging, data structures, and cloud SDK integrations.
    • Strong foundation in Linux environments and shell scripting.
  • DevOps & CI/CD Tooling:
    • Hands-on expertise building enterprise CI/CD workflows using GitLab CI/CD, Docker containerization, Helm, and GitOps methodologies.
    • Experience managing private package repositories using Google Artifact Registry.
  • Security & Governance Acumen:
    • Practical experience securing day-to-day engineering AI harnesses, managing service account tokens, and implementing Data Loss Prevention (DLP) best practices.
  • Certifications:
    • Google Cloud Certified Professional Machine Learning Engineer (Preferred / Nice to have).
    • Google Cloud Certified Professional Data Engineer (Preferred / Nice to have).
    • Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Architect (Preferred / Nice to have).
  • Value-Add / Bonus Qualifications:
    • Experience with Agentic AI engineering frameworks (Google ADK, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or MCP servers).
    • Familiarity with RAG evaluation frameworks (such as Ragas or DeepEval) and vector databases.
    • Exposure to Cloud Spanner, Redis/Memorystore, or GraphDB integrations.

 

 

Behavioral Competencies

 

  • Problem-Solving Agility: Exceptional analytical and diagnostic skills with the ability to resolve complex infrastructure, pipeline, and security challenges under fast-paced operational conditions.
  • Proactive Ownership Mindset: High sense of accountability, initiative, and drive to transform operational lessons into scalable, automated standards.
  • Collaborative Communication: Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary squads, data science teams, and vendor partners.
  • Continuous Learning & Adaptability: Eagerness to stay ahead of the curve in emerging MLOps practices, GenAI platform engineering, and modern cloud technologies.

title: Point of Sales Platforms
raw_description:
ROLE PURPOSE

 

 

Lead the development, enhancement, integration, and operational excellence of Point of Sales (POS) applications within the Sales & Distribution ecosystem. Drive technology modernization, process automation, and AI-powered innovation to improve sales productivity, operational efficiency, system reliability, and user experience across all sales channels.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

A. POS Application Leadership & Ownership

  • Own the end-to-end POS application lifecycle, including architecture, development, configuration, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
  • Ensure POS applications support business requirements across sales channels, outlets, dealers, and distribution operations.
  • Drive application simplification, standardization, and modernization to support business transformation and system integration.
  • Define technical roadmaps, development priorities, and delivery plans aligned with Sales & Distribution business objectives.

B. Technical Development & Solution Engineering

  • Lead and actively participate in hands-on development, coding, debugging, configuration, and technical problem-solving.
  • Design scalable, secure, and high-performance application solutions using modern technologies and development practices.
  • Manage API development, middleware integration, database design, and connectivity with core systems and other enterprise applications.
  • Establish coding standards, conduct code reviews, and ensure compliance with IT architecture, security, and quality standards.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues and drive root cause analysis (RCA) and permanent corrective actions.

C. AI Development & Intelligent Automation

  • Develop and implement AI-powered solutions to improve POS capabilities, sales processes, and operational efficiency.
  • Build AI applications and services using appropriate AI models, APIs, frameworks, and enterprise data.
  • Explore and implement Generative AI and Agentic AI to automate repetitive tasks, accelerate development, and improve operational decision-making.
  • Develop AI-assisted monitoring, anomaly detection, predictive analysis, and intelligent incident management capabilities.
  • Identify opportunities to integrate AI into sales operations, outlet management, transaction monitoring, and user support.
  • Ensure AI solutions meet enterprise security, data privacy, governance, accuracy, and reliability requirements.

D. System Integration & Technology Modernization

  • Ensure seamless integration between POS and other Sales & Distribution systems, including outlet management, dealer management, sales applications, incentive systems, and enterprise platforms.
  • Drive API standardization, reusable services, and system interoperability across business applications.
  • Lead technology upgrades and migration initiatives to improve scalability, maintainability, and integration readiness.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, IT Operations, and external technology partners.

E. Service Reliability & Operational Excellence

  • Ensure POS application availability, performance, scalability, and transaction reliability.
  • Monitor application health, identify performance bottlenecks, and implement proactive monitoring and automation.
  • Lead incident resolution, problem management, and service improvement initiatives.
  • Establish service KPIs, technical documentation, disaster recovery readiness, and operational handover standards.

Required Technical Competencies

 

 

  • Strong knowledge of POS applications, sales distribution systems, and enterprise application architecture.
  • Hands-on software development skills in relevant programming languages and frameworks.
  • Experience in REST APIs, microservices, middleware, databases, and enterprise system integration.
  • Practical experience developing and deploying AI solutions, including Generative AI, LLM integration, or Agentic AI.
  • Knowledge of AI frameworks, prompt engineering, RAG, AI agents, and model/API integration.
  • Understanding of CI/CD, DevOps, automated testing, application security, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, observability tools, and AI-assisted monitoring is an advantage.

Leadership & Business Competencies

  • Strategic thinking and technology roadmap development.
  • Strong people leadership, coaching, and talent development.
  • Agile delivery and project management.
  • Stakeholder communication and vendor management.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making.
  • Ability to translate business challenges into scalable technology and AI solutions.
  • Strong ownership and accountability for delivery and production stability.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • POS application availability and transaction success rate.
  • Application performance and reduction in critical incidents.
  • On-time delivery of development projects and business requirements.
  • Number and business impact of AI solutions successfully implemented.
  • Productivity improvement and operational cost reduction through automation.
  • Reduction in manual processes and mean time to resolve incidents (MTTR).
  • Quality of system integration and successful technology modernization.
  • Team capability development and engineering quality improvement.

Minimum Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Significant experience in application development, enterprise systems, and IT solution delivery minimal 3 years
  • Proven experience leading technical teams and managing business-critical applications.
  • Demonstrated hands-on capability in software engineering and solution design.
  • Practical experience building or implementing AI-powered applications or automation solutions.
  • Experience managing  partners, budgets, projects, and cross-functional stakeholders.

title: Product Data Analyst (Pekanbaru)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Product Data Analyst (Pekanbaru)

Daftar Sekarang

Pekanbaru, Pekanbaru City, Riau, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full-Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Analyze user behavior and product performance metrics to provide actionable insights for product decisions and improvements.

Design and implement data tracking systems to measure key metrics across our platform.

Build and maintain clear dashboards to visualize KPIs for stakeholders.

Partner with product managers to identify opportunities and solve problems through data-driven approaches.

Run A/B tests to evaluate feature effectiveness and guide product iterations.

Create analytical models to predict user behavior and uncover growth opportunities within the palm oil supply chain.

Monitor and report on key business metrics focusing on smallholder productivity, supply chain efficiency, and sustainability outcomes.

Analyze agricultural data patterns to optimize product features for farmers and other stakeholders.

Provide business leaders with regular reports and custom analyses to inform strategic decisions.

Maintain clear documentation of data definitions, analysis methods, and insights to strengthen organizational knowledge.

Kualifikasi

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, or related field.

2+ years of experience in product analytics, business intelligence, or similar data-focused roles.

Strong SQL skills for complex data analysis.

Basic Python skills for data analysis and statistics.

Experience with data visualization tools (such as Tableau, PowerBI, or Looker).

Sharp analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities, with skill in turning data into actionable insights.

Understanding of statistical concepts and their practical applications.

Knowledge of product metrics and KPIs in digital platforms or marketplaces.

Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data insights clearly to non-technical audiences.

Experience in agritech, supply chain, or related industries is a plus.

Knowledge of Indonesian agriculture, especially palm oil, is beneficial but not required.

Willing to be placed in Pekanbaru, Riau.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the Palm Oil industry. SawitPRO develops an integrated end-to-end agri-platform, creating a win-win-win for people, planet and profit. Our missions are to improve the livelihood of Indonesia’s smallholders, to unlock value for the industry, and to strive in a demanding global market in traceability and sustainability of palm oil products.

We provide platforms that connect the supply chain stakeholders within the palm oil industry (i.e. Palm Oil Mills, Agents, Smallholders, and Agri Input vendors), create a digital ecosystem that removes friction points, and essentially boosts the productivity of the smallholders via access to affordable yet high quality agro-inputs, agronomic services, and high-quality planting materials.

We envision to be the game-changer that improves smallholders’ living standard, and helps our planet to meet the growing global demand for sustainable palm oil.

Daftar Sekarang

title: Software Engineer - Odoo Specialist, Product (Jakarta)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Software Engineer - Odoo Specialist, Product (Jakarta)

Daftar Sekarang

Jakarta, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Contract (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Lead and participate in various development projects for our products and services and be involved in all development-related aspects of our technical operations.

Architect and design application solutions for complex business requirements within the agricultural supply chain domain.

Develop and customise Python-based ERP solutions according to specifications, focusing on backend services, APIs, and data processing systems using any popular Python framework (Odoo preferred).

Integrate applications with server components and third-party services, including ERP systems and internal agricultural data platforms.

Perform system analysis, design, testing and documentation whenever necessary to ensure code quality and maintainability.

Implement unit testing and system integration following best practices in software development.

Maintain and enhance existing applications while solving complex performance and architectural challenges.

Provide technical support on on-call rotations and troubleshoot production issues.

Take initiatives for required changes in software development processes to manage overall quality and efficiency.

Kualifikasi

Possess at least a Bachelor's Degree, or Master's Degree in Computer Science / IT, Engineering (Computer/Telecommunication), or equivalent.

Possess at least 2 years working experience in Odoo development and deployment.

Strong knowledge of Python and programming concepts with proven expertise in developing scalable applications.

Complete understanding of Odoo framework and its basic flow, including:

Proven expertise in developing custom modules in Odoo

Deep knowledge of Odoo data models and ORM (Object-Relational Mapping)

Experience with latest versions of Odoo (v14, v15, v16+) and excellent debugging skills

Odoo techno-functional knowledge across core modules (Sales, Purchase, CRM, Accounts, Inventory, Fleet, HR, Payroll)

Odoo Integration and APIs:

Experience with Odoo External API and XML-RPC/JSON-RPC

Web services integration (REST and SOAP) with external systems

API development for third-party integrations

Experience in OpenAPI 3.0 is a plus

Experience working with Source Control (Git) and following best practices for version control and code collaboration.

Experience in working with Web services integration (REST and SOAP) and API's Response (JSON and XML). Experience in OpenAPI 3.0 is a plus.

Good discipline in writing unit tests and integration tests with testing frameworks like pytest.

Experience with cloud services such as GCP and/or AWS is a plus.

Knowledge of Linux operating systems and command-line tools.

Experience in Finance and Accounting.

Experience with data processing and analytics tools relevant to agricultural data management.

Willing to be on a 1-year contract.

Willing to undergo a 2-month onboarding period in Pekanbaru

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is a cutting-edge green digital agritech startup located in the heart of Jakarta. Our mission is to be the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the palm oil industry. Through our integrated end-to-end agri-platform, we create a win-win-win scenario for people, planet, and prosperity.

We provide integrated apps that connect the supply chain stakeholders in the palm oil industry (Mills, DO Agents, Smallholders, Harvesters, Drivers, etc.). Creating a digital ecosystem that essentially boosts their productivity with effortless work documentation, affordable yet original agri-inputs, and agronomist services.

Our commitment extends beyond providing innovative solutions; we aim to nurture every aspect of Indonesia's palm oil industry. By fostering growth and sustainability, we strive to bring positive change to the lives of individuals in the palm oil sector, one at a time.
