title: Business Intelligence Executive (Pekanbaru)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Business Intelligence Executive (Pekanbaru)

Daftar Sekarang

Pekanbaru, Pekanbaru City, Riau, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Contract (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Design and build automated internal applications (focusing on CRM and HRIS) utilizing Lark Base and workflow logic.

Maintain and troubleshoot the existing Lark ecosystem to ensure highly reliable and seamless daily operations.

Collaborate with stakeholders to map business processes and translate them into efficient Lark automations.

Write and optimize SQL queries to extract structured data from warehouses for robust analytical reporting.

Develop and manage executive-level KPI dashboards using BI platforms like Power BI, Looker Studio, or Metabase.

Conduct rigorous quality checks to guarantee uncompromising mathematical accuracy and flawless aggregations in all data outputs.

Kualifikasi

Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.

Minimum 1 year of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or a similar role.

Proficient in SQL and advanced Microsoft Excel.

Experience with BI and data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights.

Good communication and stakeholder management skills.

Familiarity with data warehousing, ETL processes, or Python is a plus.

Able to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Willing to be placed in Pekanbaru, Riau.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the Palm Oil industry. SawitPRO develops an integrated end-to-end agri-platform, creating a win-win-win for people, planet and profit. Our missions are to improve the livelihood of Indonesia’s smallholders, to unlock value for the industry, and to strive in a demanding global market in traceability and sustainability of palm oil products.

We provide platforms that connect the supply chain stakeholders within the palm oil industry (i.e. Palm Oil Mills, Agents, Smallholders, and Agri Input vendors), create a digital ecosystem that removes friction points, and essentially boosts the productivity of the smallholders via access to affordable yet high quality agro-inputs, agronomic services, and high-quality planting materials.

We envision to be the game-changer that improves smallholders’ living standard, and helps our planet to meet the growing global demand for sustainable palm oil.

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know Our Team

The Fulfilment Engineering team builds the technology that connects demand with supply across Grab’s services. We solve complex marketplace problems spanning allocation, driver experience, reliability and operational efficiency, supporting millions of transactions across Southeast Asia.

We work closely with Product, Data Science, Analytics, Operations and other engineering teams to develop scalable systems that improve the experience of our driver-partners and consumers.

Get to Know the Role

You will lead a team of software engineers responsible for building and operating critical fulfilment capabilities. You will create the conditions for the team to deliver reliable outcomes, grow strong technical leaders and translate product and business priorities into an effective engineering roadmap.

As an engineering manager, you will remain technically fluent while empowering senior individual contributors to lead architecture and detailed technical decisions.

You will report to the Senior Software Engineering Manager.

At Grab, we have 5-day in office arrangement.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

Lead, coach and develop a team of software engineers, setting clear expectations and individual growth plans.

Partner with Product, Data Science, Analytics and Operations to define priorities, roadmaps and measurable outcomes.

Own planning and delivery of the team’s engineering roadmap, proactively managing dependencies and risks.

Work with senior engineers to establish sound technical direction and make appropriate architecture and engineering trade-offs.

Improve the reliability, scalability, security, observability and cost efficiency of the systems owned by the team.

Establish effective engineering practices covering design reviews, testing, deployment, incident response and continuous improvement.

Create an inclusive environment where team members have clarity, psychological safety and meaningful ownership.

Attract, assess and retain strong engineering talent while contributing to hiring and talent development across Grab.

Communicate progress, risks and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
raw_description:
Senior Software Engineer, Backend

Team

Engineering

Location

Jakarta, Indonesia

Job Type

Full-time

The role at a glance

Skills you need

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know the Team

The Fulfilment tech family is one of the most important pillars ensuring Grab to out-serve our customers and partners in different businesses and marketplaces across Southeast Asia. We are working on high throughput, real-time distributed systems that use machine learning techniques to solve hundreds of millions of requests per day.

Our mission is to offer the best products and experiences to our driver partners as to increase adoption and engagement of our services. Improve driver partner opportunities and efficiency to fulfil customer orders without fail, rain or shine. And to create efficient marketplaces by determining a price that is both sustainable and loved by our partners and customers.

Our team members are in Indonesia and Singapore.

Get to Know the Role

We are seeking experienced and passionate Software Engineers to join our team. You will have opportunities to lead a small team of software engineers to work on multiple backend service clusters. It is very important that our team members to initiatively identify problems and have the right mindset and skills to solve them.

You will be reporting to Software Engineering Manager II, Backend and the role will be base onsite in our South Jakarta, Jakarta, Indonesia office.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

Develop and maintain backend services and APIs with a focus on reliability and scalability.

Write efficient database queries (e.g., MySQL, Presto) and optimize system performance through profiling and troubleshooting.

Contribute to projects on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and support deployments via CI/CD pipelines.

Implement and maintain automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end) to ensure code quality.

Gain exposure to distributed computing frameworks such as Apache Flink, while building services in Golang and Scala.

Collaborate with senior engineers and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality technical solutions.

Read more

Skills you need

What Essential Skills You Will Need

More than 4 years of experience in backend development.

title: Searah Muara Bakau - Security Asset Coordinator
raw_description:
Searah is a leading independent integrated energy company in Southeast Asia, established in 2026 through the strategic partnership between Eni and PETRONAS. With a current asset base of 19 assets across Malaysia and Indonesia, Searah stands as one of the leading players in the Asia Pacific energy sector. In Indonesia, Searah Muara Bakau serves as one of Searah’s operating companies. Its operations span the exploration, development, and production of offshore natural gas resources, with a strong focus on the deepwater areas of the Kutei Basin in the Makassar Strait, contributing to energy security across Southeast Asia and the sustainable development of the communities where it operates.


We are looking for qualified personnel with high motivation, initiative, and integrity to fill the following position:


Job Title: Security Asset Coordinator


Purpose:

 

To implement and maintaining effective security operations, procedures, and controls to safeguard company personnel, assets, and information. Ensures day-to-day coordination of security activities at operational sites and comply with company standards and regulatory requirements.


Main Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

 

·         Coordinate and monitor the company’s security management system in alignment with corporate policies and local regulations.

·         Identify security threats, assess possible risks and recommend mitigation strategies for identified threats.

·         Oversee physical security of company assets, offices, including onshore facility and offshore platforms.

·         Act as the first point of contact for security incidents.

·         Actively support in managing incident response, evidence collection, and preliminary investigations.

·         Liaise with government agencies, military, police, and local communities regarding security matters.

·         Manage the contractual of security personnel, ensuring performance meets company standard.

·         Supervise and coordinate activities of contracted security personnel

·         Coordinate evacuation, medical emergencies, and business continuity in case of major incidents.

·         Supports audits, inspections and internal reviews.

·         Build a strong security culture across the organization.

 

Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ):

·         Comply with rules and standards described in Company Policies, HSE Integrated Management System and Procedures

·         Report all incidents

·         Motivate staff and colleagues to comply with HSE rules and standards

·         Participate in HSE related initiatives
raw_requirements:
Qualifications & Experience:

 

·         Education: Minimum Bachelor degree in Criminology, Security Management or equivalent subjects.

 

·         Professional Qualification:

-      Minimum 5 years of professional security experience, with at least 5 years in a managerial role within Oil & Gas industry.

-      Background in law enforcement, military, or corporate security are preferred (ex-police/military officer, or have attended police/ military officer academy)

 

·         Certification, Training and Courses:

-      Employee Induction including HSE Awareness

 

Language: Proficient in English and Bahasa Indonesia


Technical Competencies

-      Strong knowledge of Oil & Gas operational environments.

-      Knowledge of organization processes; company/corporate organization, internal standards, site management.

-      Knowledge of information integrity system, information process support software.

-      Operational security management

-      Incident response and reporting

 

 

Non-Technical Competencies

-      Strong leadership

-      Strategic thinking

-      Problem solving

-      Teamwork

-      Decision making

-      Performance measurement

-      Communication

-      Negotiation



Working Conditions:


 - Possibility for business travel to other Company’s premises or field areas

title: Searah Muara Bakau - Electrical Technician (FPSO)
raw_description:
Searah is a leading independent integrated energy company in Southeast Asia, established in 2026 through the strategic partnership between Eni and PETRONAS. With a current asset base of 19 assets across Malaysia and Indonesia, Searah stands as one of the leading players in the Asia Pacific energy sector. In Indonesia, Searah Muara Bakau serves as one of Searah’s operating companies. Its operations span the exploration, development, and production of offshore natural gas resources, with a strong focus on the deepwater areas of the Kutei Basin in the Makassar Strait, contributing to energy security across Southeast Asia and the sustainable development of the communities where it operates.


We are looking for qualified personnel with high motivation, initiative, and integrity to fill the following position:


Job Title: Electrical Technician


Purpose:

To support the Electrical & Instrument operations in giving the Electrical advice and support to maximize the operation’s efficiency of Company's facilities and any other Projects.

Supervise electrical technicians in installing, troubleshooting, repairing and performing preventive maintenance of process instrumentation and safety systems on FPU/FPSO to ensure safe, efficient and dependable operation of equipment in order to achieve established production goals. Responsible for electrical switchgear, power generation and distribution systems, fixing the conduit, wiring and lighting, maintains process electric equipment  (Electric motors, MCCs, Soft Starter, , DC power distributions, AC & DC control panels, UPS, Battery chargers),  and electric utilities (HVAC, Electric appliance, PA Systems and emergency alarm systems etc) so that equipment will operate at all times in the manner for which it was designed and safety devices will sense out of limits conditions and cause appropriate alarms, partial shut-ins, and complete shut-ins

Electrical Technician activities will be conducted in safe manner with maximizing field production efficiency while minimizing the total maintenance cost (production downtime, spare parts, manpower, etc.) and meet daily production targets whilst complying with company guidelines and legal requirements.


General Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

Technical:

  • Provide electrical engineering support to Operations and Maintenance teams. 
  • Identify and develop ideas for improvements to the Electrical system that can add value to the asset.
  • Provide operations Electrical input and support to future field development. 
  • Perform Electrical modifications for gas plant and offshore facilities in accordance with engineering standards and operational requirements. 
  • Develop technical skills to improve capabilities. 
  • Participate in Root Cause Analysis for significant equipment failures. 
  • Develop operating procedures and guidelines.
  • Provide production engineering advice and support to maximize operation's efficiency. 
  • Focal point for production engineering support to field operations. 
  • Assist with preparation of short term and long-term production forecasting. 
  • Assist in preparation and maintenance of annual operation's team budget. 
  • Record electrical system performance to provide technical feedback for relevant stakeholder and support production efficiency. 
  • Create profiles with subsurface to confirm future facility capacity requirements. 
  • Demonstrate appropriate safety behaviours and commitment to environmental policies. 
  • Conduct production activities in compliance with all relevant procedures and legal requirements. 
  • Lead investigation and rectify operational problems. 
  • Analyse field data and develop action plans to improve production performance that can add value to the asset through improved reliability and uptime. 
  • Conduct safe start-up and shutdown of process facilities. 
  • Progress all MOC (Management of Change)'s including gaining technical and budgetary approval and interfacing with facility and Project Engineering to ensure all changes to equipment design, type or functions are controlled by application of applicable company Management of Change procedure. 
  • Develop Plant Operating Procedures and guidelines for all Company’s operation facilities. 
  • Conduct all operation tasks in compliance with Company's established policies, procedures, and professional standards. 
  • Conduct appropriate risk assessments for all operation activities, with particular attention to recognize the impact of change. 
  • Apply the lessons learned from design reviews, receiving inspections, and risk management findings and support team performance by sharing knowledge and best practices.
  • Ensure the confidentiality of the company's documentation. 


Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ): 

  • Comply with rules and standards described in Company Policies, HSE Integrated Management System and Procedures 
  • Report all incidents 
  • Motivate staff and colleagues to comply with HSE rules and standards 
  • Participate in HSE related initiatives
raw_requirements:
Qualifications & Experience:

  • Education: Minimum Diploma (D3) in Engineering or equivalent subjects 
  • Professional Qualification: 
    • Minimum 5 years of working experience in Oil and Gas Project 
    • Minimum 5 years’ experience in the use of applications of electrical and instrumentation simulation software 
  • Certification, training and courses: 
    • Employee Induction including HSE Awareness 
    • T-BOSIET (15 time) or T-FOET (refreshment) 
    • Coxswain Lifeboat 
    • Basic Fast Rescue Craft Coxswain Course 
    • OIM Controlling Emergencies Assessment 
    • Advance Fire Fighting 
    • Radioactive Source Security Officer (PKSR) 
    • Radiation Protection Officer (PPR) 
    • Occupational Health Safety Administration Series (OHSAS) 
    • Environmental Management System International Standardization Organization EMS IS0- 14001) 
  •  Language: Proficient in English and Bahasa Indonesia 


Required Competencies

Technical Competencies:

  • Proficient in operation of Gas Turbines and generators including support packages and ancillary equipment. 
  • Ability to use and develop PLC, DCS and SCADA systems/ 
  • Knowledge of gas plant and offshore operations. 
  • Project management experience 
  • Extensive experience and exposure to Root Cause Ana lysis and troubleshooting of operational equipment with state of the art diagnostic techniques. 
  • Experience in the design, installation, commissioning and operations of electrical, instrumentation and metering. 
  • Knowledge of subsea systems, ORF and offshore operations desired. 
  • Experience in pre-commissioning, commissioning and start-up. 
  • Production Operations: Maintenance Management, Predictive Maintenance, 
  • Operation/Maintenance Advising. 
  • Maintenance Engineering: CMMS Activities, Maintenance Engineering, Maintenance System Auditing, Maintenance Advising in Project Phase, Reliability/Availability 
  • Analysis techniques knowledge, Maintenance systems and policies knowledge 
  • Organization Processes: Internal Standard, Feedback development and diffusion, 
  • Technical Audit and Design review, Documentation Management. 
  • Support and Technologies: Standard ISO, TQM and Quality System, Technical requirement and Standard. 
  • Compliance: Local/National and International Standard and Codes, Health, Safety, Environment, Quality. 
  • Capable in terms of the maintenance management of Oil & Gas Platforms offshore or Onshore receiving Processing Facility. 


Non-Technical Competencies:

  • Integrity & values 
  • Value Creation Focus
  • Teamwork & cooperation
  • Initiative
  • Analytical thinking
  • Eager to Learn
  • Concern for order
  • Self-confidence
  • Team player


Working Conditions:

  • Location: Offshore (FPSO), Indonesia – Rotational 
  • Possibility for business travel to other Company’s premises or field areas

title: Software Engineer - GSI
raw_description:
Lowongan pekerjaan ini dipublikasikan melalui akun PT Global Service Indonesia. Kandidat terpilih akan menjadi karyawan PT Global Service Indonesia dengan penempatan di United Tractors Group (UT Group).

  1. Mengembangkan, memelihara, dan meningkatkan aplikasi menggunakan C# dan .NET 5 atau versi lebih baru.
  2. Mengembangkan dan mengintegrasikan API untuk mendukung kebutuhan aplikasi dan sistem.
  3. Mengelola database menggunakan Microsoft SQL Server, termasuk pembuatan query, pengolahan data, dan struktur database.
  4. Melakukan debugging, troubleshooting, serta optimalisasi performa aplikasi.
  5. Menyusun dokumentasi teknis dan diagram desain sistem.
  6. Melaksanakan pengujian sistem, termasuk System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), serta mendukung pengujian keamanan aplikasi.
  7. Mengelola kode program menggunakan version control Git.
  8. Berkolaborasi dengan tim terkait untuk memastikan aplikasi berjalan sesuai kebutuhan bisnis dan standar teknis.
raw_requirements:
1. Pendidikan minimal S1 Teknik Informatika, Ilmu Komputer, Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak, atau jurusan terkait.

title: Sr DevOps Engineer - ADMO
raw_description:
1. Menjembatani kesenjangan antara Tim Core Infrastructure, Security, QA, dan Developer.
  2. Menguasai Ketersediaan dan Performa aplikasi dan infrastrukturnya secara menyeluruh
  3. Menyediakan dukungan infrastruktur & aplikasi 24X7 infra & app support
  4. Membuat, mengelola, dan memelihara seluruh infrastruktur menggunakan IaC.
  5. Melakukan onboarding aplikasi baru dengan proses peninjauan kesiapan produksi.
  6. Bekerja sama dengan Tim Developer untuk memiliki pemahaman mendalam tentang arsitektur aplikasi dan hambatannya.
  7. Mengidentifikasi kesenjangan observabilitas dalam aplikasi & infrastruktur dan bekerja sama dengan pemangku kepentingan untuk memperbaikinya dengan memanfaatkan perangkat yang tepat.
  8. Mengelola pemadaman dan melakukan RCA terperinci dengan pengembang serta mengidentifikasi cara untuk menghindari situasi tersebut.
  9. Mengotomatiskan kerja keras dan pekerjaan berulang.
raw_requirements:
1. Gelar Sarjana dari jurusan Teknik Informatika/Sistem Informasi/Teknik Komputer/Manajemen Informatika atau bidang terkait dari universitas terkemuka dengan IPK minimal 3,00.
  2. Minimal 6 tahun pengalaman kerja dalam mengelola high traffic site, layanan mikro berskala besar, dan infrastruktur dengan keterampilan pemecahan masalah yang sangat baik. 
  3. Pengalaman dalam pemecahan masalah, pengelolaan, dan penerapan lingkungan terkontainerisasi menggunakan Docker/containerd. 
  4. Harus memiliki 5 tahun pengalaman kerja di lingkungan Kubernetes/Openshift. 
  5. Harus memiliki 2-3 tahun pengalaman bekerja dengan diagram helm. 
  6. Berpengalaman dengan administrasi Linux dan pemahaman yang baik tentang berbagai subsistem kernel Linux (memori, penyimpanan, jaringan, dll.). 
  7. Berpengalaman dalam DNS, TCP/IP, UDP, Routing, dan Load Balancing. 
  8. Berpengalaman dengan alat pemantauan dan pencatatan (misalnya, NewRelic, DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, tumpukan ELK). 
  9. Keahlian dalam GitOps, alat Infrastruktur sebagai Kode seperti Terraform, dll. 
  10. Keahlian dalam AWS Cloud dan/atau solusi Infrastruktur Cloud relevan lainnya. 
  11. Pengalaman dalam membangun jalur CI/CD dengan alat seperti Jenkins, GitLab, dll. 
  12. Pengalaman dengan beberapa penyimpanan data merupakan nilai tambah (Kafka/RabbitMQ, Redis, Elasticsearch). 
  13. Wajib menguasai salah satu bahasa skrip DevOps (Bash / Python / Go). 
  14. Semangat kolaboratif dengan kemampuan bekerja lintas disiplin untuk memengaruhi, belajar, dan memberikan hasil. 
  15. Pemahaman mendalam tentang ilmu komputer, pengembangan perangkat lunak, dan prinsip-prinsip jaringan

title: Head of ODU Product Pricing & Revenue
raw_description:
REQUIREMENTS

 

Education: Bachelor’s degree in economics, finance, business or engineering.

Experience: Seven to ten years in telco, broadband or subscription pricing, revenue management or commercial finance, with experience leading people or commercial workstreams.

Financial Modelling: Advanced Excel skills covering pricing, unit economics, forecasts, business cases and sensitivity analysis.

Business Acumen: Ability to balance customer affordability, growth, margin and network capacity using measurable commercial decisions.

Leadership and Communication: Ability to coach officers, influence cross-functional stakeholders and defend recommendations to Finance and senior leadership.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s degree in a relevant discipline.
  • Experience with FWA or fixed broadband pricing, device financing and recurring subscription economics.
  • Working knowledge of SQL or Power BI and billing or revenue assurance processes.

Job Description

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Pricing Strategy and Portfolio Economics

  • Develop monthly and advance-payment plans, installation fees, device pricing and installment options in coordination with Product Development.
  • Develop pricing for additional data and service upgrades with the Network team; recommend price changes through the Head of Product FWA, Finance and the pricing approval forum.

2. Promotion Governance and Business Cases

  • Evaluate acquisition, retention and renewal programmes through additional profit contribution, subsidy, payback and return assessments before and after launch.
  • Approve promotions only within the delegated mandate and approved budget; escalate exceptions and stop programmes that do not meet agreed economics.

3. Revenue Planning and Performance

  • Own FWA revenue forecasts, average revenue per customer plans and gap-closing actions against annual business targets; review acquisition, recurring and additional service revenue weekly.
  • Maintain the FWA business case with Finance for annual planning and the long-term business plan, including sensitivity analysis and monthly variance explanations.

4. Revenue Assurance and Channel Economics

  • Coordinate investigation and closure of price configuration errors, unauthorised discounts, promotion abuse and unpaid service entitlements.
  • Assess device costs, partner discounts, channel margins and commissions with Sales Planning and channel owners to maintain affordable acquisition costs.

5. Acquisition and Base Leadership

  • Set priorities, budgets and commercial guidelines for the two officers covering acquisition and customer base management.
  • Review acquisition quality, active customer growth, customer attrition, renewal and programme returns; coach the team and align corrective actions with Network, customer lifecycle management teams and Regional teams.

6. Cross Functional and Pricing Governance

  • Coordinate FWA pricing with Pricing and Marketing teams to avoid conflicts with other company offers; escalate cross-portfolio proposals for approval.
  • Present revenue outlook, commercial risks and pricing recommendations to senior management; track competitor pricing and recommend evidence-based responses.

title: Head of Product (Jakarta)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Head of Product (Jakarta)

Daftar Sekarang

Jakarta, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full-Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Own and drive product strategy from

zero-to-one

, ensuring alignment with long-term product vision and company strategy, and communicate it clearly to stakeholders and users.

Lead

experimentation-driven product development

, including rapid prototyping, MVP launches, A/B testing, and iterative validation.

Define, maintain, and execute product roadmaps, ensuring milestones are delivered on time with measurable impact.

Discover user pain points through qualitative research and deep data analysis; collaborate closely with analytics teams to translate insights into actionable product decisions.

Prototype product functionality and collaborate with design/UX teams to deliver best-in-class user experiences.

Develop go-to-market strategies and partner with growth teams to drive adoption, engagement, and retention.

Apply

growth-hacking principles

to product development, focusing on scalable acquisition, activation, and monetization levers.

Be highly analytical and data-driven; define success metrics and continuously measure product performance.

Lead, coach, and develop product managers, designers, and analysts, fostering a culture of experimentation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Proven experience working in agile development environments.

Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.

Exceptional problem-solving skills with structured and strategic thinking.

Strong collaboration and teamwork capabilities across cross-functional teams.

Ability to work independently in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

Kualifikasi

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, Business, or other related fields.

8+ years of experience in Product Management, with demonstrated ownership of products from zero-to-one and scaling stages.

Strong track record in experimentation, growth initiatives, and data-led decision making.

Experience using Product Management tools (e.g. Trello, GitHub Issues, Google Drive).

Experience using Prototyping tools (e.g. Figma).

Familiarity with Data Analytics tools (e.g. Metabase, Google Analytics).

Experience in palm oil or agribusiness-related companies is preferred.

Nice to have: Background in top-tier management consulting and/or investment banking, with exposure to strategy, growth, due diligence, or complex business problem-solving.

Willing to undergo a 2-month probation period in Pekanbaru, Riau.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is a cutting-edge green digital agritech startup located in the heart of Jakarta. Our mission is to be the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the palm oil industry. Through our integrated end-to-end agri-platform, we create a win-win-win scenario for people, planet, and prosperity.

We provide integrated apps that connect the supply chain stakeholders in the palm oil industry (Mills, DO Agents, Smallholders, Harvesters, Drivers, etc.). Creating a digital ecosystem that essentially boosts their productivity with effortless work documentation, affordable yet original agri-inputs, and agronomist services.

Our commitment extends beyond providing innovative solutions; we aim to nurture every aspect of Indonesia's palm oil industry. By fostering growth and sustainability, we strive to bring positive change to the lives of individuals in the palm oil sector, one at a time.

Daftar Sekarang

title: Searah Muara Bakau - Utility Control Room Operator
raw_description:
Purpose:

The Utility Control Room Operator is to operate and maintain processing gas & condensate in the Offshore/FPSO facilities complex in Control Room through established procedures to produce gas & condensate from Offshore/FPSO facilities and deliver to East Kalimantan facilities in safe operation, efficiently and within environment and contractual limits.

 

Utility Control Room Operator also operate, and handling emergency Shut down system, surveillances equipment, utility systems and equipment in safe operations. Utility Control Room Operator also must capture all alarm system include mitigation to be done and manage coordination with field operator & maintenance team to maintain safety, production quality and plant availability.

 

Utility Control Room Operator will communicate with Offshore/FPSO Utility Control Room Operators & East Kalimantan parties including but not limited to the Badak Control Room, in any changes of production operation parameter and condition in FPU, particularly during emergency situation until the production re-start in safely & timely manner. In addition, CRO will also liaise with Field Operator, Maintenance Team, Site Support team including but not limited to the Security, Housekeepers, Grass cutter, Project Representatives for any operational support required.

 

Utility Control Room Operator will work closely with Field Operator and ensures that hydrocarbon production moves continuously from the inlet FPU to the tie-in export facilities within operational context and part of all Front-Line Operations Production & Maintenance.

 

General Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

  • Ensure the efficiency of production facilities.
  • Adhere to all safety and environmental protection procedures.
  • Manage the startup and shutdown of process facilities to ensure safe operation and compliance with procedures to meet product requirements.
  • Plan the work activities of production operators during their shifts.
  • Ensure facilities and work areas are in a safe condition for the execution of maintenance and project activities under valid work permits.
  • Verify that fire and gas detection systems, emergency systems, and surveillance equipment are functioning properly.
  • Operate and maintain production operation parameters (Pressure, Temperature, hydrocarbon quality, etc.), UPS and battery systems, Main
  • generators, and emergency diesel generators with their utility support systems.
  • Operate and maintain gas and condensate metering systems and other utility equipment to support production availability and reliability at the FPU.
  • Operate and maintain gas and condensate system units, ensuring qualities meet agreed specifications and nominations.
  • Monitor production and resolve operational problems by working closely with all relevant teams to maintain optimal performance.
  • Maintain data logbooks, gather information, and analyse data from process facilities.
  • Utilize experience and knowledge to lead or participate in investigations and the rectification of operational problems.
  • Troubleshoot minor operational issues and report major problems to management.
  • Produce comprehensive and accurate shift and crew-change handover notes.
  • Ensure that Permit to Work (PTW) activities are carried out according to safety procedures.
  • Mentor field operators on DCS operations to facilitate knowledge transfer.
  • Record bypass and override process parameters as per BIFO procedures.
  • Understand multi-disciplinary risk assessments and execute mitigation plans for bypassed or overridden signals; ensure the Central Control Room (CCR) is aware of required emergency actions.
  • Minimize production losses by ensuring safe procedures and execution.
  • Ensure the production plant, processes, and equipment are working efficiently.
  • Perform routine checks of all equipment and units to ensure they function correctly in accordance with standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Maintain plant log sheets to ensure process parameters are within safe limits and report any abnormalities to the Operation Supervisor.
  • Participate actively in shift handover meetings to ensure current conditions are communicated clearly to the entire team.
  • Manage and monitor process facilities during pigging activities.
  • Record and report equipment abnormalities and problems via SAP Notifications and formal communication protocols to the reporting line (Leader, Supervisor, OIM).

 

Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ):

·         Comply with rules and standards described in Company Policies, HSE Integrated Management System and Procedures

·         Report all incidents.

·         Motivate staff and colleagues to comply with HSE rules and standards.

·         Participate in HSE related initiatives.
raw_requirements:
Qualifications & Experience:

-          Education: Diploma (D3) in Engineering or equivalent

-          Professional Qualification:

·         7 years as Operator including 1 year at Control Room

·         Control Panel Operator experiences is advantage

-          Training and Certification:

·         Employee Induction including HSE Awareness

·         T-BOSIET (1st time) or T-FOET (refreshment)

·         SAP PM Modules

·         Control Room Emergency Training (MOME)

·         Authorization Gas Tester (AGT)

·         First Aid & Fire Fighting

·         Other training might be required to support operational duty

·         BNSP-certified candidates are highly preferred

-          Language: Fluent in English and Bahasa Indonesia

 

Required Competencies

Technical Competencies:

-       Knowledge of subsea system, oil & gas processing facilities, MRU operational, Hull & utilities and operations desired

-       Pre-commissioning, commissioning and start-up experienced

-       Ability to conduct Operations Process upset – Troubleshooting in field facilities

-       Production Operations: Plant Management, Plant Prod Optimization

-       Maintenance Operations: Trouble shooting techniques knowledge

-       Supports and technologies: Technical requirement and Standard

-       Compliance: Health, Safety, Environment, Quality

 

Non-Technical Competencies:

-       Integrity & values

-       Value Creation Focus

-       Teamwork & cooperation

-       Initiative

-       Analytical thinking

-       Information seeking

-       Concern for order

-       Self-confidence

-       Team player Information seeking

-       Concern for order

Offshore based – Rotational (FPSO)

title: Prime Natuna EP - Geologist
raw_description:
Focused on field development and production Geology. This position will play a key role in maximizing hydrocarbon recovery from our new field development assets, working under the guidance of Senior Geoscientists, and utilize Geomodelling software to build and update static models, correlate wells, and support Field Development Plans. 

Areas of Accountability, Responsibility and Competence:

·     Support the development and continuous updating of 3D static geological models for active and new development fields.

·     Perform detailed well-to-well correlation, well log analysis, and core/cuttings integration to refine reservoir zonation and identify bypassed pay or infill drilling opportunities.

·     Assist in the preparation of subsurface deliverables for Subsurface Evaluation Reports (SER), Field Development Plans (FDP), resource evaluations, and well proposals.

·     Monitor production data and work closely with Reservoir Engineers and Production Technologists to update geological models and explain production anomalies.

·     Support post-drill well evaluations and end-of-well reports, ensuring new geological data is rapidly integrated into existing subsurface workflows.

·     Assist in preparing subsurface data, maps, and reports in compliance with local regulatory requirements.

·     Participate in multidisciplinary team meetings, contributing geological insights to well planning and production optimization discussions.
raw_requirements:
Qualification / Work Experience:

·   Education: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) or Master of Science (M.Sc.) in Geology, Petroleum Geology, Geosciences, or a closely related discipline

·   Experience: Fresh graduate or up to 1 year of experience in Geoscience. (Fresh Graduates with Strong Academic Projects, Internships, or Thesis work related to development Geology, Reservoir characterization, or Natuna Basin are highly encouraged to apply).

·   Software Skills: Foundational knowledge or academic exposure to Petrel software. Proficiency in Microsoft 365 for Data Analysis and Technical Presentations.

· Technical Knowledge: Solid understanding of Development Geology Principles, Sedimentology, Stratigraphy, Structural Geology, and basic Reservoir Engineering Concepts.

title: Prime Natuna EP - Subsea Work Package Project Manager
raw_description:
Responsible for Delivering, Leading and Managing the Subsea Work Package for Subsea Well Development from Pre-FEED through FEED and subsequent EPCI phases. The role provides dedicated Leadership for the Development of Technical requirements, Design Basis, Contractor Engineering Management, Technical Assurance, and Delivery of Subsea Production Systems, Wells Interfaces, Umbilicals, Risers, Flowlines and associated integration with Fixed Infrastructure and Floating Facilities. The role also supports the Tuna Project as and when required, while ensuring Subsea Development activities are Delivered Safely, Efficiently and in line with approved Scope, Schedule, Budget, Quality and Regulatory Commitments.

This position oversees all Subsea works at Tuna Block and Natuna Block.
raw_requirements:
Qualification / Work Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering.
  • Minimum 15 years of Experience in the Upstream Oil and Gas Industry, with Strong Exposure to Electrohydraulic Subsea Well Development, preferably covering FEED and EPCI phases in a Leading or Managerial role.
  • Strong Leadership and Stakeholder Management Skills, with the ability to Lead Multidisciplinary teams and Coordinate Interfaces across various Functions.
  • Proven experience across the Subsea Project Lifecycle, including Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing/Fabrication, Construction, Installation, Pre-commissioning, Commissioning and Start-up.
  • Experience in Contractor Engineering Management and Technical Assurance, including Review and Approval of Engineering Deliverables, rRsolution of Technical Queries and Monitoring of Contractor Performance.
  • Demonstrated Capability in Managing Critical Interfaces among Subsea Production Systems, Wells, Umbilicals, Risers, Flowlines, Fixed Infrastructure and Floating Facilities.

 

Special Skills / Knowledge:

  • Familiar with Project Planning and Control, Contract and Risk Management.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with Proficiency in MS Office and relevant Project Management Tools/Software.
  • In-depth Knowledge and Experience in Subsea Well Development from Conceptual Study until Commissioning and Start-up.
  • Broad and Extensive Knowledge of Components, Hardware, Infrastructures and Facilities required for Subsea Well Development.
  • Comprehensive understanding on the Modifications required at the Existing Facilities to support Subsea Development.
  • Able to implement and embed applicable Subsea Engineering Codes, Standards and specifications to effect Project Delivery.
  • Good Knowledge of Regulatory Framework and relevant Legislation.
  • Having latest Knowledge of Industry and Technology Development associated with Subsea Well Development.

title: Searah Muara Bakau - Operations Specialist
raw_description:
﻿Searah is a leading independent integrated energy company in Southeast Asia, established in 2026 through the strategic partnership between Eni and PETRONAS. With a current asset base of 19 assets across Malaysia and Indonesia, Searah stands as one of the leading players in the Asia Pacific energy sector. In Indonesia, Searah Muara Bakau serves as one of Searah’s operating companies. Its operations span the exploration, development, and production of offshore natural gas resources, with a strong focus on the deepwater areas of the Kutei Basin in the Makassar Strait, contributing to energy security across Southeast Asia and the sustainable development of the communities where it operates.


We are looking for qualified personnel with high motivation, initiative, and integrity to fill the following position:


Job Title: Operations Specialist 


Purpose:

The Operation Specialist is responsible for ensuring the reliable operation and maintenance of all facility equipment. This includes optimizing facility performance and troubleshooting various processing systems such as pumps, compressors, generators, processing units, and production chemicals. The role also plays a key part in developing and implementing initiatives to enhance processing facility performance.

The Operation Specialist ensures the prompt, safe, and environmentally responsible execution of all operational activities. The position is accountable for maintaining safe operations, maximizing equipment uptime and field production efficiency, and minimizing total operating costs—including LPO, production downtime, spare parts usage, and overall resource management.

The role is expected to meet or exceed daily production targets while ensuring full compliance with company guidelines, regulatory requirements, and Safe Operating Principles, ultimately delivering maximum value to stakeholders without compromise.

 

General Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

-     Reporting to the Operation & Maintenance Superintendent (O&M Supt), the Operation Specialist is responsible for coordinating process support to optimize the operation of offshore facilities. All activities must be conducted safely, maximizing field production efficiency while minimizing total operating costs—including LPO, production downtime, spare parts usage, and overall resource management. The role is expected to meet or exceed daily production targets while ensuring full compliance with company guidelines and legal requirements.

-     To managing respective people and organization with relevant administration and report, also managing HSE function in the respective department.

-     Responsible for the coordination of the development project activities relevant to the offshore equipment with focus on Pre-Operations Works and establish Operations requirements during detail engineering , construction, commissioning , start up phases of new oil/gas production facilities, ensuring that commissioning phase and startup operations are conducted in safe, effective and efficiently manner with meeting the company target and to the satisfaction of all parties.  

-     To support all operation readiness activities and assurance review from initial concept through to project sanction, and possibly through project execution, ensuring that the design meets project objectives for cost, schedule, safety and environmental impact. Assure all operation aspects and risk opportunities to optimize the construction activities in the field, have been address and mitigate the risk.



 

Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ):

·    Comply with rules and standards described in Company Policies, HSE Integrated Management System and Procedures

·         Report all incidents

·         Motivate staff and colleagues to comply with HSE rules and standards

·         Participate in HSE related initiatives

title: Searah Muara Bakau - Loading Master
raw_description:
Searah is a leading independent integrated energy company in Southeast Asia, established in 2026 through the strategic partnership between Eni and PETRONAS. With a current asset base of 19 assets across Malaysia and Indonesia, Searah stands as one of the leading players in the Asia Pacific energy sector. In Indonesia, Searah Muara Bakau serves as one of Searah’s operating companies. Its operations span the exploration, development, and production of offshore natural gas resources, with a strong focus on the deepwater areas of the Kutei Basin in the Makassar Strait, contributing to energy security across Southeast Asia and the sustainable development of the communities where it operates.


Purpose:

The Loading Master is a senior marine officer responsible for the safe and efficient management of all hydrocarbon cargo and ballast water systems onboard the FPSO. This includes ensuring vessel stability and trim, maintaining cargo quality specifications, and preparing for offloading operations. The role requires deep coordination with the Topside Operations team to balance production with storage capacity and acts as the lead for the cargo and ballast control operators. Strict adherence to Indonesian national regulations is mandatory.


General Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

A. Cargo & Ballast Management:

  • Cargo Planning: Develop and execute detailed cargo and ballast management plans to maintain the FPSO's stability, hull stress, upright heel/list and draught within designed limits at all times. Develop plan and execute work sequence during cargo offload to offtake tanker.
  • System Operation: Manage and oversee the operation of the cargo and ballast systems, including pumps, valves, inert system, crude oil washing system and stripping systems, via the ship's automated control system.
  • Storage Management: Monitor tank levels, temperatures, and pressures for all cargo tanks, slop tanks, and all other tanks including ballast tanks. Coordinate with Production to manage incoming production flow against available storage capacity.

Stability & Stress Calculations: Perform daily and critical-operation stability, trim, and shear force/bending moment calculations using dedicated software. Issue formal reports.

B. Cargo Quality Assurance:

  • Quality Control: Work closely with the Production Chemist or Topside Operators to monitor the quality of produced condensate/oil (e.g., BS&W, salinity, density, RVP).
  • Specification Compliance: Ensure all cargo in storage meets the contractual specifications required for offtake and sale. This involves overseeing the sampling and testing process.
  • Tank Cleaning: Plan and oversee tank cleaning operations to maintain cargo quality and prevent contamination.
  • Cargo Records: Maintain accurate records of all cargo quantities (including ullage/innage gauging) and quality data for reconciliation and customs purposes.

C. Offloading Preparation & Support:

  • Pre-Offloading Readiness: Prepare the cargo system for offloading: line up valves, prepare pumps, and ensure all equipment is functional. Prepare all administration documents include but are not limited to Pre Arrival Check, Cargo Meeting, Sequence Time during Cargo Operation.
  • Support to Mooring Master: Work under the direction of the Mooring Master (a distinct, often more senior role) during the offloading process. The Loading Master's team manages the internal cargo transfer and pumping to the offtake tanker.
  • Cargo Calculation: Accurately calculate and document the quantity of cargo transferred to the shuttle tanker (Bill of Lading figures, Manifest, Statement of Fact), acting as the FPSO's official representative for quantity.

D. Team Management & Safety:

  • Supervision: Directly supervise the Cargo Control Room Operators, Ballast Operator and deck crew involved in cargo and ballast operations.
  • Training: Ensure all team members are trained and competent in operating cargo/ballast systems and emergency procedures.
  • Safety & Compliance: Enforce all safety procedures, Permit-to-Work (PTW) systems, and isolations for work on cargo and ballast systems. Lead by example in implementing the company's Safety Management System (SMS).
  • Emergency Response: Fulfill a key role in the vessel's Emergency Response team, particularly for scenarios related to cargo spills, stability issues, or fire/explosion.

E. Coordination & Administration (Indonesia Focus):

  • Interface with Topside Operations: Maintain constant communication with the Production team lead to align marine storage plans with production rates and shutdowns. This is a critical daily interface.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all operations comply with Indonesian regulations from:
    • DIRJEN HUBLA (Directorate General of Sea Transportation): Cargo Operations, Vessel stability, safety, and pollution prevention regulations.
    • SKK Migas: Specific reporting and operational requirements for oil and gas upstream activities.
    • Customs & Excise: Accurate reporting of cargo quantities for export and tax purposes.
  • Documentation: Manage all marine-related documentation, including cargo logs, ballast water record books, stability booklets, Intact Stability Booklet and Indonesian regulatory reports.

 

Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ):

·        Comply with rules and standards described in Company Policies, HSE Integrated Management System and Procedures

·        Report all incidents

·        Motivate staff and colleagues to comply with HSE rules and standards

Participate in HSE related initiatives
raw_requirements:
Qualifications & Experience:

·        Education: Minimum Level Class -2 Deck Officer with dangerous cargo endorsement.

·        Professional Qualification:

-      A minimum of 5 years of experience as a Chief Officer (C/O) on crude oil tankers, product tankers, or LNG carriers. Direct experience on an FPSO or FSO is highly desirable and often essential.

-      Proven, hands-on experience in cargo and ballast operations, including extensive use of automated control systems.

-      Demonstrated experience in performing stability and stress calculations for large vessels.

-      Experience in a supervisory role, managing a team of operators.

-      Experience working in Southeast Asia or Indonesia is a significant advantage.

Certification, training and courses:

Mandatory Certifications (STCW & Indonesian):

•     Chief Mate (Class II) or Master Mariner (Class I) Certificate of Competency recognized by the Indonesian government. A Chief Mate ticket is often the minimum requirement.

•     Valid STCW Certificates (Advanced Firefighting, Proficiency in Survival Craft, etc.).

•     Tanker Endorsements: Mandatory STCW certificates for Oil Tanker and preferably Liquefied Gas Tanker operations (for condensate).

•     Seafarer's Medical Certificate.

•     Indonesian Specific Certifications: The company will facilitate, but eligibility is key. This may include:

•    ADPT (Ahli Deklarasi Pengangkutan Tujuan) for hazardous cargo.

•    Familiarization with Indonesian port state and flag state requirements.

Language: Proficient in English and Bahasa

 

Required Competencies:

Technical Competencies

  • Technical Expertise: In-depth knowledge of tanker operations, hydrodynamics, and crude oil/condensate characteristics.

Non-Technical Competencies

  • Leadership & Teamwork: Ability to lead a marine team and collaborate effectively with the production (topside) department, which often has a different reporting structure and priorities.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills to troubleshoot issues with cargo systems, balance stability during production, and manage capacity constraints.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Knowledge of Bahasa Indonesia is a major advantage for managing local crew and understanding local regulations.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: Absolute accuracy is required in cargo calculations, stability calculations, and following complex procedures.

 

Working Conditions:

Offshore/FPSO, possibility for business travel to other Eni premises or field areas.

title: Accounting Analyst - GF
raw_description:
1. Melakukan pencatatan dan memastikan transaksi keuangan sesuai dengan standar akuntansi dan kebijakan perusahaan.
  2. Menjalankan proses month-end dan year-end closing, termasuk jurnal, accrual, dan adjustment.
  3. Melakukan rekonsiliasi akun, termasuk bank, AR, AP, dan akun terkait lainnya, serta menindaklanjuti selisih yang ditemukan.
  4. Melakukan review dan analisis General Ledger (GL) untuk mengidentifikasi ketidaksesuaian dan transaksi yang memerlukan tindak lanjut.
  5. Memantau dan merekonsiliasi AR, AP, prepaid expense, accrued expense, serta akun terkait lainnya.
  6. Melakukan pencatatan dan rekonsiliasi aset tetap, termasuk depreciation, movement, impairment, dan disposal.
  7. Menyiapkan schedule dan supporting data untuk kebutuhan financial reporting, termasuk Neraca, Laba Rugi, dan Arus Kas.
  8. Memastikan accounting treatment atas transaksi dan kejadian tertentu sesuai dengan standar akuntansi yang berlaku.
  9. Mendukung proses audit dan internal control dengan menyiapkan data, dokumen, dan rekonsiliasi yang diperlukan.
  10. Memastikan kelengkapan dan ketertiban dokumen serta supporting transaksi accounting.
  11. Melakukan analisis data accounting dan memberikan insight atau rekomendasi atas permasalahan yang ditemukan.
  12. Mendukung perbaikan proses accounting untuk meningkatkan akurasi, efisiensi, dan efektivitas pekerjaan.
raw_requirements:
1. Pendidikan minimal S1 Akuntansi, Keuangan, atau bidang terkait.
  2. Memiliki pengalaman kerja 2 - 4 tahun di bidang Accounting.
  3. Memiliki pemahaman yang baik mengenai PSAK, financial reporting, dan proses month-end/year-end closing.
  4. Memahami proses General Ledger, AR, AP, bank reconciliation, prepaid/accrual, dan fixed asset.
  5. Memahami dasar accounting treatment dan revenue recognition menjadi nilai tambah.
  6. Memiliki kemampuan Microsoft Excel yang baik dan familiar dengan software atau sistem accounting.
  7. Memiliki kemampuan analisis yang baik, teliti, detail-oriented, dan mampu bekerja dengan target waktu.
  8. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan koordinasi yang baik dengan pihak internal maupun eksternal.
  9. Memiliki integritas, ketelitian, dan komitmen terhadap akurasi serta kerahasiaan data keuangan.

Take full ownership of projects that are built to meet functional and non-functional requirements of our users and partners.

Design, implement, instrument and deploy highly performant and reusable Android components for operational excellence programs

Lead collaboration across teams and roles, to resolve ambiguous, multi dimensional business, legal, and product needs.

Participate in interview loops to help Grab continue hiring top industry talent

Provide technical guidance, mentorship and knowledge sharing to peers.

title: Prime Natuna EP - Fixed Infrastructure Sr. SURF Engineer
raw_description:
To be mobilized to support the execution of Fixed Infrastructure FEED work. Involvement of a Sr. SURF Engineer is critical to ensure readiness of SURF engineering activities, including design basis, technical requirements, and key interfaces between subsea systems and Fixed/Floating Infrastructure. Timely mobilization will help ensure design integrity and interface alignment, while minimizing the risks of design gaps, installation constraints, and rework during FEED and subsequent EPCI phases.

Areas of Accountability, Responsibility and Competence: 

  • ​Identify and solve technical issues that may rise during all SURF activities of the Project. 
  • ​Ensure the prompt and efficient dispatch, review, high quality of all SURF Systems and approval of all Detailed Engineering / Qualification / Manufacturing / Fabrication / Construction / Installation / Pre-Commissioning documents issued by SURF Contractor, in due time, ensuring the adequate level of priority is given. 
  • ​Ensure coherence of the SURF systems and manage interfaces with other Package Managers of the Project (Topsides, SPS Construction and Operation). 
  • ​Responsible to coordinate and validate the technical responses to all SURF technical queries between external entities/Contractors. 
  • ​Ensure that SURF Engineering activities are performed in line with Contract requirement and Project Specifications, all within project schedule and budget. 
  • ​Keep the Project Development Sr. Manager informed about any deviation, technical risk or concern impacting the overall project execution plan on technical, planning or cost issues related to SURF. 
  • ​Ensure that design and qualification outcomes/constraints are adequately considered in due time for Procurement, Manufacturing, Fabrication, Installation and Pre-commissioning, and vice/versa. 
  • ​Ensure that HSE requirements are taken into consideration during design. 
  • ​Participate in various technical reviews (Hazids, Hazops, Project Technical Reviews, Risk Assessments, etc.), and ensure implementation of recommendations as necessary. 
  • ​Participate to interface meeting and liaise with Interface manager to manage the project interfaces. 
  • ​Liaise with Project QHSES, QAQC, etc, to ensure that the SURF scope is designed to be safe, operable, and maintainable. 
  • ​Assist QA/QC manager for all quality issues related to SURF engineering. 
  • ​​Ensure high quality of all SURF Systems Detailed Engineering / Qualification / Manufacturing / Fabrication / Construction / Installation / Pre-Commissioning activities performed by Contractor. 
  • ​Identify and solve technical issues that may rise during all SURF activities of the Project. 
  • ​Ensure the prompt and efficient dispatch, review and approval of all Detailed Engineering / Qualification / Manufacturing / Fabrication / Construction / Installation / Pre-Commissioning documents issued by SURF Contractor, in due time, ensuring the adequate level of priority is given. 
  • ​Ensure coherence of the SURF systems and manage interfaces with other Package Managers of the Project (Topsides, SPS Construction and Operation). 
  • ​Responsible to coordinate and validate the technical responses to all SURF technical queries between external entities/Contractors. 
  • ​Ensure that SURF Engineering activities are performed in line with Contract requirement and Project Specifications, all within project schedule and budget. 
  • ​Keep the Tuna Asset Sr. Manager informed about any deviation, technical risk or concern impacting the overall project execution plan on technical, planning or cost issues related to SURF. 
  • ​Ensure that design and qualification outcomes/constraints are adequately considered in due time for Procurement, Manufacturing, Fabrication, Installation and Pre-commissioning, and vice/versa. 
  • ​Ensure that HSE requirements are taken into consideration during design. 
  • ​Participate in various technical reviews (Hazids, Hazops, Project Technical Reviews, Risk Assessments, etc.), and ensure implementation of recommendations as necessary. 
  • ​Participate to interface meeting and liaise with Interface manager to manage the project interfaces. 
  • ​Liaise with Project QHSES, QAQC, etc, to ensure that the SURF scope is designed to be safe, operable, and maintainable. 
  • ​Assist QA/QC manager for all quality issues related to SURF engineering. 
  • ​Monitor Contractor performance against engineering aspects of the Contract and to assist the Project Manager / PCM in management of associated Change Order Requests. 
  • ​To initiate and attend all SURF engineering meetings, routine and subject specific, to pursuit Contractor’s resolution and close-out of documents. 
  • ​Develop effective and constructive relationships with all Contractors representative(s) in a manner that enables a high level of value to be obtained. 
  • ​Positively represent the Company at SURF Contractor's premises, sites and on vessels if appropriate, during onshore and offshore construction, as and when required. 
  • ​Ensure that agreed project battery limits are adhered to. 
  • ​Control and approve, when appropriate, the specifications, requisitions, design procedures, layouts, general arrangements, drawings, P&ID's, installation procedures, installation analyses reports, design reports, etc. 
  • ​Ensure that all relevant documentation created by the SURF Contractor or its suppliers is reviewed and commented on by the relevant specialists within the appropriate time frame. 
  • ​Prepare/support handover to Field Operations / Commissioning team. 
  • ​Develop SURF engineering report for Management in a timely manner. 
  • ​Ensure construction, pre-commissioning, and start-up activities for SURF are delivered safely as per company requirement.
raw_requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical / Civil / Structural Engineering or other relevant engineering discipline.

title: Searah Muara Bakau - Mechanical Specialist
raw_description:
Purpose:

The Mechanical Specialist is responsible for ensuring the reliable operation and maintenance of all mechanical equipment on Offshore/FPSO. This includes troubleshooting, repairing, and overhauling various systems such as pumps, compressors, turbines, and others rotating and static equipment. Also play as key role in developing and implementing preventative maintenance programs and optimizing equipment performance.

 

The Mechanical Specialist is guaranteeing the prompt, safe and environment respecting execution of Maintenance activities will be conducted in safe manner with maximizing uptime and field production efficiency while minimizing the total maintenance cost (production downtime, spare parts, manpower, etc.) and meet daily production targets whilst complying with company guidelines and legal requirements to deliver highest value to stakeholders without compromise to Safe Operating Principals.

 

General Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

  • Ensure all relevant Mechanical equipment is fully operational, in service, maintained safely, effectively and in accordance with procedures and equipment design codes and standards.
  • Ensure maintenance activities are carried out in compliance with all relevant procedures and legal requirements.
  • Ensure that all Safety Critical element PM’s are completed with plan.
  • Ensure all work is coordinated and aligned with production priorities and within the issued job plan and schedules, including reporting by the scheduler from the CMMS.
  • Liaise with Planner and Scheduler regarding the forward planning of spare parts deliverability and in determining min/max stock levels of spare parts and maintenance consumables on the facility.
  • Assist in preparation and surveillance of annual maintenance team budget.
  • Maintain complete and accurate equipment history records within the CMMS, Computerized Maintenance Management System, preferable SAP system.
  • Apply the lessons learned from design reviews, receiving inspections, and risk management findings and support team performance by sharing knowledge and best practices.
  • Conduct and coordinate Mechanical maintenance contractors, inspections, calibrations, function tests and evaluate Mechanical equipment operation and condition to determine remedial action.
  • Prepare maintenance activities for flawless execution. Ensuring permits, PPE, tools, materials, equipment, work site preparation, and toolbox talks are in place and always completed.
  • Develop equipment Standard Maintenance/Repair Procedures and guidelines for all FPU/FPSO equipment.
  • Support safe start-up and shutdown of process facilities
  • Manage relevant reporting and administration work based on the needs of the respective organization (including data recording, correspondence, etc. – based on the function of this position).
  • Produce comprehensive and accurate shift and crew change handover notes.
  • Ensure that any changes to Mechanical controlled documentation, because of MOC (Management of Change) work, are captured and correctly recorded.
  • If required, attend Emergency work after normal working hours on a callout basis.
  • Participate in Root Cause Analysis for equipment failures.
  • Apply the lesson learned from design review, receiving inspections, and risk management finding and support team performance by sharing knowledge and best practices.
  • Maintain complete and accurate equipment history records within the Computerized Maintenance Management System.
  • Manage relevant reporting and administration work based on the needs of the respective organization (including data recording, correspondence, etc – based on the functions of this positions).
  • Ensure the confidentiality of the company’s documentation.

 

Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ):

-              Comply with rules and standards described in Company Policies, HSE Integrated Management System and Procedures

-              Report all incidents

-              Motivate staff and colleagues to comply with HSE rules and standards

-              Participate in HSE related initiatives
raw_requirements:
Qualifications & Experience:

·        Education: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or similar

·        Experience:

·        Minimum 5 years of Oil & Gas Industry experience.

·        Fluent with CMMS System, preferable SAP Experience.

·        Familiar with Predictive Maintenance data acquisition, such as tribology.

·        Extensive experience handle Gas Turbine Generator, Gas Turbine Compressors, rotating equipment, and pedestal crane.

·        Training and Certification:

·        Employee Induction including HSE Awareness

·        T-BOSIET (1st time) or T-FOET (refreshment)

·        Advance Fire Fighting

·        CSEA (Confined Spaces Entrant Attendant)

·        BNSP-certified candidates are highly preferred

·        Language: Fluent in English and Bahasa Indonesia

 

Required Competencies

Technical Competencies:

-        Extensive experience and exposure with variety of Mechanical rotating and static equipment and manufacturers.

-        Good knowledge of production facilities in an oil/gas including installation, repair testing and maintenance of wide range of Mechanical systems.

-        Must have the ability to read and understand drawings and specifications specific to Mechanical discipline, e.g. P&ID, vendor control drawings, etc.

-        Extensive experience and exposure with hazardous areas and hazardous area equipment certification.

-        Extensive experience and exposure with standard operating practice with respect to maintenance activities in an operational Oil & Gas production/processing environment, with specific regard to hazardous area practise and restrictions.

-        Extensive experience and exposure with Maintenance Management system CMMS-SAP.

-        Extensive experience and exposure with hazard associate with Manual handling and operation maintenance requirements of fixed and mobile lifting equipment, including offshore cranes and inspection requirements under design code API 2C.

-        Extensive experience and exposure with maintenance requirements and hazards of high-pressure piping systems, valve types, and flange management.

-        Extensive experience and exposure with levelling and alignment rotating equipment.

-        Extensive experience and exposure with operation and maintenance of industrial single & dual fuel Gas Turbines and the installation and removal of compressor dry gas seals.

-        Extensive experience and exposure with operation and maintenance of HVAC systems.

-        Extensive experience and exposure with operation and maintenance of centrifugal compressors, centrifugal pumps, air compressors and dryers, fin fan air coolers, pedestal cranes, diesel engine drivers, and utility packages.

-        Extensive experience and exposure with use of hydraulic and pneumatic bolt torque and tensioning equipment.

-        Extensive experience and exposure with standard operating practice with respect to maintenance activities in an operational oil & gas production/processing environment, with specific regard to hazardous area practices and restrictions.

-        Extensive experience and exposure to root cause analysis and troubleshooting of operational equipment with state-of-the-art diagnostic techniques.

 

Non-Technical Competencies:

-        Integrity & values

-        Driving for results

-        Value Creation Focus

-        Teamwork & cooperation

-        Initiative

-        Analytical thinking

-        Information seeking

-        Concern for order

-        Self-confidence

-        Team player

 

Working Conditions:

Offshore based – Rotational (FPSO)

title: Prime Natuna EP - Fixed Infrastructure Sr. Technical Safety Engineer
raw_description:
Responsible for Designing Technical Safety system for Fixed Infrastructure Project and ensure its safe and optimum project delivery as well as reliable operation.

Required to be mobilized to support the execution of Fixed Infrastructure FEED work, which is planned to commence in Oct’26. Involvement of a Sr. Technical Safety Engineer is critical to ensure readiness of Technical Safety Engineering Activities, including Safety Design Requirements, Major Accident Hazard assessment, SECE requirements, and required Process Safety Studies. Timely mobilization will ensure that Safety-Critical requirements are properly incorporated into the design from the early stage of FEED, while minimizing the risks of design gaps, late safety-driven changes, and rework during FEED and subsequent EPCI phases.

Areas of Accountability, Responsibility and Competence: 

  • ​​Deliver Technical Safety deliverables for Fixed Infrastructure scope.  
  • ​Establishing the Implementation of INBU HSE Technical Safety Program through an effective approach, 
  • ​Empowering the Mandatory Control Framework of MAH concept and stimulus the Technical Safety Performance Evaluation and identify Gaps, 
  • ​Strategically for evaluating the process for managing of MAH risks of the INBU, 
  • ​Hosting the Technical Safety Corporate and Regulatory requirements with aligned to Management direction and requirements 
  • ​Ensuring the technical healthiness and integrity of the SECEs. 
  • ​Delivering the Compliance process of SECE Verification Scheme process into Operation and Development Department 
  • ​Accountable for Validating to all Critical Process Safety Information at all Worksites 
  • ​Assuring to Deliver the analysis of Technical Safety Findings and Interventions which covering the aspects of Identify Root Causes, Formulate Intervention Strategies and Review intervention plans to strengthen HSE Control of Work. 
  • ​Providing the Technical Safety (HSE Engineering) Guidance with Innovative Technical Solutions in supporting the implementation of Technical Safety requirements at all Worksites 
  • ​Role Model for Process Safety and Coach for Process Safety Rules Implementation 
  • ​Supporting the Role and Responsibility of Technical Safety Technical Authority 
  • ​Coordinating to all Process Safety Programes 
  • ​Build, Train and Coach the Process Safety awareness especially to Operation and Development Personnel.

• Proven experience in Technical Safety Engineering and Design for Offshore Facilities, including Development and review of Safety Engineering deliverables throughout the Project Lifecycle.

• Relevant Experience in Process Safety and Major Accident Hazard (MAH) Management, including Participation in Risk Assessments and Technical Safety Assurance Activities for Offshore facilities.

• Experience in supporting Construction, Pre-Commissioning, and Start-Up Activities associated with Technical Safety Systems is preferred.

• Fluent in English, Both written and Spoken, with proficiency in MS Office and relevant Technical Safety Engineering Tools/Software.

title: Engineering Manager - ADMO
raw_description:
• Kepemimpinan dan Manajemen Tim: (1) Memberikan kepemimpinan, arahan, dan bimbingan kepada tim teknik; (2) Mengelola dan membimbing para insinyur, mendorong pertumbuhan karier dan pengembangan keterampilan; (3) Menumbuhkan budaya tim yang positif dan kolaboratif; (4) Melakukan pertemuan tatap muka, tinjauan kinerja, dan sesi penetapan tujuan dengan anggota tim secara berkala; (5) Menangani tugas administratif terkait tim seperti penjadwalan, alokasi sumber daya, dan penempatan staf.
  • Manajemen Proyek dan Produk: (1) Berkolaborasi dengan manajer produk, desainer, dan pemangku kepentingan untuk menentukan cakupan, persyaratan, dan jadwal; (2) Merencanakan dan memprioritaskan proyek dan tugas teknik; (3) Memastikan penyelesaian proyek teknik yang tepat waktu dan berkualitas tinggi; (4) Memantau kemajuan proyek, mengidentifikasi dan menangani masalah atau risiko apa pun.
  • Panduan Teknis dan Pengambilan Keputusan: (1) Memberikan keahlian dan panduan teknis kepada tim teknik; (2) Membuat keputusan teknis dan kompromi untuk memastikan keberhasilan proyek; (3) Tetap mengikuti perkembangan tren industri, praktik terbaik, dan teknologi yang sedang berkembang.
  • Komunikasi dan Kolaborasi: (1) Memfasilitasi komunikasi dan kolaborasi dalam tim teknik dan lintas departemen lainnya; (2) Bertindak sebagai penghubung antara departemen teknik dan departemen lain, menyampaikan status proyek, tonggak sejarah, dan tantangan.
  • Peningkatan Proses dan Operasi: (1) Terus meningkatkan proses teknik dan alur kerja untuk meningkatkan efisiensi dan produktivitas.; (2) Terapkan dan tegakkan praktik terbaik untuk pengembangan perangkat lunak, termasuk standar pengodean, tinjauan kode, dan praktik pengujian; (3) Identifikasi dan terapkan alat dan teknologi untuk merampingkan pengembangan dan operasi.
  • Kolaborasi Lintas Fungsi: (1) Bekerja sama erat dengan departemen lain seperti manajemen produk, desain, dan devops untuk memastikan keselarasan dan koordinasi; (2) Berpartisipasi dalam inisiatif dan proyek lintas fungsi sesuai kebutuhan; (3) Mewakili tim teknik dalam rapat dan diskusi dengan departemen lain
  • Manajemen Kinerja dan Akuntabilitas: (1) Tetapkan tujuan dan harapan kinerja yang jelas untuk tim teknik; (2) Minta pertanggungjawaban anggota tim atas kinerja dan perilaku mereka; (3) Tangani masalah dan konflik kinerja secara tepat waktu dan konstruktif; (4) Kenali dan berikan penghargaan kepada anggota tim atas kontribusi dan pencapaian mereka.
  • Perencanaan dan Visi Strategis: (1) Berkontribusi pada pengembangan tujuan dan visi strategis tim teknik; (2) Menyelaraskan tujuan tim teknik dengan prioritas strategis perusahaan secara keseluruhan; (3) Memberikan masukan dan umpan balik tentang OKR/peta jalan produk dan teknologi.
raw_requirements:
• 9+ tahun pengalaman sebagai Software Engineer atau pemimpin yang memecahkan masalah pelanggan
  • 3+ tahun pengalaman sebagai Manajer SDM yang telah memimpin dan mengembangkan tim teknik berkinerja tinggi.
  • Gelar Sarjana, lebih disukai dalam Ilmu Komputer
  • Pemahaman yang kuat tentang pemrograman berorientasi objek, konkurensi, dan dasar-dasar ilmu komputer.
  • Keterampilan pemecahan masalah, struktur data, dan algoritma yang kuat.
  • Anda suka membangun layanan yang tangguh, terukur, dan berkinerja.
  • Anda bangga dengan pencapaian Anda, tetapi juga bertujuan untuk menjadi lebih baik setiap hari secara terus-menerus.
  • Keterampilan teknis dan pemikiran kritis yang kuat, dan kemampuan untuk mengomunikasikan visi Anda pada tingkat tinggi kepada audiens teknis dan manajemen puncak
  • Berpartisipasi dan berkontribusi dalam diskusi/keputusan arsitektur.
  • Memiliki pengalaman dalam:
    • Java, XML, J SON, Junit, Scala / Kotlin, Algoritma, dll.
    • REST, Graph QL, Layanan Mikro
    • Apache Tomcat, Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Docker
    • AWS: EC2, S3, RDS. Kubernetes, Redis
    • Alat Pemantauan dan Pemberitahuan seperti New Relic dan PagerDuty.
  • Bekerja dalam lingkungan yang serba cepat, datar, gesit, dan terdistribusi adalah pilihan Anda untuk terus mengembangkan karier Anda

title: Solution Architect Analyst - AID
raw_description:
1. Mengidentifikasi dan mengevaluasi teknologi baru serta peluang peningkatan arsitektur sistem.
  2. Menyusun dan memelihara dokumentasi arsitektur Level 0-2.
  3. Merancang solusi arsitektur untuk mendukung proyek dan inisiatif bisnis.
  4. Melakukan review terhadap arsitektur proyek untuk memastikan kesesuaian dengan standar dan kebijakan yang berlaku.
  5. Memastikan dokumentasi seluruh sistem selalu terkini dan terpelihara.
  6. Melakukan pemetaan aset digital, integrasi sistem, dan alur data (data flow).
  7. Memastikan penerapan prinsip dan standar arsitektur (architecture guardrails) selama proses implementasi.
  8. Menentukan ruang lingkup proyek, batasan, dependensi, serta risiko yang terkait.
  9. Menerjemahkan kebutuhan bisnis menjadi desain arsitektur teknis yang tepat.
  10. Menyiapkan presentasi, diagram, dan dokumentasi teknis untuk mengomunikasikan solusi arsitektur kepada para pemangku kepentingan.
raw_requirements:
1. Pendidikan minimal Sarjana (S1) di bidang Ilmu Komputer, Informatika, atau bidang terkait.
  2. Memiliki pengalaman kerja 1-3 tahun sebagai Solution Architect atau pada posisi yang relevan.
  3. Memiliki keahlian di bidang Application Development, DevSecOps, Cloud, atau domain teknologi sejenis.
  4. Menguasai perancangan arsitektur aplikasi, integrasi sistem, infrastruktur/cloud, serta aspek keamanan (security).
  5. Memiliki kemampuan dalam desain database, praktik DevOps, analisis kebutuhan (requirement analysis), dan penyusunan dokumentasi teknis.
  6. Memiliki pemahaman bisnis yang baik, visi strategis, serta berorientasi pada kebutuhan pelanggan (customer focus).
  7. Penempatan di Astra Integrasi Digital (AID)
