title: Sr Officer-ERP System Support
raw_description:
Role Purpose

To act as the primary Person In Charge (PIC) for the ERP platform on the IOH side, serving as the key functional and technical point of contact between business users, IT, and the Managed Services Partner (vendor/mitra). This role is responsible for day-to-day platform ownership — including business requirement coordination, master data and configuration integrity, and cross-module functional oversight — as well as governing the partner's delivery of L1, L2, and L3 Application Managed Services (AMS) across the ERP ecosystem, System Integration, on prem/cloud infrastructure related, middleware, ensuring operational stability, SLA compliance, effective Change Request (T&M) delivery, and adherence to IOH governance, reporting, security, and service acceptance (BAST) standards.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the single Point of Contact (PIC) for ERP system matters on the IOH side; gather and consolidate business requirements from process owners; prioritize and validate enhancement/CR proposals prior to partner execution; safeguard master data, Chart of Accounts, and configuration integrity across modules; provide functional guidance to business users on system usage and process alignment, system integration, and infrastructure utilization awareness.
  • Act as the primary IOH counterpart for the ERP Ecosystem Managed Services Partner; monitor day-to-day delivery of L1/L2/L3 support across ERP ecosystem, Surrounding system, system integration, infra utilization, license monitoring; ensure the partner operates within the agreed operating model, service window, and escalation matrix.
  • Monitor and validate the partner's compliance to SLA targets (response/resolution time per P1-P4, System and integration uptime, First Time Fix Rate); review incident trend and aging-ticket reports; drive corrective action for SLA breaches.
  • Oversee incident and problem management performance across L1/L2/L3 tiers; validate Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and CAPA for P1/P2 incidents; review and endorse Change Request documentation (FDS/TDS), T&M consumption, and enhancement delivery against approved scope.
  • Coordinate impact assessment, regression testing, and stabilization activities for ERP system mandatory quarterly cloud updates; ensure partner readiness and risk mitigation prior to patch deployment.
  • Lead and/or participate in daily operational standups, weekly service reviews, the monthly Executive Steering Committee, and the quarterly Patch & Strategy Alignment forum with the partner; consolidate reporting for management visibility.
  • Ensure the partner adheres to IOH IAM/MFA access standards, data confidentiality requirements, and change governance (no production change without an approved CR and roll-back plan); maintain audit evidence of access and change activities.
  • Validate monthly service evidence (SLA summary, RCA/CAPA, ticket tracker, UAT sign-offs) submitted by the partner and process monthly BAST acceptance in line with IOH governance standards.

Qualification

  • Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in ERP/IT operations, including at least 2 years in ERP system (Oracle Fusion ERP & EPM) implementation, support, or vendor/managed services governance within a large enterprise environment. Experience overseeing L1/L2/L3 Application Managed Services and SLA-based vendor management is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion ERP/EPM modules (GL, AP, AR, FA, PPM, Procurement, Tax, FCCS/TRCS/EDMCS), OCI infrastructure, and OIC integration concepts; understanding of ITSM/ITIL incident, problem, and change management processes; SLA and vendor performance management; strong analytical, reporting, and stakeholder communication skills; proficient in MS Office and reporting tools; good command of English (written and verbal).

  • Oversee incident and problem management performance across L1/L2/L3 tiers; validate Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and CAPA for P1/P2 incidents; review and endorse Change Request documentation (FDS/TDS), T&M consumption, and enhancement delivery against approved scope.

Qualification

  • Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in ERP/IT operations, including at least 2 years in ERP system (Oracle Fusion ERP & EPM) implementation, support, or vendor/managed services governance within a large enterprise environment. Experience overseeing L1/L2/L3 Application Managed Services and SLA-based vendor management is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion ERP/EPM modules (GL, AP, AR, FA, PPM, Procurement, Tax, FCCS/TRCS/EDMCS), OCI infrastructure, and OIC integration concepts; understanding of ITSM/ITIL incident, problem, and change management processes; SLA and vendor performance management; strong analytical, reporting, and stakeholder communication skills; proficient in MS Office and reporting tools; good command of English (written and verbal).

title: Head of Home Business Performance & Insights
raw_description:
Role Purpose

 

Lead FTTH and FWA annual operating planning, financial outlooks, and business case evaluation, providing clear analysis for VP review and supporting management and shareholder decisions on profitable growth and investments.

 

Key Responsibilities

  1. Lead the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) for FTTH and FWA, aligning subscriber, revenue, operating cost, CapEx, profitability, and cash flow targets with business strategy and execution plans.
  2. Lead periodic financial outlooks, including 3+9, 6+6, and 9+3 forecasts, incorporating actual performance, updated assumptions, risks, and opportunities; explain variances against the AOP and recommend actions to close gaps.
  3. Lead business case development and investment appraisal for FTTH rollout and partnerships, assessing home-pass potential, take-up rates, contractual commitments, financial returns, and capital efficiency.
  4. Evaluate FWA investment and commercial models, aligning network capacity, customer demand, device lifecycle costs, and deployment readiness; oversee scenario and sensitivity analyses across FTTH and FWA.
  5. Coordinate cross-functional inputs and prepare shareholder presentations, management reports, responses to stakeholder inquiries, and ad hoc analyses, ensuring clear insights and recommendations for VP review before submission.
  6. Oversee performance against approved plans and business cases, drive corrective actions with business owners, maintain planning and investment governance, and guide the Senior Officer’s work.

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • At least seven years of relevant experience in business planning, commercial finance, investment analysis, or consulting, including experience leading projects or analytical teams.
  • Proven experience leading annual budgets, AOP development, and periodic financial forecasts.
  • Strong expertise in financial modelling, investment appraisal, cash flow analysis, NPV, IRR, and scenario assessment.
  • Experience evaluating telecommunications or broadband investments, with an understanding of FTTH and FWA business models and economics.
  • Proven ability to challenge assumptions, align cross-functional stakeholders, and translate complex analysis into clear management and shareholder presentations.
  • Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, with strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, and business communication skills.
  • Experience using AI tools to support financial analysis, market research, scenario modelling, and presentation preparation is an added advantage, with the ability to independently validate outputs and protect confidential business data.

title: Head of Sales Planning & Operation
raw_description:
Long Description

Role Purpose:

The AVP of Postpaid Policy & Development  is responsible for driving the strategic growth and development of the postpaid business. This role involves setting monthly business targets, leading postpaid-related projects, analyzing business profitability outlook, and creating policies that ensure the continuous improvement and success of the postpaid business. The AVP will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams in HQ & Circle to enhance the company’s competitiveness and market share in the postpaid segment, focusing on revenue growth, cost management, and operational efficiency.

Long Description

Scope of Work:

Area of Responsibilities

Key Activities

Monthly target Setting

Develop and set clear, measurable postpaid sales and performance targets on a monthly basis in alignment with the company’s overall objectives.

Coordinate with all stake holders to align on target metrics such as revenue growth, customer acquisition, and retention rates.

Monitor and track the achievement of targets, providing insights and recommendations for upcoming target distribution

Postpaid Project Leadership

Lead and oversee strategic postpaid-related projects, including Prepaid to Postpaid Conversion initiatives and the Indosat Preferred Partner Project, aimed at improving customer acquisition, Revenue uplift, and sales channel expansion

Engage with Circles to foster &  enhance project penetration.

Postpaid Business Outlook Analysis

Create Postpaid Business Case

Analyze and assess the postpaid business performance, focusing on key metrics such as cost ratio, revenue growth, and profitability.

Identify opportunities to optimize revenue versus cost by evaluating trends

Prepare regular business performance reports and present insights to senior management, proposing strategies for enhancing the postpaid portfolio's contribution to overall revenue.

Policy Creation & Development

Formulate and implement policies that govern the postpaid business, KPI, target, way of working, & overall business process

Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices while driving innovation in policy development.

Collaborate with legal, finance, and operational teams to ensure that policies are aligned with broader organizational goals and market conditions.

Monitor & provide RCE capability measurement thru quis & KPI performance analysis

 

Requirements

Qualification:

Bachelor's degree in Business Management, Marketing, Telecommunications, or a related field. A Master’s degree is preferred.

Related Experience:

  • Minimum 3-5 years of experience in postpaid business development, policy creation, or sales management within the telecommunications industry.
  • Proven experience in leading projects and initiatives with cross-functional teams.

Hard Skills:

  • MS Office : Proficiency in Operating MS Office tools especially Excel & word
  • Data analytic: Understanding of databases and data warehouse architectures, including tools
  • Business Process development capability
  • Data Visualization Tools especially Ms Power Point

 

Soft Skill:

  • Problem-Solving: Ability to troubleshoot issues related to data collection, transformation, and storage.
  • Communication: Good communication skills to collaborate with data scientists, business analysts, software engineers, and stakeholders to understand data requirements.
  • Strong understanding of postpaid business dynamics, including revenue management, cost control, and profitability optimization.
  • Leadership and project management skills, with a demonstrated ability to deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex data and present actionable insights to senior leadership.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills for building strong relationships with internal teams and external partners.
  • Proficient in creating and implementing sales policies, business development strategies, and optimizing operational efficiency.

title: VP-Head of Financial Non Bank
raw_description:
Role Purpose

VP-Head of Sales is responsible for leading multiple sales teams through Sales Managers to drive segment-level revenue growth, strategic account expansion, and long-term customer value.
This role focuses on defining and executing sales strategies across a portfolio of accounts, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and market opportunities. VP-Head of Sales provides direction and oversight to AVP-Head of Sales or any Account Directors, ensuring consistent execution of account plans, pipeline development, and performance management across teams.
In addition, the role requires strong engagement with senior customer stakeholders, guidance on complex sales opportunities, and oversight of forecasting and business performance. VP-Head of Sales acts as a key link between senior leadership and the sales organization, ensuring strategies are effectively translated into execution and delivering sustainable business growth.

Job Details

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop end-to-end IT solutions for B2B Financial Non Bank clients.
  • Translate business needs into functional and technical specifications.
  • Identify technological enhancements to drive operational efficiency and customer value.
  • Collaborate with the sales team to understand client needs and strategic direction.
  • Conduct client meetings to gather requirements and present solution options.
  • Provide technical support in client presentations and negotiations.
  • Define project scope, objectives, technical requirements, timelines, and budgets.
  • Align internal teams and resources based on project milestones.
  • Monitor and report project progress against targets.
  • Stay current with trends and emerging technologies in supply chain, energy, and digital transformation.
  • Proactively recommend innovations and technology applications.
  • Drive digital enablement across B2B client solutions.
  • Coordinate across IT, product, and operations teams to ensure solution delivery.
  • Lead multidisciplinary teams during solution development and implementation.
  • Provide coaching and mentoring to solution architects and analysts.

 

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Master’s Degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, or relevant field is preferred.
  • Minimum 12–15 years of professional experience in IT solution development, enterprise systems, digital infrastructure, ICT, cloud computing, ERP
  • At least 5-7 years in a leadership role managing large-scale, cross-functional projects
  • Proven experience in designing and implementing technology-driven solutions for B2B clients in the Financial Non Bank sector
  • Strong background in working directly with enterprise clients and senior stakeholders
  • Strategic thinking and commercial acumen in B2B technology environments.
  • Strong project management and budgeting skills.
  • Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, cost-effective technical solutions.
  • Leadership, mentoring, and cross-functional team collaboration abilities.
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, client-driven environments.
  • Proven track record in driving segment/portfolio-level revenue growth
  • Strong experience in strategic account management and large-scale deals
  • Experience leading large sales organizations or multi-region coverage

title: Lead of Procurement Fertilizer (Pekanbaru)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Lead of Procurement Fertilizer (Pekanbaru)

Daftar Sekarang

Pekanbaru, Pekanbaru City, Riau, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full Time (Full WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

As a Procurement Executive, you will play a key support role within the Procurement team. Under the guidance of the Procurement Head, you will help manage the sourcing and purchasing of goods and services, maintain supplier relationships, and ensure all procurement processes follow company policies and industry best practices. This position offers an excellent opportunity to learn and grow within the agritech and palm oil sectors.

You will be responsible to:

Process purchase requests (PR) and purchase orders (PO) in a timely and accurate manner.

Coordinate with internal departments (e.g., Finance, Operations) to clarify requirements and confirm specifications.

Support the Procurement Lead in evaluating new and existing suppliers by collecting and organizing relevant data (quality, pricing, delivery performance).

Maintain up-to-date records of supplier information, contracts, and pricing agreements.

Assist in resolving supplier-related issues, including product discrepancies, shipment delays, and invoice queries..

Conduct basic market research to benchmark prices and identify cost-saving opportunities.

Ensure all procurement activities align with company policies.

Maintain accurate and organized procurement records, including contracts, delivery notes, and invoices.

Monitor inventory levels of key supplies (e.g., fertilizers, agrochemicals, equipment) and notify the Procurement Lead of potential shortages.

Kualifikasi

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Agriculture, or related fields.

6+ years of relevant experience in procurement, supply chain, or related fields (preferably in agriculture or commodities). Must experience in Palm Oil Industry and handling Fertilizer products.

Basic knowledge of procurement processes, supplier evaluation, and contract management.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); familiarity with e-procurement tools or ERP (Odoo) systems is a plus.

Strong analytical, strategic, and problem-solving abilities.

Fluent in English and Bahasa Indonesia, both written and spoken.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across diverse teams.

Ability to work under tight deadlines and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.

Placement at Pekanbaru City.

Mandarin Speakers is point plus.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the Palm Oil industry. SawitPRO develops an integrated end-to-end agri-platform, creating a win-win-win for people, planet and profit. Our missions are to improve the livelihood of Indonesia’s smallholders, to unlock value for the industry, and to strive in a demanding global market in traceability and sustainability of palm oil products.

We provide platforms that connect the supply chain stakeholders within the palm oil industry (i.e. Palm Oil Mills, Agents, Smallholders, and Agri Input vendors), create a digital ecosystem that removes friction points, and essentially boosts the productivity of the smallholders via access to affordable yet high quality agro-inputs, agronomic services, and high-quality planting materials.

We envision to be the game-changer that improves smallholders’ living standard, and helps our planet to meet the growing global demand for sustainable palm oil.

title: [Talent Pool] Supply Chain Management (Kalimantan)
raw_description:
< Kembali

[Talent Pool] Supply Chain Management (Kalimantan)

Daftar Sekarang

Central Kalimantan, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full-Time (Full WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

SawitPRO is expanding its operation supply chain team into Kalimantan and is building a strong talent pipeline to support our future growth. We are looking for passionate and driven professionals with experience in Supply Chain to join our Talent Pool.

Open Position:

Warehouse Team (Supply Chain Coordinator, Warehouse Operator, etc.)

Logistic Team (Transport and Hub, First Last Mile, etc.)

General Responsibility:

Support end-to-end supply chain operations, including logistics, warehousing, inventory, and distribution.

Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to ensure the smooth flow of materials and operational activities.

Monitor inventory levels and ensure timely availability of materials and supplies.

Track inbound and outbound shipments to ensure on-time delivery and operational efficiency.

Analyze supply chain performance and identify opportunities for process improvements.

Prepare operational reports and maintain accurate supply chain documentation.

Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and safety standards.

Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance supply chain efficiency and effectiveness.

Kualifikasi

Bachelor's degree (S1) in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Agribusiness, or a related field.

Experience in Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics, Warehouse, Inventory Management, Distribution, or other related functions is preferred.

Strong understanding of supply chain principles and operational processes.

Good analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Microsoft Excel.

Experience with ERP systems (Odoo) or Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) is an advantage.

Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment.

Willing to travel for business purposes when required.

Willing to be based in Kalimantan according to business needs.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is a cutting-edge green digital agritech startup located in the heart of Jakarta. Our mission is to be the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the palm oil industry. Through our integrated end-to-end agri-platform, we create a win-win-win scenario for people, planet, and prosperity.

We provide integrated apps that connect the supply chain stakeholders in the palm oil industry (Mills, DO Agents, Smallholders, Harvesters, Drivers, etc.). Creating a digital ecosystem that essentially boosts their productivity with effortless work documentation, affordable yet original agri-inputs, and agronomist services.

Our commitment extends beyond providing innovative solutions; we aim to nurture every aspect of Indonesia's palm oil industry. By fostering growth and sustainability, we strive to bring positive change to the lives of individuals in the palm oil sector, one at a time.

title: Fleet Assessor Associate
raw_description:
Fleet Assessor Associate

Team

Operations

Location

BSD, Tangerang, Indonesia

Job Type

Full-time

The role at a glance

Skills you need

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know the Team

We are Grab Rentals ID. We provide fleet supply to Grab, serving the non bank-able partner to work as Grab's driver-partner. In the Fleet team, we identify opportunities to maintain the competitive cost to serve through maintenance strategy, strategic partnership and excellence process in vehicle operating process. We are serving 11 cities and in Jabodetabek we have 5 different pool locations.

Get to Know the Role

We are seeking a Fleet Assessor Associate to join our team in our BSD Pool, Tangerang, Indonesia. In this role, you will be responsible for conducting comprehensive assessments and inspections of fleet vehicles to ensure compliance with maintenance standards, safety regulations, and operational requirements. You will play a critical role in maintaining the integrity and performance of our fleet operations through evaluation and documentation. You will report to the Assistant Manager of Fleet Insurance & Disposal.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

Conduct assessments of vehicle condition, performance, and maintenance needs using diagnostic tools and established safety standards.

Promptly detect mechanical issues, wear, and potential safety risks to support interventions.

Ensure all fleet vehicles align with industry safety regulations and organizational policies.

Systematically organize and update inspection data and findings within fleet management systems for complete transparency.

Track operational patterns to uncover opportunities for fleet-wide efficiency, safety enhancements, and preventative care.

Share diagnostic findings and recommended corrective actions openly with team members to resolve issues.

Manage inspection schedules thoughtfully to ensure all evaluations are completed within agreed-upon timelines.

Prepare clear, accessible reports and presentations that support informed decision-making across diverse organizational teams.

Read more

Skills you need

What Essential Skills You Will Need

Bachelor's degree in Automotive / Mechanical Engineering, Business Administration or related technical field.

At least 3 years of experience in fleet assessment, vehicle operations, or structured vehicle inspections.

title: Medco E & P Indonesia - Piping / Mechanical Supervisor (TPC)
raw_description:
Medco E & P Indonesia is looking for an experienced Piping / Mechanical Supervisor to join our team through a Third-Party Contract (TPC). In this role, you will contribute to Sakakemang PSC, an upstream oil and gas project located in South Sumatra and operated by MedcoEnergi. Currently in the development phase, the project is progressing toward First Gas/First Production, with start-up targeted for Q3 2027.


In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing, supervising, and assuring mechanical construction and installation activities at site to ensure safe, high-quality, and timely execution in compliance with Operator standards, contractual requirements, and applicable codes and regulations. The role provides field-level technical authority and oversight, ensuring that EPC contractors and subcontractors execute mechanical works in accordance with approved designs, procedures, and HSSE requirements, while safeguarding Operator interests.



Key Responsibilities



Mechanical Construction Supervision

  • Supervise and monitor mechanical construction activities, including piping, static equipment, rotating equipment, structural supports, and mechanical packages.
  • Ensure contractors perform work in compliance with approved drawings, specifications, work procedures, and method statements.
  • Verify that construction sequencing aligns with project priorities, schedule, and commissioning readiness.
  • Identify construction issues, deviations, or constructability concerns and escalate appropriately.



Health, Safety & Environment (HSE)

  • Enforce Operator HSE standards, life-saving rules, and procedures at all times.
  • Ensure all mechanical construction works are performed under valid work permits, risk assessments and approved method statements.
  • Actively participate in toolbox talks, safety walks, audits, and inspections.
  • Report and follow up on HSE observations, near-misses, incidents, and corrective actions.
  • Promote a strong safety leadership culture.



Quality Assurance & Control

  • Ensure mechanical works comply with Operator quality standards, international codes and project QA/QC plans.
  • Coordinate with QA/QC and inspection teams for hold points, witness points, and inspections.
  • Verify proper installation, alignment, torqueing, welding, testing, and preservation activities.
  • Ensure timely resolution and close-out of mechanical punch lists and non-conformities.



Contractor & Interface Management

  • Supervise EPC contractors and subcontractors, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations.
  • Monitor contractor manpower, equipment, and work-front readiness.
  • Coordinate mechanical interfaces with civil, electrical, instrumentation, and commissioning teams.
  • Support resolution of site execution conflicts and interface issues.



Schedule, Progress & Cost Control

  • Monitor daily and weekly mechanical work progress against the approved schedule.
  • Identify potential delays, interface issues, or construction constraints and report to the Construction Superintendent / Construction Manager.
  • Support progress measurement and verification for contractor reporting and milestones.
  • Assist in assessing field variations or changes impacting scope, schedule, or cost.



Reporting & Documentation

  • Prepare and submit daily and weekly construction reports, including progress, HSE, manpower, and key issues.
  • Maintain site records, inspection logs, and construction documentation.
  • Participate in site coordination meetings, progress meetings, and HSE meetings.



Commissioning & Handover Support

  • Support pre-commissioning and commissioning activities, including cleaning, gauging, hydrotesting, drying, and line filling.
  • Participate in walk-downs, mechanical completion, and system handover activities.
  • Ensure preservation, integrity, and handover documentation are complete and compliant.
raw_requirements:
• Minimum bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Civil Engineering or related discipline.
  • Minimum 13 years of experience in piping/mechanical construction, installation, and supervision within oil & gas projects.
  • Minimum 2 years of proven experience in supervisor role as a Piping/Mechanical Supervisor, Site Supervisor, or Construction Supervisor.
  • Previous experience working for Operators/Owners is essential. 
  • Strong technical knowledge of construction and installation practices.
  • Solid knowledge of HSE regulations and international standards.
  • Ability to read and interpret drawings, alignment sheets, specifications, and procedures.
  • Familiarity with international codes and standards.
  • Strong field supervision, coordination, and problem-solving skills. 
  • English B2 (Upper Intermediate) Level.


Disclaimer: The selected candidate will be engaged on a contract basis through a third-party company appointed by MedcoEnergi. This role supports MedcoEnergi's projects and business objectives, and is delivered in alignment with the Company's standards, governance, and operational requirements.

title: Medco E & P Indonesia - Supervisor Pipeline Construction (TPC)
raw_description:
Medco E & P Indonesia is looking for an experienced Supervisor Pipeline Construction to join our team through a Third-Party Contract (TPC). In this role, you will contribute to Sakakemang PSC, an upstream oil and gas project located in South Sumatra and operated by MedcoEnergi. Currently in the development phase, the project is progressing toward First Gas/First Production, with start-up targeted for Q3 2027.


In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing and assuring pipeline construction activities at site, ensuring all works are executed safely, in compliance with Operator standards, approved designs, contractual requirements, and applicable international codes.



Key Responsibilities


The role provides field-level supervision and technical governance, safeguarding Operator interests by ensuring EPC contractors and subcontractors deliver pipeline works with the highest standards of HSSE, quality, and schedule performance.

Pipeline Construction Supervision


Supervise and monitor all pipeline construction activities, including:

  • Right-of-Way (ROW) preparation (Stringing, bending, welding, NDT; Coating, field joint coating; Lowering-in, backfilling, and reinstatement)
  • Ensure construction activities comply with approved drawings, specifications, method statements, and construction procedures.
  • Verify that construction sequencing aligns with approved schedules, environmental constraints, and commissioning priorities.
  • Identify field execution issues, deviations, or constructability concerns and escalate appropriately.

Health, Safety & Environment (HSE)

  • Enforce Operator HSE standards, life-saving rules, and procedures at all times.
  • Ensure all pipeline construction works are performed under valid work permits, risk assessments and approved method statements.
  • Actively participate in toolbox talks, safety walks, audits, and inspections.
  • Report and follow up on HSE observations, near-misses, incidents, and corrective actions.
  • Promote a strong safety leadership culture.

Quality Assurance & Control

  • Ensure pipeline construction complies with international pipeline codes and standards and Operator specifications.
  • Coordinate with QA/QC teams to witness welding, NDT, coating, pressure testing, and inspection activities.
  • Verify proper documentation of weld records, NDT results, coating reports, and hydrostatic test data.
  • Ensure timely identification, rectification, and close-out of punch list items and non-conformities.

Contractor & Interface Management

  • Supervise EPC contractors and subcontractors, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations.
  • Monitor contractor manpower, equipment, and work-front readiness.
  • Coordinate pipeline interfaces with civil, mechanical, station facilities, and commissioning teams.
  • Support resolution of site execution conflicts and interface issues.

Schedule, Progress & Cost Control

  • Monitor daily and weekly pipeline construction progress against approved schedules.
  • Validate contractor-reported progress through field verification.
  • Provide accurate progress input to Construction Superintendent / Construction Manager and Project Controls team.
  • Escalate schedule risks, environmental constraints, or stakeholder-related issues affecting pipeline works.

Reporting & Documentation

  • Prepare and submit daily and weekly civil construction reports, including progress, HSE, manpower, and key issues.
  • Maintain site records, inspection logs, and construction documentation.
  • Participate in site coordination meetings, progress meetings, and HSE meetings.

Commissioning & Handover Support

  • Support mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, and commissioning activities.
  • Ensure mechanical systems are completed in accordance with Mechanical Completion (MC) and System Completion (SC) requirements.
  • Participate in walk-downs, system handover, and readiness reviews.
  • Ensure preservation and handover documentation is complete and accurate.

  • Minimum 13 years of experience in mechanical construction, installation, or supervision within oil & gas projects.
  • Proven experience with minimum 2 years’ experience as a Field Supervisor or Pipeline or Mechanical Supervisor, or Construction Supervisor role.
  • Previous experience working for Operators/Owners is essential.
  • Strong technical knowledge of pipeline construction and installation practices.
  • Good understanding of pipeline, installation, testing, and preservation.
  • Good understanding of HSE management in oil & gas construction environments. 
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and construction schedules. 
  • Familiarity with international codes and standards.
  • Strong field supervision, coordination, and problem-solving skills. 
  • English B2 (Upper Intermediate) Level.

title: Searah Muara Bakau - Subsea Operations Technical Professional
raw_description:
Purpose 

  • To ensure the subsea inspection, repair & maintenance activities involving diving, ROV and Vessel services for Company subsea assets to safely maintain the integrity of the subsea facilities in full compliance with legislation and company standards. 
  • To ensure the subsea capital spares and inventory being preserved, maintained and optimized. 
  • To ensure the subsea intervention project in the pursuit of sustaining or enhancing an existing asset's production perform effectively and efficiently.


Main Accountabilities and Responsibilities 

Technical: 


  • Deliver the Subsea Facilities Integrity Management System (SFIM) and ensuring compliance/delivery/reporting with refers to MSG Operation Annex D and BP-SVI-ENG-004. 
  • Provide support for Technical Integrity for Development Project (opi_svi_021 AIM in Development Phase) & for carryover activities (warranty call) related SFIM, PIM (subsea), refers on OPI_OPE_040_Handover. 
  • Responsible for SECE Management related with subsea facilities based on OPI HSE 021. 
  • Manage Inspection, Maintenance and Repair (IMR) for all subsea production system and infrastructure including flow lines, pipelines, risers, SSIV and other subsea equipment. 
  • Review impact of anomalies and making any recommendations for remedial work. 
  • Maintain SFIM documentation for assets review and updating the Inspection Data Management System (IDMS) related to Subsea Facilities. 
  • Ensure Subsea Facilities have appropriate preventive maintenance and inspection plan frequency for their service. 
  • Optimize the IMR strategies with demonstrable improvements and value add to the assets. 
  • Develop SFIM documentation for any new assets. 
  • Control and optimize Critical spares & Inventory of Subsea Equipment including preservation requirements. 
  • Prepare long-terms work plans and budgets for activities associated with subsea (& pipelines) inspection, repair and maintenance across all facilities (spend, resources, schedule, logistics) and delivering plan against budget. 
  • Ensure planning & implementation of subsea facilities integrity contract and compliance with pre- and post-award management procedure (preparation of mandatory documents for PR until close out). 
  • Support to manage subsea minor intervention project in the pursuit of sustaining or enhancing an existing asset's production. 
  • Support to control and maintenance of the cross asset subsea integrity database. 
  • Provide operations technical input to Projects Departments, Engineering Departments and Drilling & Completion Departments including Decommissioning Projects and support the Project Development process with discipline peer reviews. 
  • Manage interaction with the relevant authorities, SKK Migas and Classification Society for Subsea matters including requests for legal consent, reviews and safety directive inspections. 
  • Manage any external support organisations for effective and efficient delivery of support services. This includes healthy challenge to scope of works and cost, time & resource estimates ensuring maximum value to Company. 
  • Provide Support Audit/Assessment based on MSG operations. 


 Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ): 


  • Comply with rules and standards described in Company Policies, HSE Integrated Management System and Procedures 
  • Report all incidents 
  • Motivate staff and colleagues to comply with HSE rules and standards 
  • Participate in HSE related initiatives
raw_requirements:
Qualifications & Experience 

  • Education: Minimum Bachelor Degree in Engineering (Preferably in Automation / Electric / Instrument / Mechanical / Ocean Engineering) or equivalent subjects 
  • Professional Qualification: Minimum 10 years of working experience in operational, subsea and pipeline integrity management/delivery with Oil and Gas Operators 
  • Certification, Training, and Courses: Offshore survival and medical certificates – qualified to visit and work offshore 
  • Language: Proficient in English and Bahasa Indonesia 


Required Competencies 

Technical Competencies 

  • Experience with oil and gas operations (topsides and subsea), associated equipment classes, and corresponding risks from a technical and practical standpoint.  
  • Experience with operational subsea IMR management, delivery and optimization. Sound appreciation of inspection, repair and maintenance activities and techniques. 
  • Familiar with project/developments/operations/drilling & completion and typical oil company processes. 


Non-Technical Competencies 

  • Proactive approach to HSE and technical performance 
  • An effective communicator (translate between on & offshore)  
  • Working knowledge of Subsea integrity data systems, Synergy, Maximo, Regulatory HSE reporting requirements in UKCS  
  • Knowledge of relevant legislation, standards and best practices in the subsea  


Working Conditions 

  • Location: Jakarta, Indonesia 
  • Possibility for business travel to other Company’s premises or field areas

title: Searah Muara Bakau - Land Transport Supervisor
raw_description:
Purpose:

To plan, coordinate, and supervise daily land transportation activities to support drilling, production, project, and exploration operations. The role ensures the safe, reliable, and cost-effective execution of land transport services, including personnel transportation and material deliveries, while ensuring compliance with Company standards, regulatory requirements, and contractual obligations. This role also coordinates with internal stakeholders and transport contractors to optimize fleet utilization, delivery schedules, and operational efficiency, resolves day-to-day transportation issues, monitors contractor performance, and drives continuous improvement initiatives to enhance service reliability, safety, and cost performance. 


General Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

  • Plan, coordinate, and supervise daily light vehicle transportation services to support drilling, project, production, and corporate operations.  
  • Ensure the availability, reliability, and optimum utilization of contractor light vehicle fleets to meet operational requirements.  
  • Manage transportation requests, vehicle allocation, trip scheduling, and dispatch activities to ensure safe and timely service delivery.  
  • Monitor contractor performance to ensure compliance with Company HSE standards, contractual obligations, and applicable transportation regulations.  
  • Coordinate fleet maintenance, inspections, licensing, and statutory certifications to maintain vehicle readiness and regulatory compliance.  
  • Monitor transportation performance, fleet utilization, and operating costs, and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance safety, efficiency, and cost effectiveness. 
  • Coordinate daily transportation requests, vehicle allocation, driver assignments, and dispatch activities to ensure timely and efficient service delivery.  
  • Monitor fleet availability, vehicle utilization, and contractor performance to support operational requirements.  
  • Verify vehicle documentation, driver qualifications, maintenance status, and statutory compliance prior to deployment.  
  • Monitor transportation operations and promptly resolve service disruptions, vehicle breakdowns, and operational issues.  
  • Maintain transportation records and prepare daily operational and performance reports.  
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders and contractors to ensure safe, reliable, and cost-effective transportation services.

Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ):

  • Comply with rules and standards described in Company Policies, HSE Integrated Management System and Procedures.
  • Report all incidents.
  • Motivate staff and colleagues to comply with HSE rules and standards.
  • Participate in HSE related initiatives.
raw_requirements:
Qualifications & Experience:

  • Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in Industrial Engineering, Logistics or other equivalent subjects.
  • Experience:
    • Minimum of 5 years of experience in Land Transportation or logistics operations within the oil and gas industry.  
    • Experience in supporting offshore drilling, production, or project operations is preferred.
  • Language: Proficient in English and Bahasa Indonesia


Required Competencies

Technical Competencies:

  • Good knowledge of land transportation operations, fleet management, transportation planning, and contractor management within the oil and gas industry. 
  • Good understanding of HSE requirements, road transportation regulations, and statutory compliance applicable to light vehicle operations.  
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and transportation reporting systems, with good written and spoken English communication skills.  

 

Non-Technical Competencies:

  • Strong planning, coordination, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to manage multiple operational priorities.  

 

Working Conditions:

  • Location: Balikpapan, Indonesia – Rotational
  • Possibility for business travel to other Company’s premises or field areas

title: Prime Natuna EP - Fixed Infrastructure Sr. Mechanical & Piping Engineer
raw_description:
Responsible for Designing Mechanical and Piping Engineering system for Fixed Infrastructure and support End-to-End Platform delivery/Construction Process to ensure its safe and optimum Project delivery as well as reliable Operation.

Areas of Accountability, Responsibility and Competence:

  • ​Ensure proper procedures in place and in line with the Standard Engineering and statutory requirements prior any Fabrication, Testing, Lifting, Transportation, Installation and Hook up commissioning activities. 
  • Ensure high quality of Mechanical and Piping Engineering design for Fixed infrastructure as per company requirement.
  • ​Perform Mechanical and Piping Engineering studies for Fixed infrastructure
  • ​Provide Technical input for Tender Plan, Technical Evaluation and Presentation related to Mechanical and Piping items. 
  • ​Ensure all P&ID, Piping Plan, Isometric Drawings, Assembly Drawings and Equipment Layout are up to Date and properly documented and have easy access for references. 
  • ​Provide Offshore Mechanical and Piping Engineering and Design work, ensuring Quality, Budget and Schedule are met.
  • ​Provide Conceptual routing studies, Engineering Execution Planning.
  • ​Provide Mechanical and Piping technical deliverables and ensure they are delivered.
  • ​Review and comment on 3D model, Procedures, Material Classes, Vendor Data and Study Reports.
  • ​Provide Construction Assistance.
  • ​Coordinate and Direct Drafters, Check Drawings and other Documents.
  • ​Interface with Contractors, Project Managers and ensure coordination between Mechanical Piping and other discipline.
  • ​Manage Interface issues between Floating Infrastructure and Fixed Infrastructure in related to Mechanical and Piping discipline (if applicable)
  • ​Response to any Technical query regarding any issues related to Mechanical and Piping based on latest standard Engineering Practice 
  • ​Develop Mechanical and Piping Engineering report for Management in a timely manner.
  • ​Ensure Construction, Pre-Commissioning, and Start-up activities for Mechanical and Piping Systems are delivered safely as per Company requirement.
raw_requirements:
Qualification / Work Experience:

  • ​​​​​​Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering. 
  • ​Min. 15 years experiences in Mechanical and Piping Engineering role within the Oil & Gas industry, with strong exposure to Offshore Fixed Infrastructure Projects, preferably covering FEED, detailed engineering, and construction phases.
  • ​Extensive experience in Offshore Piping Layout and Design, with involvement as Piping Engineer in at least 2(Two) Offshore Projects.
  • ​Proven experience in FEED verification, Detail Engineering/Design and Construction support for Offshore Oil & Gas Facilities
  • ​Experience in FPSO Topside or other Offshore Floating Facilities is preferred, particularly where Interface with Fixed Infrastructure is required.
  • Experience in Vendor Engineering and Technical Review, including review of Vendor Drawings, Datasheets, and Technical Documentation.
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken) with the ability to Effectively Communicate and Coordinate with Multidisciplinary Project Teams

Special Skills / Knowledge:

  • ​In-depth knowledge of detailed Engineering and Design of Mechanical and piping system for Offshore Facilities, with comprehensive knowledge of applicable Codes and Standards such as ASME, ASTM, NACE, ANSI, TEMA, API, NPFA and AWS.
  • ​Strong Technical Knowledge of Mechanical Static Equipment and Piping Systems, including Pressure Vessels, Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchangers, Process Skids, Columns, Piping, Valves, and Associated Equipment.
  • Strong capability in Piping Engineering and Design, including Piping Layout, Material Classes, P&ID Review, Piping Stress requirements, Insulation, Passive Fire Protection (PFP), and requisitioning of Piping Materials and Components.
  • Comprehensive understanding of Fabrication, Construction, Installation, and Commissioning requirements for Mechanical Equipment and Piping Systems, including Interfaces with Procurement, Vendors, and Construction activities.
  • Proficiency in Mechanical and Piping Engineering/Design Tools, including PDMS or equivalent 3D Plant Design Systems, supported by Good Understanding of Piping Engineering Workflows and Multidisciplinary Design Interfaces

title: Prima Energy - HSE Inspector (CPP/FPSO/FSO)
raw_description:
Role Overview

Conduct HSE inspections and monitor offshore activities to identify hazards, ensure compliance with HSE procedures and applicable regulations, and support safe, reliable, and environmentally responsible operations.

2. Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct routine and targeted HSE inspections, identify unsafe acts and conditions, and follow up corrective actions.
  • Monitor compliance with PTW, JSA/JHA, risk assessments, LOTO, SIMOPS, and other HSE requirements.
  • Monitor high-risk activities, including lifting, confined space entry, hot work, working at height, pressure testing, and marine operations.
  • Inspect emergency response equipment, participate in emergency drills, and support incident investigations.
  • Monitor environmental protection, waste management, hazardous materials, and spill prevention measures.
  • Report incidents, near misses, and HSE deviations, and maintain accurate inspection records and reports.
  • Conduct toolbox talks, safety briefings, and HSE awareness activities.
  • Monitor contractor HSE performance and verify personnel competency and certification for critical activities.
  • HSE Management System, HIRADC/HAZID, JSA/JHA, PTW, SIMOPS, and LOTO.
  • Emergency response, fire and gas systems, process safety, hydrocarbon release prevention, and incident investigation.
  • Marine safety, personnel transfer, helideck safety, lifting operations, dropped object prevention, evacuation, and working over water.
  • Environmental management, contractor HSE management, and safety reporting.
raw_requirements:
Minimum Qualifications

  • Diploma (D3) or Bachelor's degree (S1) in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, Environmental Engineering, or any major related discipline.
  • Minimum 7–10 years of HSE experience in oil & gas, marine, petrochemical, or heavy industry, preferably including 3–5 years of offshore experience.
  • Experience in offshore production facilities, such as WHP, CPP, FPSO/FSO, drilling rigs, or offshore construction facilities.

Certifications

  • AK3 Umum / relevant K3 competency certification.
  • BOSIET/FOET, H2S Awareness, and basic firefighting for offshore deployment, as applicable.
  • Competency in PTW, risk assessment/JSA, incident investigation, and emergency response.
  • First aid, working at height, confined space, lifting and rigging, and LOTO certifications are preferred.

title: Head of FWA Sales
raw_description:
Role Purpose
Deliver FWA subscriber acquisition and acquisition revenue through productive, compliant sales territories and channels, strengthening direct-sales execution across 4G and 5G propositions.

Scope of Work 
1. Target Cascade — Translate Circle targets into branch, cluster and sales-force objectives by addressable market and product proposition.
2. Field Sales Leadership — Lead branch reviews, pipeline discipline, field coverage, sales quality and corrective action on underperforming territories.
3. Channel Mix — Increase productive direct sales while coordinating with partner-led channels under national commercial direction.
4. Conversion & Activation — Coordinate with delivery teams to move qualified leads and sales orders through successful activation.
5. Sales Force Effectiveness — Partner with capability teams on onboarding, deployment, performance and field coaching.
6. Quality & Controls — Drive compliant selling, valid customer registration and early-life usage quality.

Requirements
Education and experience
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Operations or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience. Strong experience managing consumer field sales, channel productivity and geographically distributed sales teams.

Functional competencies
Territory management; sales forecasting; channel execution; sales quality; coaching. Strong spreadsheet, presentation and reporting literacy appropriate to the role.

Behavioral competencies
Ownership and follow-through; clear communication; collaboration across functions; analytical problem-solving; customer and commercial orientation. Leadership and decision complexity should be assessed in proportion to actual role scope.

title: Community Engagement Officer - Sumatra
raw_description:
Role Purpose

To develop local community relationships and lead community-based on-ground engagement activities that increase Home Business awareness, generate qualified leads, and support subscriber acquisition across FTTH and FWA. The role builds partnerships with residential communities and local stakeholders, drives product education and referral initiatives, and works closely with Circle Sales to convert community engagement into measurable business outcomes.

Scope of Work (SOW)

  1. Community Mapping & Prioritization — Identify and prioritize residential communities, housing complexes, property managers, resident associations, and local stakeholders based on Home Business market potential and service availability.
  2. Community Relationship Management — Build and maintain relationships with community leaders, residential management, property developers, and other relevant stakeholders to strengthen market access and engagement.
  3. On-Ground Activation & Engagement — Plan and execute community-based activations, resident gatherings, door-to-door engagement, product demonstrations, and promotional activities to increase product awareness and consideration.
  4. Product Education & Consumer Engagement — Communicate the benefits and suitability of FTTH and FWA to residents, helping them understand product options, service availability, and the registration process.
  5. Lead Generation & Referral Programmes — Develop community-driven lead generation initiatives, referral programmes, and local engagement activities in coordination with Circle Sales to support subscriber acquisition.
  6. Partnership Development — Establish mutually beneficial partnerships with residential communities, property management, and relevant local organizations to create sustainable acquisition channels.
  7. Performance Monitoring & Improvement — Track activation results, community participation, qualified leads, referral performance, and subscriber conversion; use insights to improve engagement effectiveness.

 

Requirements

Education and experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Public Relations, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in community engagement, field marketing, event activation, partnership development, sales activation, or a related role.
  • Experience in telecommunications, property, FMCG, or consumer services is an advantage.
  • Experience managing field teams, activation partners, or community stakeholders is preferred.

Functional competencies

  • Strong understanding of community engagement and on-ground activation.
  • Ability to build relationships with community leaders, property management, and local partners.
  • Experience planning events, product demonstrations, and referral or lead-generation programmes.
  • Understanding of lead qualification, sales handover, and conversion tracking.
  • Ability to monitor activity performance and prepare basic reports.

Behavioural competencies

  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
  • Persuasive communication and presentation skills.
  • Proactive, hands-on execution and problem-solving.
  • Commercial orientation and results-driven mindset.
  • Strong coordination skills and adaptability to field-based work.

title: Fiber Base Management - Sumatra Officer
raw_description:
Role Purpose

Support sustainable FTTH subscriber retention by monitoring account health, payment and usage signals, and coordinating approved rebuy and win-back activity.

Scope of Work

1. FTTH Base Health — Review payment activity, tenure cohorts and churn risks across serviceable Fiber accounts.

2. Early-Life Monitoring — Flag onboarding and installation-related problems affecting continued subscription.

3. Proactive Retention — Coordinate approved win-back and customer save programs with national functions.

4. Customer Outreach — Support appropriate renewal, payment reminder and engagement campaigns.

5. Issue Routing — Refer technical service problems to Home CX and Fiber delivery owners.

6. Reporting — Summarize survival, churn and recovery trends and recommend local actions.

Requirements

Education and experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Operations or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience. Experience in fixed broadband customer lifecycle, service support or retention operations.

Functional competencies

Customer cohort analysis; retention execution; issue coordination; customer contact. Strong spreadsheet, presentation and reporting literacy appropriate to the role.

Behavioral competencies

Ownership and follow-through; clear communication; collaboration across functions; analytical problem-solving; customer and commercial orientation. Leadership and decision complexity should be assessed in proportion to actual role scope.

title: AVP of Commercial (Pekanbaru/Medan)
raw_description:
< Kembali

AVP of Commercial (Pekanbaru/Medan)

Daftar Sekarang

Sumatra, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full-Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

As

AVP of Commercial

, you will lead and integrate SawitPRO’s

Customer Experience, Commercial, B2B Sales, Customer Management, Growth, Marketing, and Performance

functions into one cohesive strategy.

You will be responsible for building and scaling SawitPRO’s relationship with key stakeholders across the palm oil ecosystem, particularly

Palm Oil Mills, mill suppliers/agents, FFB Ramps, and other B2B partners

.

This role combines

commercial leadership and customer experience

, with a strong focus on driving customer acquisition, engagement, retention, revenue growth, and long-term ecosystem development.

You will work closely with the CEO and other senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Operations, Marketing, and other functions to translate customer and market insights into business growth and strategic outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Experience & Commercial Strategy

Develop and execute SawitPRO’s overall

Customer Experience and Commercial strategy

, aligned with the company’s business objectives.

Own the end-to-end customer journey, from

customer acquisition, onboarding, activation, engagement, growth, to retention

.

Identify opportunities to improve customer experience while maximizing commercial value and revenue.

Develop strategic initiatives, new channels, business models, and partnerships to accelerate growth.

Build and continuously improve the roadmap and budget for the Experience and Commercial portfolio.

2. B2B Sales & Customer Management

Own the commercial relationship with SawitPRO’s key B2B customer segments, including

Palm Oil Mills, suppliers/agents, FFB Ramps, and other supply-chain stakeholders

.

Develop strategies to acquire, activate, grow, and retain B2B customers and partners.

Understand customer motivations, pain points, business opportunities, competitive landscape, and growth potential.

Build long-term strategic relationships with key customers and ecosystem partners.

Optimize revenue opportunities across the existing customer base.

Establish a strong customer service and relationship management approach to ensure high customer satisfaction and retention.

3. FFB Commercial Growth

Lead the commercial strategy for

FFB source acquisition, conversion, and customer management

.

Identify and develop new markets, customer segments, partnerships, and distribution channels to expand SawitPRO’s FFB ecosystem.

Build strategic partnerships with mills, suppliers, ramps, and other relevant stakeholders.

Work closely with internal teams to accelerate the acquisition and activation of FFB sources and maximize their commercial potential.

4. Customer Growth & Engagement

Drive customer growth through

customer intelligence, growth marketing, engagement programs, partnerships, campaigns, and ecosystem development

.

title: Head of Creative, Marketing (Pekanbaru/Medan)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Head of Creative, Marketing (Pekanbaru/Medan)

Daftar Sekarang

Sumatra, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full-Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Memberikan arahan kreatif secara menyeluruh untuk seluruh organisasi.

Bertanggung jawab atas keseluruhan ekuitas merek (brand equity) SawitPRO, termasuk positioning di pasar.

Bertanggung jawab atas positioning produk dan merek untuk seluruh produk dan layanan SawitPRO.

Memimpin dan mengelola strategi konten untuk proyek berskala kecil maupun besar, termasuk membuat pedoman dan template untuk desain merek, copywriting, visual, dan aset digital.

Melakukan audit terhadap seluruh hasil karya kreatif dari berbagai tim serta memberikan saran perbaikan untuk meningkatkan keterlibatan dan pengalaman pengguna.

Berpartisipasi dalam seluruh sesi kreatif dan brainstorming dari berbagai tim untuk memberikan ide-ide baru dan inovatif dalam pengembangan produk, peluncuran kampanye pemasaran, serta operasional bisnis.

Mengembangkan pemahaman yang mendalam mengenai persona pelanggan sasaran dan berperan sebagai konsultan internal dalam menentukan pendekatan yang efektif maupun yang kurang efektif bagi pengguna.

Mengajarkan tim untuk mendorong batas kreativitas meskipun dengan keterbatasan anggaran dan waktu.

Tanggung Jawab Utama

Kreativitas Pemasaran - Mengawasi, membimbing, dan mengarahkan hasil kreatif dari seluruh kampanye pemasaran SawitPRO, baik secara online maupun offline.

Kreativitas Desain Produk - Melakukan audit dan memberikan rekomendasi perbaikan terhadap desain produk yang dikembangkan oleh tim Product Management.

Tim Loyalty Management - Membantu dalam proses ideasi, pembuatan, dan perancangan konsep-konsep baru yang inovatif untuk mendorong pertumbuhan program loyalitas.

Tim Customer Experience - Bekerja sama dengan tim eCommerce dan Sales untuk menciptakan ide-ide kreatif yang dapat meningkatkan penjualan produk eCommerce maupun produk offline. Meningkatkan keterlibatan dan loyalitas pelanggan.

Kreativitas Operasional - Bekerja sama dengan tim operasional untuk merancang dan menghasilkan cara-cara kreatif dalam menjalankan operasional bisnis, mulai dari pengelolaan kantor, pengumpulan umpan balik pengguna, pengiriman produk, hingga penyelenggaraan webinar bagi pengguna.

Mengawasi tim lintas fungsi yang terdiri dari Graphic Designer, Copywriter, Social Media Specialist, Photographer/Videographer, dan Product Manager dalam pengembangan strategi komunikasi serta hasil kerja yang akan disampaikan.

Menyelenggarakan sesi brainstorming bersama tim kreatif dengan tetap menerapkan pemikiran strategis untuk menghasilkan inisiatif yang inovatif, dapat diterapkan, dan tetap mempertimbangkan efisiensi anggaran.

Menunjukkan kepemimpinan dan kemampuan manajemen tim yang memadai dalam mendorong pelaksanaan ide-ide kreatif di dalam tim kreatif.

Kualifikasi

Pendidikan

Gelar Sarjana (S1) di bidang Computer Graphics, Game Design, Graphic Design, Industrial Design, Product Design, Interior Design, atau bidang seni kreatif lainnya.

Pengalaman

Minimal 10 tahun pengalaman bekerja sebagai Copywriter, Graphic Designer, Production Artist, Game Designer, Sketch Artist, Interior Designer, atau bidang kreatif terkait.

Memiliki pengalaman dalam mengembangkan model bisnis yang inovatif serta mengembangkan saluran bisnis, model bisnis, atau transformasi bisnis.

Memiliki pengalaman di industri yang berorientasi pada konsumen seperti Fast Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG), perbankan konsumen, asuransi digital, FinTech, sharing economy, dan sejenisnya menjadi nilai tambah.

Memiliki rekam jejak yang terbukti dalam menghasilkan desain kreatif mulai dari tahap ide hingga implementasi.

Memiliki pengetahuan tentang industri kelapa sawit menjadi nilai tambah.

Memiliki pemahaman yang mendalam mengenai berbagai saluran komunikasi, pemasaran, dan periklanan, baik online maupun offline.

Memiliki pengalaman yang terbukti dalam mengelola tim, stakeholder, serta mengawasi proyek desain berskala besar.

Pengetahuan/Keterampilan

Memiliki pemahaman yang mendalam mengenai perilaku, motivasi, dan karakteristik manusia.

Memiliki kemampuan kreativitas visual dan desain grafis yang sangat baik, serta memahami penggunaan warna, tipografi, tata letak, bahasa, persepsi manusia, dan elemen desain lainnya.

Memiliki pemahaman bisnis yang kuat, termasuk pengetahuan spesifik mengenai industri manufaktur, perusahaan berbasis sumber daya alam, serta unit bisnisnya.

title: E-Commerce Executive (Pekanbaru/Medan)
raw_description:
< Kembali

E-Commerce Executive (Pekanbaru/Medan)

Daftar Sekarang

Pekanbaru, Pekanbaru City, Riau, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full-Time (Full WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Primary Responsibilities

Own, lead and drive the eCommerce business of SawitPRO called Toko Sawit

To drive the online demand for goods and services sold by SawitPRO

Work with different departments to ensure a comprehensive eCommerce strategy for capturing market share, market development and sales of toko Sawit

Ensure high adoption of Toko Sawit

Define the SLAs for Toko Sawit online business

Work closely with operations team to ensure on-time fulfillment of online orders

Own P&L responsibility of Toko Sawit constantly driving towards higher revenues and profits

Role of the eCommerce Executive

eCommerce Strategy

- Develop, own and constantly update end to end eCommerce business strategy for Toko Sawit through innovation and creativity

Customer Experience Management

- Ensure highest standards of online shopping experience for Toko Sawit customers

Category Management

- Ensure the most sought after products are always listed in the product catalog of Toko Sawit. Continuously source for high revenue, high profit products to be listed on Toko Sawit

Revenue Management

- Come up with innovative pricing strategies for products to optimise revenues while serving the

best price guarantee

of SawitPRO

Sales Growth

- Maximise sales revenues for online sales through constant growth of customer base, product catalog, best pricing and customer satisfaction

User adoption

- Ensure high levels of recurring revenue from the existing users, referral business and other strategies for highest standards of user adoption

Promotions and marketing

- Work with marketing team to launch innovative online marketing campaigns and promotions for building the SawitPRO and Toko Sawit brands

Partnerships

-

Collaborate with partnership team to maximise online to offline (O2O) sales, revenues and profits

Performance monitoring

- Constantly monitor Toko Sawit performance to ensure maximum availability of Toko Sawit products. Close inventory monitoring with the operations team to maximize product availability across all regions

eCommerce Loyalty

- Develop loyalty programs for online shopping

Execution KPIs

– clearly define execution goals and KPIs to deliver on the experience portfolio of the organization

P & L

- Manage revenue and costs generated from the online user base

Kualifikasi

Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Business or Marketing discipline is required.

Experience

Min. 2 years’ experience working in eCommerce business, preferably with some independent P&L responsibilities

Experience in innovating business models and developing new channels, business models or business transformation

Palm oil industry knowledge would be helpful

title: Event Organizer (Pekanbaru)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Event Organizer (Pekanbaru)

Daftar Sekarang

Pekanbaru, Pekanbaru City, Riau, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Summary

:

The Event Marketing Coordinator plays a crucial role in the promotion and execution of events related to a digital loyalty platform specific to the Palm Oil Industry, with a focus on the Upstream and Midstream sectors. This role involves planning and coordinating various marketing activities, including trade shows, conferences, webinars, and industry networking events. The Event Marketing Coordinator works closely with cross-functional teams, industry partners, and stakeholders to ensure successful event experiences that drive engagement and enhance the platform's visibility in the market.

Responsibilities:

Event Planning and Execution: Plan, coordinate, and execute events aligned with the marketing strategy and objectives of the digital loyalty platform in the Palm Oil Industry. This includes identifying suitable events, managing event logistics, coordinating with vendors, and ensuring timely execution.

Event Marketing: Develop and implement event marketing campaigns to promote events and generate attendance. Utilize various channels, such as email marketing, social media, and industry publications, to maximize event visibility and attract target audiences.

Collateral and Content Development: Create event-related collateral, such as brochures, presentations, and promotional materials. Collaborate with the marketing team to develop compelling event content, including speaker profiles, session descriptions, and educational resources.

Industry Networking: Establish and maintain relationships with industry associations, organizations, and influencers. Actively participate in industry networking events and build strategic partnerships to expand the platform's reach and enhance its industry presence.

Event Analysis and Reporting: Measure and evaluate event performance through post-event analysis. Analyze metrics, such as attendance, lead generation, and attendee feedback, to assess event success and provide insights for future event planning and optimization.

Budget Management: Develop event budgets, track expenses, and ensure adherence to allocated budgets. Negotiate contracts and agreements with vendors, venues, and service providers to maximize cost-effectiveness.

Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with the marketing team, sales team, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure event strategies align with overall marketing and business goals. Coordinate with internal teams to secure speaker participation, organize product demonstrations, and provide event support.

Project Management: Effectively manage multiple event projects simultaneously, ensuring deadlines, deliverables, and budgets are met. Employ project management methodologies to streamline processes, enhance efficiency, and improve overall event experiences.

Kualifikasi

Requirements:

Education: Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business administration, or a related field. Relevant certifications in event management are a plus.

Experience: 3-5 years of experience in event planning, event marketing, or related roles. Experience in organizing and executing events within the Palm Oil Industry or a similar industry is highly desirable.

Industry Knowledge: Strong understanding of the Palm Oil Industry, specifically the Upstream and Midstream sectors. Familiarity with industry events, trade shows, conferences, and key stakeholders is preferred.

Event Management: Demonstrated experience in event planning, logistics management, and execution. Proven ability to handle multiple events simultaneously, work under pressure, and meet tight deadlines.

Marketing and Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create compelling event content and effectively communicate event details to diverse audiences. Proficiency in social media marketing and email marketing is desirable.

Relationship Building: Strong networking and relationship-building skills to engage with industry partners, vendors, and event participants. Ability to establish and maintain relationships with key stakeholders.

Analytical and Reporting Abilities: Proficiency in analyzing event data, generating reports, and extracting actionable insights. Strong attention to detail in tracking event metrics and measuring event success.

Budgeting and Financial Management: Experience in event budget development, expense tracking, and contract negotiation. Ability to manage budgets effectively and maximize cost-efficiency.

Creativity and Problem-Solving: Innovative thinking and problem-solving skills to overcome challenges, identify opportunities, and enhance event experiences. Ability to think strategically and deliver unique event concepts.

Flexibility and Adaptability: Willingness to work in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. Ability to adapt plans and strategies based on changing priorities and emerging industry trends.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the Palm Oil Industry.

Our mission is to develop an integrated end-to-end agri-platform, creating a win-win-win for People, Planet and Prosperity. Our Vision is to help palm oil smallholders become more PROficient in farming practices, so that they can produce more FFB crop, resulting in greater PROsperity for indigenous communities, also creating PROfitability for our business, PROtection of the natural environment and PROgress of Indonesia

SawitPRO is a game-changer, improving the smallholders’ living standard and helping our planet to meet the growing global demand for sustainable palm oil through efficient land use.

Industry Networking: Establish and maintain relationships with industry associations, organizations, and influencers. Actively participate in industry networking events and build strategic partnerships to expand the platform's reach and enhance its industry presence.

Event Analysis and Reporting: Measure and evaluate event performance through post-event analysis. Analyze metrics, such as attendance, lead generation, and attendee feedback, to assess event success and provide insights for future event planning and optimization.

Budget Management: Develop event budgets, track expenses, and ensure adherence to allocated budgets. Negotiate contracts and agreements with vendors, venues, and service providers to maximize cost-effectiveness.

Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with the marketing team, sales team, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure event strategies align with overall marketing and business goals. Coordinate with internal teams to secure speaker participation, organize product demonstrations, and provide event support.

Project Management: Effectively manage multiple event projects simultaneously, ensuring deadlines, deliverables, and budgets are met. Employ project management methodologies to streamline processes, enhance efficiency, and improve overall event experiences.

Kualifikasi

Requirements:

Education: Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business administration, or a related field. Relevant certifications in event management are a plus.

Experience: 3-5 years of experience in event planning, event marketing, or related roles. Experience in organizing and executing events within the Palm Oil Industry or a similar industry is highly desirable.

Industry Knowledge: Strong understanding of the Palm Oil Industry, specifically the Upstream and Midstream sectors. Familiarity with industry events, trade shows, conferences, and key stakeholders is preferred.

Event Management: Demonstrated experience in event planning, logistics management, and execution. Proven ability to handle multiple events simultaneously, work under pressure, and meet tight deadlines.

Marketing and Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create compelling event content and effectively communicate event details to diverse audiences. Proficiency in social media marketing and email marketing is desirable.

Relationship Building: Strong networking and relationship-building skills to engage with industry partners, vendors, and event participants. Ability to establish and maintain relationships with key stakeholders.

Analytical and Reporting Abilities: Proficiency in analyzing event data, generating reports, and extracting actionable insights. Strong attention to detail in tracking event metrics and measuring event success.

Budgeting and Financial Management: Experience in event budget development, expense tracking, and contract negotiation. Ability to manage budgets effectively and maximize cost-efficiency.

Creativity and Problem-Solving: Innovative thinking and problem-solving skills to overcome challenges, identify opportunities, and enhance event experiences. Ability to think strategically and deliver unique event concepts.

Flexibility and Adaptability: Willingness to work in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. Ability to adapt plans and strategies based on changing priorities and emerging industry trends.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the Palm Oil Industry.

Our mission is to develop an integrated end-to-end agri-platform, creating a win-win-win for People, Planet and Prosperity. Our Vision is to help palm oil smallholders become more PROficient in farming practices, so that they can produce more FFB crop, resulting in greater PROsperity for indigenous communities, also creating PROfitability for our business, PROtection of the natural environment and PROgress of Indonesia

SawitPRO is a game-changer, improving the smallholders’ living standard and helping our planet to meet the growing global demand for sustainable palm oil through efficient land use.
