title: Odoo Functional - GSI
raw_description:
Lowongan pekerjaan ini dipublikasikan melalui akun PT Global Service Indonesia. Kandidat terpilih akan menjadi karyawan PT Global Service Indonesia dengan penempatan di United Tractors Group (UT Group).

  1. Melakukan analisis kebutuhan bisnis pengguna, khususnya pada proses akuntansi dan keuangan, untuk diterapkan ke dalam sistem Odoo ERP.
  2. Melakukan konfigurasi dan implementasi modul Odoo Accounting, termasuk pengaturan Chart of Accounts, jurnal, pajak, vendor bills, customer invoices, pembayaran, dan rekonsiliasi bank.
  3. Mengumpulkan dan mendokumentasikan kebutuhan pengguna melalui proses requirement gathering, penyusunan Business Requirement Document (BRD), serta pemetaan proses bisnis (business process mapping).
  4. Melakukan pengujian sistem (functional testing dan UAT) untuk memastikan konfigurasi Odoo sesuai dengan kebutuhan bisnis.
  5. Memberikan pelatihan dan pendampingan kepada pengguna terkait penggunaan modul Accounting pada Odoo.
  6. Melakukan identifikasi masalah, analisis kendala, serta koordinasi dengan tim teknis untuk penyelesaian permasalahan sistem.
  7. Menyusun dokumentasi konfigurasi, panduan penggunaan, dan laporan implementasi sistem.
  8. Memberikan dukungan pascaimplementasi serta melakukan evaluasi untuk meningkatkan efektivitas proses akuntansi menggunakan Odoo.
raw_requirements:
1. Pendidikan minimal S1 Akuntansi, Sistem Informasi, Teknik Informatika, atau bidang lain yang relevan.
  2. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun sebagai Odoo Functional Consultant, Odoo Functional, ERP Functional Consultant, atau posisi sejenis.
  3. Memahami proses bisnis akuntansi dan keuangan, seperti General Ledger, Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), jurnal umum, perpajakan, dan rekonsiliasi bank.
  4. Memiliki pengalaman menggunakan dan melakukan konfigurasi Odoo ERP, khususnya modul Accounting.
  5. Memahami proses implementasi ERP, mulai dari requirement gathering, analisis kebutuhan, konfigurasi sistem, functional testing, UAT, hingga user training.
  6. Mampu menyusun dokumentasi kebutuhan bisnis, functional specification, test scenario, dan user manual.
  7. Memiliki kemampuan analisis, pemecahan masalah, komunikasi, dan koordinasi yang baik dengan pengguna maupun tim teknis.
  8. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim serta berorientasi pada penyelesaian masalah dan kebutuhan pengguna.

  11. Mendukung keterlibatan tingkat eksekutif, negosiasi, dan diskusi kemitraan.

title: Sales Fertilizer, Seedling, and Palm Oil Plantation (Pekanbaru)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Sales Fertilizer, Seedling, and Palm Oil Plantation (Pekanbaru)

Daftar Sekarang

Pekanbaru, Pekanbaru City, Riau, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Contract

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Tanggung Jawab Utama

Mengidentifikasi dan mendapatkan prospek (lead) baru serta membangun basis pelanggan yang berkelanjutan.

Mengembangkan dan mengelola pipeline prospek untuk secara konsisten mencapai target bulanan.

Secara proaktif mencari prospek baru melalui berbagai strategi pendekatan langsung.

Mengelola seluruh proses penjualan, mulai dari kontak awal dengan prospek hingga proses penutupan penjualan.

Membangun dan menjaga hubungan yang baik dengan prospek, serta memastikan keterlibatan mereka selama seluruh siklus penjualan.

Mendukung aktivitas yang berorientasi pada pencapaian pendapatan sesuai dengan Business Plan perusahaan.

Bekerja sama dengan tim internal untuk memastikan implementasi strategi berjalan dengan lancar dan efektif.

Peran Sales Executive

Customer Service - Berfokus pada akuisisi dan retensi pelanggan melalui pendekatan layanan pelanggan yang berkualitas.

Mengoptimalkan dan memaksimalkan peluang pendapatan dari basis pelanggan yang ada.

Memberikan pengalaman pelanggan yang berkualitas melalui kombinasi produk, layanan, dan pengelolaan hubungan dengan pelanggan.

Kualifikasi

Gelar Sarjana (S1) dari semua jurusan.

Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2 tahun di bidang penjualan (Sales) atau Business Development. Kandidat yang memiliki pengalaman di industri agribisnis akan menjadi nilai tambah.

Memiliki rekam jejak yang terbukti dalam menghasilkan peluang bisnis dengan hasil yang nyata.

Memiliki jaringan yang luas di industri kelapa sawit.

Memiliki pemahaman yang mendalam mengenai industri kelapa sawit.

Mampu melakukan kegiatan canvassing dan wajib memiliki kendaraan pribadi.

Mampu berkomunikasi dengan baik dalam Bahasa Indonesia dan Bahasa Inggris.

Bersedia ditempatkan di Pekanbaru

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO adalah startup agritech digital hijau yang inovatif dengan kantor pusat di Jakarta. Misi kami adalah menjadi inovator terbaik yang mampu meningkatkan kualitas hidup seluruh pelaku di industri kelapa sawit. Melalui platform agrikultur terintegrasi dari hulu hingga hilir (end-to-end), kami menciptakan manfaat bagi manusia, lingkungan, dan keberlanjutan bisnis.

Kami menyediakan aplikasi terintegrasi yang menghubungkan seluruh pemangku kepentingan dalam rantai pasok industri kelapa sawit, seperti Pabrik Kelapa Sawit (PKS), Agen DO, Pekebun Swadaya, Pemanen, Pengemudi, dan pihak terkait lainnya. Kami membangun ekosistem digital yang mampu meningkatkan produktivitas melalui dokumentasi pekerjaan yang lebih mudah, akses terhadap sarana produksi pertanian yang terjangkau dan terjamin keasliannya, serta layanan agronomis profesional.

Komitmen kami tidak hanya menghadirkan solusi yang inovatif, tetapi juga mendukung pertumbuhan dan keberlanjutan industri kelapa sawit Indonesia. Kami percaya bahwa melalui inovasi dan kolaborasi, kami dapat memberikan dampak positif bagi kehidupan setiap pelaku di industri kelapa sawit.

Daftar Sekarang

location: Jl. Raya Bogor, KM 26.6, Kel. Pekayon, Kec. Pasar Rebo, Jakarta Timur  - Jakarta Timur
raw_description:
• Perform tipping operations for sugar and milk powder into silos according to production requirements and mixing schedules.

  • Coordinate raw material requests with Warehouse forklift operators to ensure timely material availability for production.

  • Operate conveyor dumpers and hydraulic lifting table dumpers in accordance with operating procedures and safety standards.

  • Ensure accurate and proper transfer of raw materials into designated silos, following material handling procedures and production instructions.

  • Record and monitor raw material mass balance to maintain accurate records of materials received, consumed, and remaining.

  • Complete production administration and operational reports for tipping dumper activities accurately and on time.

  • Perform cleaning and sanitation of equipment and work areas in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and food manufacturing hygiene standards.

  • Maintain workplace cleanliness and organization through effective housekeeping and 5S practices.

  • Comply with Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) requirements, Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) standards, and applicable safety procedures when operating equipment and handling raw materials.
raw_requirements:
• Minimum Diploma (D3), preferably in:

    • Food Technology

    • Biology

    • Chemistry

    • Agricultural Industrial Technology

    • Other relevant STEM fields.

  • Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.

  • Proficient in basic arithmetic, including addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division, to support material calculations and mass balance recording.

  • Detail-oriented in material recording, measurement, and production reporting.

  • Basic knowledge of, or willingness to learn, manufacturing processes, sanitation, GMP, and OHS in the food industry.

  • Physically fit to perform the operational duties required for the position.

  • Must not have a dust allergy that could interfere with job performance, subject to workplace exposure assessment and available risk controls.

  • Willing to work in areas involving elevated access or work at height when required, in accordance with applicable safety procedures.

  • Willing to work on a shift basis.

  • Demonstrates integrity, discipline, a strong work ethic, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively.

  • Willing to comply with personal hygiene, cleanliness, and food safety requirements in the production environment.

  • Available to join immediately.

Employment Type: PKWT (Fixed-Term Employment Agreement)

Contract Duration: 6 months

title: Sales Officer Palu - TAF
raw_description:
• Membuat simulasi kredit dan melakukan negosiasi, baik dengan dealer maupun calon pelanggan, untuk mendapatkan aplikasi pembiayaan pelanggan.
  • Melengkapi data aplikasi pembiayaan dan dokumen pendukungnya, termasuk melakukan konfirmasi melalui telepon, proses data entry, inisiasi, dan scan dokumen ke docushare untuk menunjang proses analisa kredit yang cepat dan akurat.
  • Memonitor status aplikasi pembiayaan untuk memastikan proses persetujuan kredit mencapai target SLA yang ditetapkan.
  • Menginformasikan hasil keputusan kredit kepada pihak-pihak terkait untuk memastikan informasi keputusan kredit diterima secara benar.
  • Mencetak dokumen kontrak, menjelaskan isi kontrak kepada pelanggan dan meminta tanda tangan dokumen kontrak ke pelanggan dan dealer untuk memastikan kesesuaian dengan prosedur.
  • Mengarahkan dan memberikan penjelasan cara pembayaran angsuran kepada pelanggan untuk meastikan cara bayar yang efektif dan efisien.
  • Menindaklanjuti dokumen kelengkapan kendaraan dan dokumen tagihan dari dealer untuk memastikan kelancaran proses pembayaran kendaraan ke dealer (disburse).
  • Memonitor status aplikasi backlog untuk mencapai target penjualan yang ditetapkan.
  • Memonitor pembiayaan selama 5 angsuran pertama dan bekerjasama dengan fungsi AR management dalam menyelesaikan account F5PD untuk memastikan agar pelanggan yang telah jatuh tempo memenuhi kewajibannya.
  • Menjalankan aktivitas penunjang penjualan (mendukung pameran, show room event, dll) untuk meningkatkan pencapaian sales target.
  • Membina hubungan baik dengan dealer untuk meningkatkan pencapaian sales target.
  • Memonitor produktivitas, kualitas proses dan hasil proses sales untuk mencapai target performance yang ditetapkan.
  • Memberikan pelayanan kepada pelanggan dan/atau rekan kerja sesuai dengan standar service perusahaan sebagai bagian dari pekerjaan untuk mendukung terciptanya budaya service perusahaan.
raw_requirements:
• Pendidikan minimal Diploma, terbuka untuk semua jurusan dan lulusan baru dengan IPK minimal 3.00/4.00.
  • Memiliki SIM C/A.
  • Memiliki daya tangkap, daya juang, dan kecepatan kerja yang baik.
  • Mampu berkomunikasi, bekerja sama, serta menunjukkan inisiatif tinggi dalam bekerja.
  • Bersedia ditempatkan di Palu.

title: Finance AR Analyst - TAF
raw_description:
1. Mengelola, memantau, dan mengembangkan seluruh proses transaksi perusahaan (penerimaan, penerimaan non-angsuran, dan pembayaran) untuk memastikan transaksi berjalan dengan lancar dan efektif.
  2. Memfasilitasi perencanaan dan pengembangan strategi, proses, alat kerja, serta aspek lain dalam fungsi Finance agar dapat mendukung proses transaksi perusahaan secara efektif, akurat, dan selaras dengan tujuan perusahaan.

raw_description:
1. Mengembangkan dan menjalankan strategi pipeline serta rencana akuisisi untuk layanan platform logistik transportasi dengan fokus utama pada industri otomotif.

2. Mengakuisisi pelanggan baru (hunting) serta memperluas portofolio shipper melalui kegiatan prospecting, lead generation, dan pengembangan bisnis.

3. Membangun, mengelola, dan menjaga hubungan bisnis jangka panjang dengan klien baru maupun existing (key accounts) guna memastikan kepuasan pelanggan dan repeat order.

4. Mengidentifikasi, menganalisis, dan memahami kebutuhan shipper, khususnya di sektor otomotif, untuk menawarkan solusi logistik yang sesuai dengan kapabilitas layanan perusahaan.

5. Menyiapkan, mengajukan, dan mengelola proses tender/penawaran (bidding) secara kolaboratif dengan tim internal (Finance, Operations, dan Product).

6. Melakukan analisis pasar dan kompetitor untuk mengidentifikasi peluang bisnis, tren industri, serta area peningkatan layanan.

7. Memantau dan mengevaluasi proyek pelanggan yang sedang berjalan guna meningkatkan performa layanan, efisiensi operasional, dan profitabilitas.

8. Menangani dan memantau proses Account Receivable (AR), termasuk melakukan follow-up pembayaran dan berkoordinasi dengan tim Finance untuk menjaga cash flow yang sehat.

9. Mengoptimalkan peluang dari klien existing (farming) melalui engagement berkelanjutan, cross-selling, up-selling, dan pengembangan relasi bisnis.

10. Berkolaborasi erat dengan tim Operations, Business Development, dan Product untuk memastikan kesesuaian antara demand pelanggan dan kapasitas supply serta kelancaran eksekusi proyek.

11. Menyusun dan menyampaikan laporan kinerja secara berkala (mingguan dan bulanan) terkait penjualan, pipeline pelanggan, dan status AR kepada manajemen.

title: B2B Sales Logistics - MODA
raw_description:
1. Mengembangkan dan menjalankan strategi pipeline serta rencana akuisisi untuk layanan platform logistik transportasi dengan fokus utama pada industri otomotif.
  2. Mengakuisisi pelanggan baru (hunting) serta memperluas portofolio shipper melalui kegiatan prospecting, lead generation, dan pengembangan bisnis.
  3. Membangun, mengelola, dan menjaga hubungan bisnis jangka panjang dengan klien baru maupun existing (key accounts) guna memastikan kepuasan pelanggan dan repeat order.
  4. Mengidentifikasi, menganalisis, dan memahami kebutuhan shipper, khususnya di sektor otomotif, untuk menawarkan solusi logistik yang sesuai dengan kapabilitas layanan perusahaan.
  5. Menyiapkan, mengajukan, dan mengelola proses tender/penawaran (bidding) secara kolaboratif dengan tim internal (Finance, Operations, dan Product).
  6. Melakukan analisis pasar dan kompetitor untuk mengidentifikasi peluang bisnis, tren industri, serta area peningkatan layanan.
  7. Memantau dan mengevaluasi proyek pelanggan yang sedang berjalan guna meningkatkan performa layanan, efisiensi operasional, dan profitabilitas.
  8. Menangani dan memantau proses Account Receivable (AR), termasuk melakukan follow-up pembayaran dan berkoordinasi dengan tim Finance untuk menjaga cash flow yang sehat.
  9. Mengoptimalkan peluang dari klien existing (farming) melalui engagement berkelanjutan, cross-selling, up-selling, dan pengembangan relasi bisnis.
  10. Berkolaborasi erat dengan tim Operations, Business Development, dan Product untuk memastikan kesesuaian antara demand pelanggan dan kapasitas supply serta kelancaran eksekusi proyek.
  11. Menyusun dan menyampaikan laporan kinerja secara berkala (mingguan dan bulanan) terkait penjualan, pipeline pelanggan, dan status AR kepada manajemen.
raw_requirements:
1. Pendidikan minimal S1 dari semua jurusan.
  2. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2 tahun di bidang Sales Logistics.
  3. Terbukti mampu menangani jumlah akun yang cukup besar.
  4. Berorientasi pada pelanggan, memiliki visi serta business sense yang baik.
  5. Memiliki kemampuan problem solving yang baik.
  6. Proaktif (self-starter) dengan kemampuan interpersonal, negosiasi, kepemimpinan, dan kerja tim yang sangat baik.

Memiliki dan mengembangkan hubungan pelanggan dengan pelanggan B2B SawitPRO - terutama pemasok pabrik kelapa sawit (Pabrik CPO) yang dikenal sebagai Agen DO atau FFB Suppliers.

Mendorong strategi komersial SawitPRO, dengan fokus pada growth pendapatan, perluasan pasar, dan kemitraan strategis

Mengembangkan dan melaksanakan strategi komersial komprehensif yang selaras dengan misi SawitPRO untuk meningkatkan hubungan dengan Pemasok TBS

Mengoptimalkan dan memaksimalkan peluang pendapatan dari basis pengguna

Memberikan pengalaman pelanggan berkualitas tinggi kepada pemasok TBS melalui kombinasi produk, layanan, dan manajemen hubungan

Mempelajari tingkat motivasi masing-masing pemangku kepentingan pabrik, titik kesulitan mereka, peluang bisnis dan prospek growth

Kolaborasi antar tim di seluruh produk, penjualan, operasi, sales, dan teknologi untuk meningkatkan pemahaman yang baik tentang pelanggan

Menjaga komunikasi yang efektif dengan Pemasok TBS untuk memastikan kebutuhan mereka terpenuhi dan masalah apa pun yang mungkin timbul dapat diatasi. Memastikan Pemasok dikelola secara efisien, dengan fokus pada pencapaian target keuangan dan bisnis

Membantu waktu riset pelanggan dengan pengembangan dan implementasi strategi klien, termasuk riset pasar, riset pesaing, dll.

Membantu tim pemasaran dengan identifikasi audiens target, perencanaan dan pelaksanaan kampanye.

Pengalaman di bidang kelapa sawit (FFB Purchase) diutamakan

Bersedia untuk melakukan perjalanan dinas di luar kota

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is a cutting-edge green digital agritech startup located in the heart of Jakarta. Our mission is to be the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the palm oil industry. Through our integrated end-to-end agri-platform, we create a win-win-win scenario for people, planet, and prosperity.

We provide integrated apps that connect the supply chain stakeholders in the palm oil industry (Mills, DO Agents, Smallholders, Harvesters, Drivers, etc.). Creating a digital ecosystem that essentially boosts their productivity with effortless work documentation, affordable yet original agri-inputs, and agronomist services.

Our commitment extends beyond providing innovative solutions; we aim to nurture every aspect of Indonesia's palm oil industry. By fostering growth and sustainability, we strive to bring positive change to the lives of individuals in the palm oil sector, one at a time.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is a cutting-edge green digital agritech startup located in the heart of Jakarta. Our mission is to be the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the palm oil industry. Through our integrated end-to-end agri-platform, we create a win-win-win scenario for people, planet, and prosperity.

We provide integrated apps that connect the supply chain stakeholders in the palm oil industry (Mills, DO Agents, Smallholders, Harvesters, Drivers, etc.). Creating a digital ecosystem that essentially boosts their productivity with effortless work documentation, affordable yet original agri-inputs, and agronomist services.

Our commitment extends beyond providing innovative solutions; we aim to nurture every aspect of Indonesia's palm oil industry. By fostering growth and sustainability, we strive to bring positive change to the lives of individuals in the palm oil sector, one at a time.

title: PRIME Natuna EP - FIXED INFRASTRUTURE DELIVERY MANAGER
raw_description:
Responsible to deliver, lead and manage the Fixed Infrastructure elements of Development Projects. This responsibility and accountability specifically include for delivery of inputs from contributory functions and disciplines from Project select Gate to Commencement of the Production phase, ensuring that Fixed Infrastructure elements of development Projects are delivered in a safe, quality and environmentally conscious manner in line with Budget and Schedule commitments and other agreed project KPIs per phase of each project, all whilst ensuring maximum value is obtained for key B. Whilst the initial role is specific to the Tuna PSC Asset, the role shall also support the Long-term strategic view of potential Future Developments within the Business Unit portfolio, additionally supporting the Exploration function in the Identify Phase, proposing, costing, scheduling and evaluating development options, whilst offering innovative solutions to development challenges. 

This position is critically required at the Earliest Stage to ensure effective Leadership and Coordination for the preparation of Fixed Infrastructure FEED work. Early onboarding of a qualified Project Delivery Manager will safeguard Schedule Adherence, improve Technical and Commercial Evaluation Quality, and minimize risks associated with misalignment, rework, and cost escalation during the FEED and subsequent EPCI phases.
raw_requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Project Management. Preferably with a MSc in Engineering or Business Administration.

• Minimum 10 years experience in Managerial Role for Offshore Project Development.  

• Previous experience in delivering EPCI Contracts is a mandated requirement.

• Strong Collaborative Experience and Established Relationships with SKK Migas related division. 

• Experience in Upstream Oil and Gas operations, both Pre-Production and Production Sges is an advantage.

• Preference for Knowledge of SKKMigas Rules and Regulations inclusive of a working knowledge of PTK 007 Latest revision.

• Good knowledge in Subsurface, Drilling and Production functions and their relationship with Projects.

• Good Knowledge in Project Lifecycle from FEED through Construction, Installation and Commissioning.

• Experience with Managing the Key Interfaces between Fixed and Floating Infrastructure.

• Good knowledge in Project Lifecycle from FEED through Construction, Installation and Commissioning.

• Familiar with Project Schedule, Network Planning Structures and Techniques, including proficiency with Microsoft Project. Proficiency in utilisation of Primavera Project Planner (P6) is an advantage.

• Proficient with the use of Standard Office Software such as Visio, Excel, Word and PowerPoint.

• Experience with Microsoft Access, Primavera Risk Analysis and Que$tor Tools is an advantage

• Fluent in English (written and spoken), with effective Communication Skills for Multidisciplinary Coordination and Stakeholder engagement

• Strong capability in Multidisciplinary Engineering integration for Offshore Fixed Infrastructure facilities, including in-depth understanding of Topsides, Jacket, Pipeline, Subsea, and key deliverables such as PFDs, P&IDs, HAZOP, and design basis across FEED and EPCI phases

• Advanced proficiency in Project Planning and control, covering scheduling, Cost Control, and progress monitoring, with working knowledge of tools such as Primavera P6 and MS Project

• Proven Leadership and Stakeholder Management Skills, with the ability to Lead Cross-functional and Multicultural Teams and effectively manage Clients, Contractors, Vendors, Shipyards, and JV Partners

• Strong expertise in Contract and Risk Management, including handling variations, Claims, Procurement Strategies, and proactive Risk Identification and Mitigation across the Project Lifecycle

• High commitment to HSE and Regulatory Compliance, with solid understanding of HAZID, HAZOP, SIL studies, and applicable Offshore and International standards

title: Prime Natuna EP - Floating Infrastructure Sr. Electrical Engineer
raw_description:
Responsible for designing Electrical System for FPSO Project Development and ensure its safe and optimum project delivery as well as reliable operation. 

Areas of Accountability, Responsibility and Competence:

  • ​​​Implement project requirements into Electrical design. 
  • ​Provide electrical load list, schematic diagrams, single line diagrams, cable schedules and MTO using Smart Plant Electrical. 
  • ​Perform power system studies (short circuit, coordination, motor starting, arc flash, harmonics) using ETAP. 
  • ​Perform Insulation coordination and transient study using PSCAD or EMTP software. 
  • ​Perform calculations for equipment sizing, UPS, cable sizing, lighting, grounding and heat tracing. 
  • ​Prepare specifications, data sheets, cable schedules and interface schedules. 
  • ​Produce material take-off and material requisition. 
  • ​Review Bids and Technical Evaluation. 
  • ​Design and checking of single lines, schematics and wiring diagrams, area classification, grounding, panel/cable schedules, equipment layout, cable layout, tray layout, lighting and installation details without supervision. 
  • ​Review and coordinate electrical 3D model with the other disciplines. 
  • ​Review and coordinate electrical 2D AutoCAD/ Micro-station drawings. 
  • ​Visit construction/plant sites and fabrication shops during design phase on as required basis. 
  • ​Ensure construction, pre-commissioning, and start-up activities for electrical systems are delivered safely as per company requirement. 
  • ​Develop electrical engineering report for Project Development Management in a timely manner 
  • ​Performs non-routine tasks and attends such meetings as directed from time to time by Project Development Sr. Manager as opportunity presents in order to meet Company objectives.  Ensures that all relevant managers and subordinates are kept informed of all major opportunities, developments, problems or potential problems, which will impact upon the Business.
  • Indonesian Nationality
raw_requirements:
Qualification / Work Experience:

  • ​​​​​​​​​​​​​Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering. 
  • ​Min. 15 years working experience as an electrical engineer for offshore floating infrastructure within oil and gas industry, preferably experience in project stage. 
  • ​Experienced in electrical design using Smart Plant Electrical or other electrical design software. 
  • ​ Minimum 15 years of experience in electrical engineering within the oil & gas industry, with strong exposure to offshore floating infrastructure projects, particularly FPSO, preferably covering project development, FEED, detailed engineering, and execution phases.
  • Proven experience in electrical system design and engineering for offshore floating facilities, including preparation and review of electrical engineering deliverables throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Experience in electrical engineering software and power system studies, including SmartPlant Electrical, ETAP, PSCAD/EMTP, or equivalent engineering applications.
  • Experience in construction, fabrication, pre-commissioning, and start-up support for electrical systems in offshore facilities is preferred.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with proficiency in MS Office and relevant electrical engineering tools/software.

Special Skills / Knowledge:

       • In-depth expertise in detailed engineering and design of electrical power systems for offshore floating facilities, particularly FPSO, covering power generation and distribution, electrical      equipment, cabling, grounding, lighting, UPS, and heat tracing systems.

      • Strong capability in electrical power system studies and analysis, including load flow/load assessment, short circuit, protection coordination, motor starting, arc flash, harmonics, insulation coordination, and transient studies using ETAP, PSCAD/EMTP, or equivalent tools.

      • Strong capability in developing and reviewing key electrical engineering deliverables, including load lists, single-line diagrams, schematics, equipment sizing calculations, cable schedules, equipment layouts, specifications, datasheets, material requisitions, and MTOs.

      • Comprehensive knowledge of international electrical codes, standards, and hazardous-area requirements applicable to offshore facilities, including ANSI, IEEE, IEC, NEC, NEMA, CSA, UL, API, and relevant area-classification requirements.

      • Strong multidisciplinary interface and constructability capability for FPSO electrical systems, including coordination with other engineering disciplines, 3D model reviews, vendor technical evaluations, and support during fabrication, construction, pre-commissioning, and start-up

title: Officer-Property Manager Sumapa
raw_description:
Role Purpose

This position is responsible for managing day-to-day property and building operations across Circle Sumapa. The role requires analytical thinking and effective communication with stakeholders in related with policy or any regulations that need to be implemented in the office area.

 

Scope of Work

Responsible for overseeing the daily operations, maintenance, and safety of a building or facility. This job scope includes:

1. Building Operations

  • Ensure the building is fully operational and meets safety, regulatory, and functional standards.
  • Oversee building systems, including AC, elevators, plumbing, electrical, and security systems.
  • Maintain a clean and hygienic environment.

2. Maintenance and Repairs

  • Schedule regular inspections and monitoring preventive maintenance for building equipment and infrastructure.
  • Coordinate and supervise contractors for repair or renovation work.
  • Address and resolve maintenance requests and issues promptly.
  • Monitoring MCP (Master Cleaning Program) from vendors

3. Occupant Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact for employee occupants regarding complaints, requests, and inquiries.
  • Ensure employee satisfaction by resolving issues and maintaining a high standard of building amenities.
  • Facilitate tenant move-ins and move-outs, including inspection and documentation.

4. Safety and Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with local building codes, safety regulations, and environmental standards.
  • Conduct and coordinate regular fire drills, safety checks, and emergency preparedness exercises.
  • Manage security measures, including surveillance systems and access control.

5. Financial and Administrative Duties

  • Execute the building's operating budget approved.
  • Monitoring expenditures costs
  • Prepare reports on building operations expenses.

6. Vendor and Contractor Management

  • Manage service contracts for maintenance, cleaning, security, and landscaping.
  • Monitor contractor performance and ensure compliance with agreements.

7. Energy and Sustainability Initiatives

  • Monitoring energy-saving measures to maintain operational costs and environmental impact.

8. Crisis and Emergency Response

  • Act as a contact point between building occupants and the responsible teams to facilitate communication during emergencies, such as power outages, fires, and natural disasters.
  • Relay information between the responsible internal teams and external emergency services, including police, fire, and medical teams, as needed.

9. Space Management and Optimization

  • Oversee and manage office layouts, furniture arrangements, and common area utilization.

10. Communication and Reporting

  • Maintain open communication with stakeholders.
  • Provide and present regular updates and reports on building status, and issues.

Requirements

Qualification:

  • Bachelor degree, preferably from technical background (electrical, civil, mechanical engineering, etc)
  • Able to work under pressure.
  • Able to lead and collaborate effectively in a team.
  • Have good analytical sense and problem solver.

Related Experience:

Preferably 5 years of working experience in Property & Facilities Management

Management experience required

 

Skills:

  • Expertise in property and building management
  • Demonstrate good leadership and teamwork skills
  • Highly committed to quality and timely result of the work, including problem solving
  • Have good communication skills, to interact with vary stakeholders.

raw_description:
Position Overview

 

The Vice President of Product Development & Go-to-Market Strategy is a senior executive leadership role responsible for driving the company's product innovation, market expansion, and revenue growth strategy. This position requires a visionary leader who will spearhead the development and commercialization of telecommunications products and services, with a strategic ambition to grow the subscriber base to 500,000 customers in 2 years of launch  while achieving and maintaining an Average Revenue Per User (ARPU) of USD $10

This role demands a strategic thinker with deep expertise in product lifecycle management, multi-channel go-to-market execution, customer journey optimization, and digital transformation within the telecommunications sector. The successful candidate will be instrumental in positioning the company as a competitive player in Indonesia's dynamic telco market.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 

1. Product Strategy & Conceptualization-

 
Product Vision & Roadmap: Develop and execute a comprehensive 3-5 year product strategy aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in Indonesia's telco landscape

Product Concept Creation: Lead ideation and conceptualization of innovative telecommunications products and service bundles targeting diverse customer segments (consumer, SME, enterprise)

Market Intelligence: Conduct continuous market analysis, competitive benchmarking, and customer insights gathering to identify white space opportunities and inform product development decisions

Portfolio Management:  Manage the entire product portfolio lifecycle from concept to sunset, ensuring optimal mix of revenue-generating products and strategic positioning

Product Innovation leading to growth:  Drive innovation initiatives leveraging emerging technologies (5G, IoT, digital services, fintech integration) to create differentiated value propositions

Business Case Development: Build comprehensive business cases including financial modelling, ROI projections, risk assessments, and resource requirements for new product initiatives

 

2. Product Development & Lifecycle Management

- End-to-End Product Development: Oversee agile product development processes from requirements gathering through launch, ensuring on-time and on-budget delivery

- Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with Technology, Operations, Network, Finance, and Customer Service teams to ensure seamless product development and integration

- Quality Assurance: Establish product quality standards, testing protocols, and feedback mechanisms to ensure exceptional product performance and customer satisfaction

- Pricing Strategy: Develop dynamic pricing models and promotional strategies that balance competitiveness, customer value perception, and profitability targets

- Product Enhancement: Continuously optimize existing products based on performance analytics, customer feedback, and market dynamics to maximize lifetime value

- Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all products comply with Indonesian telecommunications regulations, consumer protection laws, and industry standards

 

.

 3. Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy & Execution

- Multi-Channel GTM Strategy: Design and execute comprehensive go-to-market strategies across digital, retail, e-commerce, and partnership channels to maximize market penetration

- Channel Strategy Development:

  - Digital Channels: Develop self-service digital platforms, mobile apps, web portals, and social commerce strategies

  - Retail Channels: Optimize branded stores, dealer networks, and retail partnerships for product distribution and customer acquisition

  - E-Commerce Integration: Establish strategic partnerships with major e-commerce platforms (Tokopedia, Shopee, Lazada, Blibli) and develop marketplace strategies

  - Alternative Channels: Explore partnerships with banks, fintech platforms, and lifestyle brands for bundled offerings

- Launch Management: Plan and execute high-impact product launches with integrated marketing campaigns, sales enablement, and channel activation programs

- Sales Enablement: Develop sales tools, training materials, and incentive programs to equip sales teams for effective product positioning and conversion

- Performance Optimization: Monitor channel performance metrics and continuously optimize channel mix, resource allocation, and activation strategies

 

 

4. Customer Journey & Experience Design

- Customer Journey Mapping: Design end-to-end customer journeys across all touchpoints (awareness, consideration, acquisition, onboarding, usage, retention, advocacy)

- Onboarding Excellence: Develop seamless onboarding processes for different customer segments and channels, reducing friction and accelerating time-to-value

- Digital Experience Optimization: Enhance digital customer experiences across web, mobile app, USSD, and messaging platforms to drive engagement and satisfaction

- Personalization Strategy: Implement data-driven personalization and segmentation strategies to deliver relevant product recommendations and offers

- Customer Pain Point Resolution: Identify and systematically eliminate customer friction points throughout the lifecycle to improve NPS and reduce churn

- Omnichannel Integration: Ensure consistent and seamless experiences across all customer interaction channels

 

5. Revenue Growth & Business Performance

- Revenue Target Achievement: Drive revenue growth through new customer acquisition, ARPU expansion, and customer lifetime value optimization

- Subscriber Acquisition Strategy: Develop and execute strategies to achieve 500K subscriber base target while maintaining quality customer acquisition

- ARPU Optimization: Implement upselling, cross-selling, and value migration strategies to achieve and maintain $10 USD ARPU target

- Retention Programs: Design and oversee customer retention initiatives to minimize churn and maximize customer lifetime value

- Monetization Innovation: Identify new revenue streams through value-added services, partnerships, and ecosystem development

 

.

6. People Manager : Team Leadership & Organizational Development 

- Team Building: Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing product and GTM team with diverse expertise in product management, marketing, analytics, and channel management

- Capability Development: Establish training programs and career development pathways to build world-class product and commercial capabilities

- Culture Development: Foster a culture of innovation, customer-centricity, data-driven decision-making, and agile execution

- Stakeholder Management: Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners to ensure alignment and collaboration

 

 

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education:

- Minimum: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, Telecommunications, or related field

- Preferred: Master's degree (MBA, Master's in Marketing, Master's in Telecommunications) from reputable university

Professional Experience:

- Minimum: 8-12 years of progressive experience in product management, marketing, and go-to-market roles within telecommunications or technology industries

title: Head of Sales (Pekanbaru/Medan)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Head of Sales (Pekanbaru/Medan)

Daftar Sekarang

Sumatra, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Primary Responsibilities

To oversee and integrate SawitPRO's Commercial, Marketing, Demand Planning, Customer Management, B2B sales, Growth, and Performance Measurement functions into a cohesive strategy. Oversee function:

Customer Experience to manage the following for the customers (primarily B2B)

Customer research, Customer acquisition, Customer engagement, Customer relationship management and Customer retention

Customer growth, including Growth Marketing through the development of a partner ecosystem, Customer Intelligence and Customers’ competitor Intelligence

Customer engagement events and marketing campaigns

Role of the Head of Sales:

Strategy & Ideation – The person responsible must develop the overall strategy and ideas behind the company's brand, as well as its customer and employee experiences.

Team management – Lead a team of collaborators and contributors for delivering on all aspects of the experience portfolio (XP)

Leadership – demonstrate leadership by coming up with innovative ideas to further the goals of the experience portfolio across all aspects of the organisation

Roadmap development – Develop the roadmap and budget for managing the experience portfolio by optimising the return on investment

Execution KPIs – clearly define execution goals and KPIs to deliver on the experience portfolio of the organisation

Senior Management collaboration – work closely with senior management, including the CEO, head of product, head of engineering, etc., to deliver on the strategic business outcomes, including owning financial KPIs and human KPIs

DDD – Lead the Data Driven Decision (DDD) making across the entire organisation. Utilise business intelligence and performance metrics to inform decision-making and strategy adjustments.

Experience gamification for optimised engagement of stakeholders across all aspects of the XP

Kualifikasi

Education

A bachelor’s Degree in Business or Marketing, or any related discipline, is required.

Experience

Min.  10 years’ experience working ideally in business management, Strong Marketing & sales/business Development, customer service, industrial design, etc., in driving digital initiatives with some independent P&L responsibilities

Five or more years of progressive leadership experience in leading cross-functional teams and enterprise-wide programs, operating and influencing effectively across the organisation and within complex contexts

Experience in innovating business models and developing new channels, business models or business transformation

Experience in consumer industries like fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), consumer banking, digital insurance, FinTech, sharing economy, etc., is preferred

Knowledge/Skills

Deep understanding of people and their motivations and behaviours

Ability to develop short interaction levers to drive strategic behaviours through gamification, rewards and engagement

Extensive knowledge of digital marketing, analytics, growth hacking and CRM.

Business-savvy strategic thinking: Big picture orientation and conceptualisation of ideas, conceiving effective strategies to drive growth and revenue generation

Strong business acumen, including domain-specific knowledge of the manufacturing and resources companies and their business units

Excellent analytical, strategic conceptual thinking and consulting skills.

Strong influence and negotiation skills

Ability to effectively drive people, process and technology change in a dynamic and complex operating environment

Excellent oral and written communication skills, including the ability to explain digital technologies to business leaders and business concepts to technologists

Must be a passionate human being with strong idealism and vision for a brighter future for Indonesia

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the Palm Oil Industry.

Our mission is to develop an integrated end-to-end agri-platform, creating a win-win-win for People, Planet and Prosperity. Our Vision is to help palm oil smallholders become more PROficient in farming practices, so that they can produce more FFB crop, resulting in greater PROsperity for indigenous communities, also creating PROfitability for our business, PROtection of the natural environment and PROgress of Indonesia

SawitPRO is a game-changer, improving the smallholders’ living standard and helping our planet to meet the growing global demand for sustainable palm oil through efficient land use.

Daftar Sekarang

title: Lead of FFB & B2B Commercial (Pekanbaru)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Lead of FFB & B2B Commercial (Pekanbaru)

Daftar Sekarang

Pekanbaru, Pekanbaru City, Riau, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full-Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Lead and drive SawitPRO's FFB (Fresh Fruit Bunch) crop commercial strategy, focusing on growth, market expansion, and strategic partnerships to support the acquisitions of FFB sources and funnel these sources into our partner mills.

Develop and execute a comprehensive commercial strategy that aligns SawitPRO's mission to enhance palm oil farming and business practices through increase in FFB growth in all stakeholders

Collaborate with product development and marketing teams to ensure product offerings meet market demands and customer needs.

Identify and pursue new business opportunities, markets, and partnerships to expand SawitPRO's footprint.

Own and develop the customer relationship for 3 distinct types of B2B customers of SawitPRO - Crude Palm Oil mills (CPO Mills), DO Agents/suppliers of CPO mills (suppliers), FFB Ramps and any other actors in the supply chain to help speed up acquisition and activation of the FFB sources.

Optimize and maximise revenue opportunities from the user base

Provide high quality customer experience through a combination of product, service and relationship management

Learn the motivation levels of each different types of customers, their pain points, business opportunities and growth prospects

Cross team collaboration across product, sales, operations, marketing and technology to promote good understanding of the customer

Be an ecosystem builder

Role of the Head, B2B Commercial

Strategy & ideation – The person responsible has to develop the overall strategy and ideas behind the company's FFB crop acquisition, conversion and customer management strategy

Team management – Lead a team of collaborators and contributors for delivering on all aspects of the business development and customer management

Leadership – demonstrate leadership by coming up with innovative ideas  as well as by building and managing a high performance team

Customer Management – Manage 3 distinct types of customers - Palm Oil mills, palm oil mill suppliers / agents, FFB Ramps and any other actors relevant to the FFB Crop Business

Customer Service - Focus on both customer acquisition and retention through a sound customer service approach
